Title: Senior Design Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Design Manager to lead design initiatives for defense projects in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the design strategy, execution, and delivery of complex defense systems and components. You will manage cross-functional teams, ensure compliance with stringent defense industry standards, and drive innovation while maintaining the highest levels of precision and security. This position offers the opportunity to shape cutting-edge defense solutions and lead a talented group of design professionals.

* Lead and manage the design team, providing strategic direction, mentorship, and performance feedback to ensure excellence and professional development
* Oversee the complete design lifecycle for defense projects, from concept development through final delivery, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards
* Develop and implement design strategies that align with project objectives, regulatory requirements, and organizational goals
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, and risk mitigation to ensure successful project completion within scope and schedule
* Ensure all designs comply with defense industry standards, international regulations, and UAE-specific security and compliance requirements
* Collaborate with stakeholders, including engineering, procurement, and client representatives, to define requirements and resolve design challenges
* Conduct design reviews and quality assurance checks to maintain technical excellence and identify areas for continuous improvement
* Analyze complex technical problems and provide innovative solutions that balance performance, cost, and manufacturability
* Maintain detailed documentation and design records in accordance with defense sector protocols and security guidelines
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in defense design and project management

  
**Qualifications**  

* Minimum 12 years of professional experience in design management, senior design roles, or equivalent leadership positions within the defense industry
* Proven expertise in managing large-scale, complex defense projects from conception through delivery
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, or a related field
* Must be an Arabic speaker

  
**Additional Information**

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Title: International Analytics Manager
Description:

You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, analyze market dynamics, and interact with marketing and business stakeholders to drive growth and engagement across international markets. If you’re passionate about sports, have a knack for strategic thinking, and thrive in a dynamic environment, this role is tailor-made for you

**Primary Location:** Across Canada

**Work Model:** Fully Remote

**Employment Type:** Contractor

**Vacancy Status:** New

* + Query and analyze data using SQL

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Analytics, or a related field

* At least 5 years of stakeholder management experience
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to drive decision-making
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to develop structured analytical approaches to business questions
* Ability to translate complex data outputs into clear, business-friendly insights
* Experience collaborating with senior stakeholders, including those at the VP level

* Experience in fan, consumer, or marketing analytics

Title: Project Manager
Description:
Job Description

Project Manager, Infrastructure (UAE)

Role overview

We are hiring a Project Manager to lead the delivery of infrastructure projects across the UAE, from design coordination through construction handover, on time, within budget and to specification.

**Job title**

Project Manager, Infrastructure

**Department**

Projects / Engineering and Delivery

**Location**

UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah, with regular site visits)

**Reports to**

Projects Director

**Employment type**

Full-time, permanent

**Project types**

Roads and bridges, utilities (water, power, drainage), district infrastructure, marine or rail works

Key responsibilitiesPlanning and delivery

* Own the full project lifecycle: scope, programme, budget, procurement, execution, testing, commissioning and handover.

* Develop and maintain the project execution plan, baseline programme (Primavera P6 or MS Project) and work breakdown structure.

* Track progress against milestones, forecast delays early and agree recovery plans.

Cost and commercial control

* Manage the project budget, cash flow, variation orders, claims and final accounts.

* Review and approve contractor and consultant payment applications.

* Report cost forecasts and risks to senior management on a monthly basis.

Stakeholder and contractor management

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, main contractors and subcontractors.

* Secure permits and no-objection certificates (NOCs) from UAE authorities such as RTA, DEWA, ADDC, Dubai Municipality, Department of Municipalities and Transport, Etisalat and du.

* Lead progress, design and coordination meetings; resolve interface issues across disciplines.

Quality, health, safety and environment

* Enforce HSE standards in line with UAE regulations, client requirements and ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.

* Ensure works meet approved drawings, specifications and quality plans, including inspection and test plans.

* Investigate incidents and non-conformances and close out corrective actions.

Risk and reporting

* Maintain the risk register and run regular risk reviews.

* Issue weekly and monthly progress reports covering programme, cost, quality, safety and risks.

* Lead, mentor and review the performance of the project team.

Qualifications and experienceRequired

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

* 10+ years of experience in infrastructure project delivery, with at least 5 years as a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager.

* 5+ years of experience on projects in the UAE or GCC, with working knowledge of local authority approval processes.

* Proven record of delivering projects above AED 100 million, on time and within budget.

* Experience with FIDIC contracts and claims management.

* Valid UAE driving licence (preferred at hire, required within the probation period).

Preferred

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 certification.

* Master's degree in Engineering or Project Management.

* Experience with PPP, design-and-build or EPC delivery models.

Skills and competenciesTechnical

* Strong command of civil and infrastructure construction methods, specifications and UAE standards.

* Advanced programming and cost control using Primavera P6, MS Project and Excel.

* Contract administration: extensions of time, variations, claims and dispute avoidance.

* Familiarity with BIM coordination tools and document platforms such as Aconex or Procore.

Leadership and behavioural

* Decisive leader who builds accountable, multidisciplinary teams.

* Clear written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

* Negotiation and conflict resolution with clients, authorities and contractors.

* Sound judgement under pressure, with a strong safety-first mindset.

* Comfortable working in a multicultural environment and on site in UAE summer conditions.

What we offer and how to apply

* Competitive tax-free salary, with the package to be confirmed by the hiring team.

* UAE employment visa, Emirates ID and medical insurance for you and eligible dependants.

* Housing or transport allowance, annual flight ticket and end-of-service gratuity under UAE labour law.

* 30 calendar days of annual leave, plus public holidays.

* Training, certification support and a clear path to Senior Project Manager or Programme Manager.

To apply, send your CV and a cover letter to **admin@adcondxb.ae**

Pay: AED15,000.00 - AED20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Lead - Procurement Systems, Digitalization & Process Improvement
Description:
Lead - Procurement Systems, Digitalisation & Process Improvement
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
The Lead - Procurement Systems, Digitalisation & Process Improvement will be responsible for driving digital transformation initiatives across the procurement function through system enhancements, ERP optimisation, process automation, data analytics, and reporting improvements. The role will serve as the focal point between Procurement, IT, Digital Transformation, and business stakeholders to improve procurement efficiency, data visibility, system integration, and user adoption.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Procurement Systems & ERP Enhancement

+ Lead continuous improvement initiatives for procurement-related systems and processes.
+ Manage procurement system integrations with ERP platforms such as SAP.
+ Identify opportunities to enhance system functionality, workflows, and user experience.
+ Coordinate with IT and business stakeholders to implement system upgrades and enhancements.
+ Support procurement digitisation projects and technology deployment initiatives.
+ Ensure data integrity, standardisation, and governance across procurement systems.

* Business Intelligence & Analytics

+ Develop and maintain procurement dashboards and performance reports using Power BI.
+ Utilise Power Query and advanced Excel tools for data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and analysis.
+ Analyse procurement performance metrics, spend data, supplier performance, and operational KPIs.
+ Generate meaningful insights and recommendations through data analytics and visualisation.
+ Design executive-level reports and presentations to support management decision-making.

* Automation & Process Improvement

+ Develop automated workflows using Power Automate.
+ Create business applications and workflow solutions using Power Apps.
+ Identify manual activities that can be automated to improve efficiency and reduce processing time.
+ Map existing procurement processes and develop future-state workflows using Visio.
+ Lead continuous improvement programmes focused on digitalisation and process optimisation.

* SharePoint & Collaboration Solutions

+ Develop and manage SharePoint-based procurement repositories, dashboards, and collaboration platforms.
+ Improve document management, workflow tracking, and information accessibility.
+ Support knowledge management and digital workplace initiatives within procurement.

* Reporting & Presentation Development

+ Develop professional procurement presentations and executive reports using PowerPoint.
+ Create infographics and visual communication materials for management reporting.
+ Translate complex data into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Act as the interface between procurement, supply chain, IT, digital transformation, and business units.
+ Gather business requirements and convert them into technical and system improvement initiatives.
+ Conduct user training and support change management activities during system implementations.
+ Provide technical guidance to procurement users on digital tools and reporting solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a Related Field.
* Professional certifications in SAP, Microsoft Power Platform, data analytics, or project management are advantageous.

**Experience Requirements**

* Typically 6-8+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain systems, business analytics, digital transformation, ERP implementation, or process improvement.
* Proven experience in procurement system implementation, enhancement, or integration projects.
* Experience working with procurement modules within ERP environments such as SAP.
* Demonstrated experience in business intelligence, reporting, process automation, and workflow optimisation.
* Experience interfacing with both business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent understanding of procurement processes and system-driven improvements.
* Highly proficient in data management, reporting, and dashboard development.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions.
* Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience leading digitalisation, automation, or procurement transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable efficiency improvements through technology and process optimisation.

Title: Business Division Manager
Description:
***BUSINESS DIVISION MANAGER***
**Job Purpose**

* Lead and manage the business functions for the Beach Valves Project from concept development through project execution, ensuring effective project governance, planning and reporting, risk and change management, cost and schedule oversight, contracting and procurement support, and organisational readiness to enable safe, timely and effective delivery of the Project.
* The Business Division Manager is responsible for managing and integrating the business requirements of the Beach Valves Project throughout all project phases, from concept development through execution. The role requires close coordination across Major Projects functions, Operations, Engineering, Supply, Finance, Legal, P&D and other supporting organisations.
* Establishing and maintaining fit-for-purpose project governance, controls, reporting, risk, change, planning and business processes appropriate to the maturity and execution phase of the project.
* Supporting Project Management in managing interfaces, priorities, emerging risks and decisions within a brownfield operating environment involving multiple stakeholders and existing facilities.
* Maintaining alignment between the company, contractors and key stakeholders to support timely decisions and achievement of safety, quality, cost and schedule objectives.

**REPORTING & RELATIONSHIPS**

* Reports to Project Manager

+ Direct Reports: 4.

* Internal Stakeholders

+ Frequent contact with Project PMT.
+ Frequent contact within the Major Projects group and other departments such as Execution Planning and Services (EP&S), Legal, Supply, Operations, Finance, Other MP PMTs, and Shared Services.

* External Stakeholders

+ Frequent contact with the EPC contractor, their sub-contractors, vendors and other third parties during the execution of the project.
+ Frequent contact with Beach Valves project shareholders.

**KEY JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Project Business Management: Lead and manage the project business functions and associated activities, including project governance, reporting, risk, change management, planning, cost, contracting and procurement support to enable achievement of project objectives.
* Governance & Business Framework: Establish and maintain the project business management framework from concept development through execution, ensuring appropriate processes, controls and governance arrangements are implemented in accordance with company requirements.
* Performance Management: Drive project performance through the review and coordination of schedule, cost, risk, change, KPIs, management reporting and other performance indicators, escalating areas requiring management intervention.
* Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Manage the preparation and coordination of project management reports, presentations, decision papers, committee submissions and approval documentation to meet governance requirements and enable timely, informed management decisions.
* Project Management System Compliance: Manage compliance with the company Project Management System (PMS) through coordination of applicable gate requirements, deliverables, reviews, findings and close-out actions to demonstrate project readiness for progression through the applicable lifecycle gates.
* Risk, Issue & Change Management: Lead project risk, issue and change management processes, ensuring risks and changes are identified, assessed, communicated, tracked and appropriately escalated to support informed project decisions.
* Organisational & Resource Planning: Coordinate project organisational and resource requirements, including recruitment, manpower planning, organisation charts, facilities and support services to maintain appropriate project capability through the different phases of execution.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate business interfaces with Major Projects functions, Operations, Engineering, Supply, Legal, Finance, P&D and other Company organisations to facilitate timely decisions and resolution of Project issues.
* Contracting, Procurement & Commercial Support: Support project contracting, procurement and commercial activities through coordination of business requirements, change orders, management recommendations and interfaces with contractors, vendors and service providers to enable timely contractual and commercial decisions in support of project delivery.
* Compliance, Audits & Continuous Improvement: Monitor project business processes and procedural compliance, supporting internal and external reviews, audits, lessons learned and continuous improvement throughout project execution.

**PERSON SPECIFICATION - Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in: Business / Accounting / Commercial / Marketing / Sciences / Engineering / Project Management / Supply Chain Management / Law / Communication / Technologies / Mathematics / Statistics
* Knowledge & Experience

+ 12 years experience in a business-related function or discipline.
+ Including 8 years in the Oil & Gas Industry.
+ Including 3 years experience in a supervisory or acting role or oversight of contractor/subcontractor/service/vendor personnel.

* Technical & Business Skills

+ Strong knowledge in project business-related functions/disciplines such as planning, scheduling, cost control, estimating, claim management, risk management, change management, procurement, pre- and post-award contract management, actionable and informative reporting, support services, lessons learned, etc.
+ Extensive knowledge in international standards, best practices and methodologies as it relates to business disciplines.
+ Broad experience and demonstrated competence in managing a business function and disciplines, including contractors, cost and tenders.
+ Strong experience with risk assessment approach in decision-making.
+ Strong knowledge of relevant software and computer skills, e.g., dashboards, data analytics, SAP, etc.
+ Experience working in large-scale operating organisations in operations, projects, subsurface, etc.

Title: Manager, Client Engagement (1 year contract)
Description:
**Our Company**

BrandActive specializes in the financial analysis, strategy, and logistics of rebrand implementation. Since 1998, we’ve helped many of the world’s most valuable brands plan, budget, and implement brand change—optimizing spend, improving efficiency, and reducing complexity along the way.

  

Our work combines industry-leading analytics with a proven methodology to help clients make smarter decisions, save time and money, and get more value from their brand investments—whether they’re navigating a major rebrand or managing their brand day to day. You can explore examples of our work in our case studies.

  

At BrandActive, we’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive workplace where people can do their best work and grow together. We strive to set the global standard for excellence in our industry while fostering a culture rooted in trust, agility, and growth —guided by our North Star: great people, doing great work, and having a great time doing it.

  

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to a Director, the Manager serves as the project lead and is accountable for strategic planning, project formulation/scoping, scenario planning, cost estimating and relationship management that supports the conversion of the client’s branded assets to a new identity/logo. The Manager then oversees the project as it moves into subsequent implementation and roll-out phases while ensuring that the client’s needs are met.

  

To fulfill these responsibilities, the Manager typically works directly with clients at senior levels of the organization including the C-suite. When conditions safely permit, travel between North America and internationally may be a requirement.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Strategy/Analytics**

* Consult with clients about all elements for project scope and delivery, providing a high-level of expertise and instilling confidence in the client.
* Work with the client and BrandActive’s team to define the scope of brand transition across all branded asset categories (e.g. signage, ID badges, website, etc.)
* Develop several high-level scenarios to achieve brand launch and completion objectives using cost, time, quality and impact as the key variables.
* Provide senior leadership and their Board the information they need to make fiscally responsible brand decisions.
* Establish high-level transition strategies by branded asset category with priority given to those categories which are required for brand launch and have longer lead times.
* Formulate and comprehend overall implementation financials and to evaluate the implications of alternative strategy approaches on these financials at a macro and micro level.
* Develop cost estimates based on developed transition strategies.
* Define the high-level processes required to support an efficient implementation process.
* Create a high-level project communications plan to ensure engagement of all project constituents.
* Define the project organization required to execute the brand transition in a way that ensures achievement of client goals and desired outcomes.

  

**Project Management**

* Lead the project team, allocating and utilizing resources in an efficient manner and maintaining a co-operative, motivated and successful team.
* Communicate project status regularly (e.g. using dashboard reports) and escalate issues to stakeholders, sponsor(s), and senior leadership as required.
* Manage project deliverables in line with approved project plans.
* Manage or coordinate partners and work groups engaged in project delivery.
* Lead internal projects and client-facing (or conference call) meetings.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans (following PMI methodologies).
* Record, track and manage project issues and risks, escalating concerns when necessary.
* Manage project scope and change control.
* Monitor project progress and performance.
* Monitor the project budget.
* Create and present deliverables, and facilitate approval of recommendations.
* Review and provide guidance with new statements of work with current projects.
* Manage the creation of change orders with direction from the Director.

  

**Professional Development**

* Own your growth by setting and updating development goals, actively seeking feedback, and aligning your aspirations with business goals.
* Contribute to internal initiatives that impact the client and/or team member experience such as our Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion Advisory Committee, Community Impact Committee, or our Social Committee.
* Bring forward smarter, faster, better solutions to processes and identify opportunities to be more agile in day-to-day activities.
* Demonstrate inclusive and supportive behavior, contributing to BrandActive’s core values of trust, agility, and growth, commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion, (EDI), humanity, and wellbeing.

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

You might not tick every box, but if you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about the role, we’d love to hear from you. We value potential, curiosity, and a growth mindset.

  

**Education and Experience**

* Demonstrated commitment to life-long learning; post-secondary degree, diploma or certificate preferred.
* Three to four years of project management experience with at least two years as the Project Lead (managing projects from start to finish).
* Strong consultative skills gained through experience working as an internal consultant or in a professional services environment.

  

**Competencies**

* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Superior organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity including the ability to handle multiple tasks under pressure across more complex/multi-faceted projects.
* Presence including the ability and confidence to manage client calls.
* Proven credibility gained by consistently delivering on commitments.
* Demonstrated ability move across a range of projects and clients over time.
* Ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships both internally and externally.
* Excellent client contact, negotiation and problem-resolution skills.
* Detail-oriented, including the ability to identify important details, ensuring things are not overlooked and delivering a consistently high quality of work, keeping the overall goals of the project in mind.
* Demonstrated initiative including finding innovative solutions for the company and the clients.
* Skill in managing the relationship with the client and looking for additional opportunities to bring value and provide additional services.
* Taking action to make the most of the opportunities for the good of the company; takes a long-term view with the client.
* Leadership skills to lead a team of diverse individuals, providing oversight of their work, coaching and supporting them from a developmental perspective.

  

**Technical Skills**

* Excellent computer skills including MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project or other scheduling software such as Smartsheet or Teamwork Projects.
* At least basic knowledge and experience with MS Visio.
* Additional languages an asset.

  

**Compensation and Benefits**

BrandActive offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including:

* **Competitive compensation:** $100,000.00 -$150,000.00 CAD. Total compensation depends on experience, education, and skills and includes non-cash rewards. This range is plus commission.
* **Values led culture** focused on humanity, trust, agility, and growth. Check out our **Culture Statement.**
* **Comprehensive health and dental coverage** with no waiting period – your benefits start on day one.
* **Generous paid time off:** 3 weeks of vacation, additional office closures, Flex Fridays, and extended long weekends throughout the summer.
* **Holistic wellbeing benefits,** including a wellbeing allowance, flexible additional time off to care for a loved one, support mental health, or observe meaningful religious or cultural holidays.
* **Parental leave benefits** to support you and your family.
* **Home office and communications reimbursement** to help you work comfortably.
* **Charitable donation matching** to support the causes that matter to you.
* **Flexible work options** – Hybrid - with adaptable schedules.
* **Two annual town halls** in Toronto, featuring engaging sessions and fun team activities.
* **Supportive leadership and career development**, with ongoing coaching and feedback to help you grow and succeed, quarterly formal feedback, annual performance reviews and separate annual development meetings.
* **Work-from-anywhere flexibility,** with the option to work abroad for up to four weeks (in eligible countries and after a minimum tenure depending on the role and circumstance).
* And more!

  

**Start Date**

Immediately.

  

**Location**

Hybrid -Toronto, Ontario. BrandActive has an office in Toronto, ON.

  

**Job Vacancy:** This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope.

  

**Commitment to Equal Opportunity**

BrandActive is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values inclusion in its workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.

  

**Accessibility Statement**

BrandActive is dedicated to ensuring an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations during the application process, please let the Talent Manager know. We are committed to partnering with you to provide support and make reasonable adjustments throughout the process. All information received in relation to accommodation will be kept confidential and will be handled in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act.

  

**The Interview Process**

At BrandActive, we use AI within our recruitment process in the following ways: screening applicants and recording calls and interviews. All candidates will be notified of the use of AI at the start of a call or interview and can request to opt out. As part of our broader dedication to EDI, we continuously review and refine our use of AI to support equitable experiences for all applicants.

* **Initial Call (Pre-Screen):** If your application is selected, you will have a prescreen call with the Talent Manager where we will use AI to transcribe for accurate note taking.
* **Virtual Interview:** Followed by an interview with the hiring manager.
* **Case Presentation Interview:** The last step is a case study and presentation to our team.

  

We thank all applicants for their interest in BrandActive, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Senior Solution Architect - Core Networks
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
At Capgemini Engineering, we are shaping the future of mission-critical connectivity across the globe. Our Connectivity & Network Engineering teams are at the heart of next-generation telecom transformation, delivering resilient, secure, and scalable core network platforms for some of the most demanding environments in the world. In Al-Khobar, we are growing our team of senior technical leaders who can own architecture decisions, drive multi-vendor integration, and lead high-performing engineering teams. If you are a seasoned core network architect who thrives at the intersection of technical depth and strategic leadership, this is the opportunity for you.
  
  
We are looking for an exceptional

* Coordinate the operational validation of end-to-end cargo processes, including normal operations, peak conditions, exceptions, degraded modes, system recovery, manual fallback and business-continuity arrangements.
* Provide the Senior Manager Projects – CT2 with evidence-based operational assessments, acceptance conditions and recommended actions relating to operational suitability, testing, handover and readiness.

* Support knowledge transfer from the ORAT consultants to QAS Cargo and ensure relevant readiness documentation, tools and lessons are retained within the operation.

* Coordinate QAS Cargo review of operations and maintenance manuals, as-built information, asset data, training materials, operational procedures, warranties, support arrangements and other documents required for safe and effective operation.

* Maintain the CT2 operational lessons-learned and knowledge-transfer process to retain project, process and systems knowledge within QAS Cargo.

Title: Technical Project Manager
Description:
**What We’re All About.**
It isn’t often you get to be part of a tech company that, since 2016, has been innovating the data analytics market in ways no-one else can. Our technology started out in FinTech, helping tackle serious criminal activity. Now, its potential is virtually limitless.
  
  
Working at Quantexa isn't just intellectually stimulating. We’re a real team. Collaborating and constantly engineering better and better solutions. We’re ambitious, we think things through and we’re on a mission to discover just how far we go. Nearly half of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We’re made up of people from 47 nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.
  
  
If our incredible culture sounds like you, we’d love you to join us.
  
  
**The opportunity.**
As a Technical Project Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution and successful end-to-end delivery of implementation projects to our clients. You will join a wider Delivery team of engineers, analysts, data scientists and architects focused on achieving the best outcomes for our clients.
  
  
You will be part of the Project Management practice, a global network of project and programme management professionals within Quantexa, a group designed to support your career development and ensure you fulfil your full potential.
  
  
As well as working with some of the largest and most prestigious organisations in the world, you will also be working hand in hand with our delivery partner network, which includes the big four consultancies as well as major systems integrators.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* You will take full ownership of the delivery of Quantexa projects end-to-end, putting your arms around all aspects, actively mitigating risks and issues, driving high standards of quality and best practice and being in full control of the costs, timelines and scope.
* You’ll drive successful outcomes - delivering projects in the most optimal way that realise maximum value to our clients.
* Managing the commercial and financial aspects of your projects, working with our clients to agree contracts for professional services, using both Time and Materials (T&M) and Fixed Priced constructs.
* Coaching and mentoring your technical teams to ensure they have the skills and capabilities necessary to produce high quality deliverables to our clients.
* Working and learning with a high degree of autonomy with minimal supervision, seeking and knowing when to engage the rest of the Quantexa organisation for support.
* You will devise critical strategies to successfully manage your project stakeholders, both from the client as well as Quantexa leadership.

**What You’ll Bring.**

* You are an accomplished project management professional with strong leadership skills and a track record of delivering complex projects with excellent outcomes.
* You are an expert on project methodologies and approaches such as Agile, can apply them to maximum effect and you appreciate how these methodologies and approaches can scale to multiple teams and functions.
* You have broad stakeholder management experience either as a supplier delivering to clients, such as a consultancy or professional services organisation, or within a client-side environment.

* You have a good understanding of the technical aspects that impact the project outcomes and can grasp technical issues and devise mitigation strategies to address them.
* You have a strong appreciation of the business purpose and drivers of your projects and direct the team to ensure that achieving them is paramount.
* You are adept at operating in complex multi-team environments where you harness your skills and knowledge to influence other teams to deliver the best overall outcome.
* You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, critical thinking and the ability to devise delivery solutions to address client challenges.
* Exhibit strong technical communication skills with demonstrable experience of working in rapidly changing client environments.
* Have an excellent appreciation of what makes a high quality, operationally stable system and how to streamline all areas of development, release, and operations to achieve this.
* You are a self-starter and bring a great deal of determination, initiative and tenacity to your projects.
* Proficiency in speaking Arabic at a fluent/native level is mandatory.
* Comfortable traveling within the UAE and across the Gulf region as required for business needs and client engagements.

**Ideal Candidates Will Also**

* Have worked on a variety of complex data orientated projects for financial services, government, and telco clients.

**Our perks and quirks.**
What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

* Competitive salary & Company bonus
* 22 days annual leave, plus national holidays + your birthday off!
* Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover
* Regularly bench-marked salary rates
* Well-being days
* Volunteer Day off
* Work from Home Equipment
* Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

* Coordinate with relevant departments to identify resource gaps and potential capacity constraints.

* Identify potential budget variances and highlight areas requiring corrective action.
* Ensure resources are aligned with project priorities, operational requirements, and delivery timelines.

* Act as a central coordination point between senior management, project managers, department heads, and key stakeholders.
* Facilitate project review meetings, governance meetings, and progress discussions.
* Ensure clear communication of project priorities, responsibilities, decisions, and action items.
* Follow up with workstream leads to ensure agreed actions and deliverables are completed within established deadlines.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and support the resolution of cross-functional challenges.
* Ensure alignment between different departments and project teams.

Title: Program Director, Sustainability Data Analytics (Part-Time)
Description:
**Company Description**

TechSilo is a small technology and engineering services firm in Fredericksburg, Virginia. We support federal defense customers, including a multi-year Navy engineering program, and we are growing into higher education and public-sector analytics. The team is small and senior, so you work directly with our CEO and with the client's decision makers.

 **Job Description**

Keep several analytics projects moving at once, and be the one person the client calls. The client will issue work in separate Task Orders, each with its own question, data, deadline, and budget. You scope each one with the client, put the right people on it, protect the budget, and step in before a problem becomes a missed date. You also decide when work is ready to go out the door. This role suits someone who has run multi-project engagements and likes keeping many moving parts honest.

**What you'll do**

* Serve as the client's primary contact for the engagement. Run an intake session for each Task Order and agree the question, datasets, outputs, review points, and delivery dates.
* Scope each Task Order with the client and propose the labor categories, estimated hours, and not-to-exceed value for the work.
* Plan capacity across Task Orders running at the same time. Confirm each person's availability and competing commitments before committing to a schedule, and line up backups.
* Direct the delivery team, including Task Leads, data scientists, analysts, a dashboard developer, and the senior quality assurance reviewer. Resolve conflicts between Task Orders before they reach a milestone.
* Track hours, spend, and forecast against each Task Order ceiling. When the ceiling is at risk, bring the client options before any extra work is done.
* Own escalation. Raise risks, schedule changes, and scope changes with the client promptly, and get changes to scope, hours, or dates approved in writing.
* Make sure every deliverable receives independent senior review before release, separate from the people who produced it.
* Hold the line on the client's data and AI commitments: client data stays in our managed environment, and we use artificial intelligence only with the client's approval.
* Act as Task Lead on smaller assignments when the workload allows.

**How the role works**

Hours are authorized Task Order by Task Order, typically 5 to 10 per week when work is active, with more during the intake of a new Task Order. There is no guaranteed minimum, and the role starts only if the contract is awarded. You set your schedule within the delivery dates. Finalists may be asked to sign a commitment letter, and their resume may be shared with the client.

 **Qualifications**

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.
* At least 12 years of professional experience, including directing professional services engagements made up of several projects.
* Experience running multiple client assignments at once, each with its own scope, schedule, and budget.
* Hands-on financial oversight: tracking hours and spend against a contract ceiling and forecasting what is left.
* Experience directing technical specialists, such as analysts, data scientists, or engineers, without needing to do their work yourself.
* Clear, direct writing and speaking with senior client decision makers, including delivering unwelcome news early.
* Based in the US and able to work remotely, part-time, in TechSilo's managed environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience on data or analytics engagements.
* Experience with task order or time-and-materials contracts, including managing to a not-to-exceed value.
* Work for a university, a public agency, or another organization made of many separate entities.
* Familiarity with sustainability, procurement, or spend data.
* A project management credential such as PMP.

  
**Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Title: People & Culture Assistant Manager (Saudi Only)

* Represent the People & Culture department in operational meetings when delegated.
* Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of HR policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Identify operational challenges and recommend effective solutions to enhance HR service delivery.
* Ensure a professional, confidential, and service-oriented approach across all People & Culture activities.

**Pre-Opening People & Culture Management**

* Support the execution of the resort's People & Culture pre-opening critical path and manpower mobilization plan.

* Oversee pre-opening recruitment coordination, employee onboarding, and joining formalities.

* Coordinate recruitment activities through SmartRecruiters and other approved platforms.
* Monitor recruitment progress, hiring timelines, and manpower requirements.
* Partner with department heads to identify recruitment priorities and workforce needs.
* Review employment offers, contracts, and joining documentation for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain recruitment reports and provide regular hiring updates to the People & Culture Manager.
* Support workforce planning, internal mobility, and talent development initiatives.

**Employee Relations & Labor Law Compliance**

* Provide guidance on employee relations matters, workplace policies, and Saudi Labor Law requirements.
* Support grievance handling, disciplinary procedures, workplace investigations, and conflict resolution.
* Ensure employee relations processes are conducted fairly, consistently, and in accordance with applicable regulations.
* Advise department heads on appropriate HR procedures and employee management practices.
* Monitor employment contract compliance, probation periods, resignations, and termination procedures.
* Coordinate with Government Relations on employment-related regulatory requirements.
* Support Saudization monitoring and compliance with applicable workforce localization requirements.
* Maintain accurate documentation of employee relations matters and compliance activities.

**Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Oversee the preparation and verification of monthly payroll inputs in coordination with Finance.
* Review attendance records, overtime, leave balances, allowances, deductions, and payroll adjustments.
* Ensure accuracy of employee data within HR and payroll systems.
* Coordinate employee benefits administration, medical insurance, and employment-related entitlements.
* Review end-of-service benefit calculations, final settlements, and separation documentation.
* Ensure payroll administration and employee entitlements comply with applicable Saudi Labor Law requirements.
* Identify payroll discrepancies and coordinate timely corrective actions.

* Support the implementation of performance management processes, probation reviews, and annual appraisals.
* Guide department heads on performance documentation and employee development procedures.
* Coordinate with the Training Supervisor on onboarding, mandatory training, and development initiatives.
* Support talent identification, succession planning, and career development programs.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional development.

**Heartist Engagement & Workplace Culture**

* Promote Accor's Heartist philosophy and foster a positive, inclusive, and engaging workplace environment.
* Support employee engagement, recognition, welfare, and well-being initiatives.
* Coordinate internal communication activities and employee events.
* Act as a trusted point of contact for Heartists seeking HR guidance and support.
* Monitor employee feedback and recommend initiatives to improve engagement and retention.
* Support a workplace culture that reflects the resort's luxury hospitality values.

**HR Systems, Reporting & Compliance**

* Oversee the accuracy and maintenance of employee records within HR information systems.
* Prepare and review HR reports covering headcount, turnover, recruitment, attendance, leave balances, and Saudization.
* Ensure employee personnel files, employment contracts, and regulatory documentation are complete and updated.
* Support HR audits, compliance reviews, and internal reporting requirements.
* Monitor HR-related deadlines and ensure timely completion of required actions.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and compliance with applicable data protection requirements.
* Perform additional People & Culture management responsibilities as assigned by the People & Culture Manager.

* Minimum 3–4 years of progressive Human Resources experience, preferably within the hotel or hospitality industry.
* Previous experience within luxury hotels, resorts, or internationally recognized hospitality brands is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to independently manage daily HR operations and provide professional guidance to department heads.
* Strong practical knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, employment regulations, and Saudization requirements.
* Demonstrated experience in employee relations, recruitment, payroll coordination, performance management, and HR administration.
* Previous hotel or resort pre-opening experience is a strong advantage.
* Hands-on familiarity with Saudi government platforms, including Qiwa, GOSI, and Mudad.
* Experience using HRIS, payroll systems, and recruitment platforms.
* Familiarity with Accor People & Culture systems and SmartRecruiters is an advantage.
* Professional HR certifications such as CIPD, SHRM, or equivalent are desirable.

**Leadership & Professional Competencies**

* Strong understanding of hospitality HR operations and employee relations.
* Excellent knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and employment compliance.
* Excellent command of English and Arabic, both written and spoken.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to advise department heads and handle sensitive HR matters professionally.
* Strong analytical thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional judgment.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Ability to supervise, coach, and support junior HR team members.
* Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and initiative.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced pre-opening environment.
* Passion for people development, employee engagement, and luxury hospitality.

 **Additional Information**

Joining Basiqat by Mantis means becoming part of an exciting pre-opening journey and contributing to the creation of a distinctive luxury hospitality destination in Riyadh.

As part of Mantis and the global Accor family, you will have the opportunity to:

* Be part of a dynamic and passionate pre-opening team.
* Lead the establishment and development of restaurant and bar operations within a new luxury eco-resort.
* Contribute to creating distinctive dining concepts and personalized guest experiences.
* Play an important role in shaping Food & Beverage service standards and operational excellence.
* Develop and lead a high-performing restaurant and bar team.
* Support innovative and sustainable dining and beverage initiatives.
* Grow professionally within an internationally recognized hospitality group.
* Experience a collaborative, inclusive, and people-focused working environment.
* Access learning and development opportunities within Accor.
* Enjoy applicable ALL Heartists employee benefits and recognition programs.

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**

At Accor, we believe in creating an environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to equal opportunities and fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

**Join us and be part of the Basiqat by Mantis journey!**

Title: Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager
Description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager, you will help deliver the core infrastructure behind Microsoft's online services, including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Azure. Our infrastructure spans over 200 datacenters and 1 million servers, supporting more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses worldwide. With a focus on environmental sustainability, we continue to grow and evolve to meet changing business demands, maintaining Microsoft's position as a world-class cloud provider.

Data Center Operations Construction (DCOC) delivers complex construction and retrofit programs inside live, operational datacenters. The work spans capacity additions, mechanical and electrical equipment replacement, end-of-life remediation, network and deployment enablement, and first-of-kind retrofits, all executed without interrupting the customer availability the sites exist to provide.

The Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager owns the Operations Construction portfolio across a group of assigned metros. Where metro program managers deliver the projects in front of them, this role decides what that portfolio contains: which work advances, which is deferred, which is stopped, and in what order, across metros competing for the same capital, outage windows, vendor capacity, and site operations bandwidth. Accountability sits with the health of the multi-metro portfolio as a whole rather than with any single project inside it.

The role leads the program managers and contract construction and safety managers working across those metros, and is measured on their capability and consistency as much as on delivered projects. It carries the most complex work in its portfolio, including first-of-kind retrofits in live space where no established execution method exists, and converts that work into standards and practice the wider program adopts. Reporting to the Director of Operations Construction, this position represents DCOC to site leadership, engineering, commissioning, and enterprise customer programs.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead portfolio strategy and prioritization across assigned metros, translating capacity, availability, sustainability, and business objectives into executable construction plans while balancing capital, resources, outage windows, vendor capacity, and operational constraints.
* Own portfolio delivery and governance across safety, scope, schedule, budget, commercial performance, and risk, including forecasting, change management, project controls, commissioning readiness, operational turnover, and closeout.
* Exercise independent judgment on complex, high-impact programs, assessing project viability, investment trade-offs, emerging risks, and delivery confidence, and personally leading the most complex, first-of-kind, or highest-risk initiatives when warranted.
* Lead and develop program capability across the portfolio, providing direction, coaching, and technical leadership to program managers and contract construction and safety teams while building workforce capacity, bench strength, and consistent execution practices.
* Develop and scale construction standards and program practices, establishing execution methods for first-of-kind work and translating lessons learned, root cause findings, project controls, and performance data into repeatable standards and playbooks adopted across metros and regions.
* Influence senior stakeholders and delivery partners across site operations, engineering, commissioning, supply chain, security, legal, and enterprise programs, presenting portfolio performance, investment needs, forecasts, and risk in terms that enable clear business decisions and resolve competing priorities.
* Model and champion a safety-first, accountable culture while embodying Microsoft’s culture and values, holding internal teams and external partners to high standards for safety, security, availability, operational excellence, and responsible delivery.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* High School Qualification or equivalent AND 10+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale environments OR equivalent experience

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field AND 15+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 17+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR equivalent experience.
* Applicable certifications: Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications.
* 12+ years of experience in construction management, datacenter operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or program management
* 6+ years of experience managing complex project or program portfolios across multiple sites, metros, or regions
* Experience delivering construction in live, mission-critical environments while maintaining operational availability
* Experience leading first-of-kind, accelerated, or high-risk projects with accountability for safety, cost, schedule, and risk
* Experience leading and developing teams, including employees, contractors, and cross-functional resources
* Experience managing portfolio governance, commercial performance, vendors, project controls, KPIs, and executive reporting
* PE, PMP, CCM, DBIA, LEED, CQM, ITIL, or equivalent certification preferred

Description:
About Cigna Healthcare
  
  
Cigna Healthcare is a global health service company dedicated to transforming healthcare. With roots in the U.S. and operations in over 30 countries, we serve more than 180 million customers and patients worldwide. About the Role
  
  
The Customer Service Lead Representative plays a critical role in supporting the delivery of exceptional customer service across member, provider, client, and broker interactions while providing day-to-day operational support within the contact centre.
  
This role serves as a senior technical and operational resource, managing complex enquiries, complaints, escalations, and service recovery activities while helping ensure service continuity, workload visibility, and adherence to service standards.
  
Working closely with the Customer Service Manager, the Customer Service Lead Representative provides floor support, operational guidance, and knowledge sharing to Customer Service Representatives, helping to drive service quality and operational effectiveness.
  
This is not a formal people management role and does not include employee performance management, disciplinary authority, or approval responsibilities.
  
  
What Youll Do
  
  

* Investigate and resolve complex customer enquiries, complaints, appeals, and escalated service issues across calls, emails, and written correspondence.
* Act as the primary operational and technical escalation point for cases requiring advanced research, coordination, policy interpretation, or procedural guidance.
* Interpret policy provisions, benefits, procedures, and operational requirements to determine appropriate solutions and escalation pathways.

* Collaborate with Health Plans, Claims, Approvals, Service Centres, Providers, IT, and other stakeholders to facilitate prompt resolution of customer issues.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex customer enquiries, complaints, escalations, and service recovery situations.

* Strong understanding of contact centre operations, service levels, escalation management, workload prioritisation, case ownership, and queue management principles.

Skills

* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage professionally and empathetically with customers and stakeholders.

Title: Production and Customer Service Manager
Description:
**Production – Customer Service Manager**

**Overview:**

Theralase® Technologies Inc. (“**Theralase®**”) is a publicly traded Canadian federal corporation (**TSXV: TLT**; **OTCQB: TLTFF**) focused on the destruction of cancer, bacteria and viruses consisting of two primary divisions:

1) **Drug Division** – Preclinical research and clinical development of energy-activated small molecules and the energy systems that activate them to safely and effectively destroy various cancers, bacteria and viruses.

2) **Device Division** - Manufacturer and distributer of proprietary super-pulsed Cool Laser Therapy (“**CLT**”) medical lasers, primarily in Canada and the United States, for the treatment of knee pain, and in off-label use, treatment of numerous nerve, muscle and joint conditions. In addition, the Device Division designs and manufactures proprietary medical laser systems used to activate the small molecules in the Drug Division.

Additional information is available at www.theralase.com and www.sedarplus.com

**Job Description:**

The Production – Customer Service Manager (“**PCSM**”) will be responsible for:

1) Direct management of production employees (engineers, technologists and technicians) in the manufacture and service of Theralase® Cool Laser Therapy (“**CLT**”) and medical laser systems (“**Products**”) for both the Drug and Device Divisions; including: incoming inspection, supplier and sub-contractor procurement and supervision, scheduling, manufacture, calibration, final test, quality control test, quality assurance, labelling, packaging, storage, sterilization, shipping and timely delivery within 24 hours of order receipt

2) Customer service of all Theralase® Products; including: verbal, written and digital communication with customers or potential customers regarding the purchase, performance, maintenance, operation, technical training, clinical training, repair (both in and out of warranty), costing of repair per finance guidelines, replacement and/or delivery

3) Coordinate the accurate and timely completion of a Customer Service Inquiry (“**CSI**”) to receive, track, repair and return a customer Product to them, within 48 hours of customer approval.

4) Deliver customer feedback survey form to all new and current customers to track customer satisfaction level post sale / post-service, respectively to obtain a Customer Satisfaction Rating (“**CSR**”). Implement strategies to systematically improve the CSR on a quarterly basis

5) Follow up with customers and secure written and video testimonials supporting the clinical safety and efficacy of the Company’s products from them and their patients (video testimonials coordinated with marketing department)

6) Encourage customer service up-sells during customer interactions and refer to the sales department for completion

7) Implement customer reward program, in conjunction with the sales and marketing departments, to reward customers based on a number of different criteria (e.g.: multiple sales to same customer, lead referrals, seminar presentations, webinar presentations, total minutes of use, et cetera)

8) Successfully launch new Products developed by engineering, in conjunction with the engineering team.

A full-time, in-office position at the Company’s headquarters located in midtown Toronto, easily accessible via public transit.

· University education, preferably with an electrical engineering background

· 5+ years of production supervision and customer service experience in the manufacture and service of medical devices

· Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact and build positive relationships proactively with direct reports, senior managers and external subcontractors

· Able to motivate direct reports to meet / exceed their Key Performance Indicators (“**KPI**”)

· Excellent time management skills with an ability to achieve production and customer service performance objectives

* Proficiency in Microsoft suite of products (e.g.: Office, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Ability to accurately estimate objectives, milestones, cost and timing to prioritize and deliver on production and customer service KPIs
* Ability to evaluate and clearly communicate (written and verbal) technology concepts and ideas to direct reports, engineering and senior managers
* Strong oral and written communication skills in the English language
* Ability to learn, remain calm and focus on the timely completion of objectives
* Team player, organized, self-motivated and professional in dealing with direct reports, colleagues and senior managers
* Self-starterwith the ability to work independently under minimal supervision
* Ability toprioritize in multi-tasking environment with excellent attention to detail and accuracy
* Flexible and accountable working in a team environment
* Positive, “**Can-Do**” attitude, with a strong belief in personal accountability
* Strive to constantly improve and develop skills both personally and in assisting their direct reports and colleagues to do the same
* Hard working, lead by example manager

**Responsibilities:**

Direct supervision of production employees (engineers, technologists and technicians) in the manufacture and service of Theralase® Cool Laser Therapy (“**CLT**”) and medical laser systems (“**Products**”) for both the Drug and Device Divisions; including: incoming inspection, supplier and sub-contractor procurement and supervision, scheduling, manufacture, calibration, final test, quality control test, quality assurance, labelling, packaging, storage, sterilization, shipping and delivery

* Customer service of all Theralase® Products; including: verbal, written and digital communication with customers or potential customers regarding the purchase, performance, maintenance, operation, technical training, repair (both in and out of warranty), costing of repair per finance guidelines, replacement and/or delivery
* Document the interaction with the customer through the completion of a CSI and e-mails
* Forward the CSI to the responsible direct report and track the timely closure of the CSI with that direct report

* Verbal, written or digital communication with customers or potential customers regarding the purchase, performance, maintenance, training, service and/or status of their Product

* Work with the marketing department to optimize the web site from a customer perspective providing additional information, FAQs and web chat access, on-line to enhance the customer’s ability to quickly and effectively resolve their concerns, in real time
* Provide the FAQ documentation monthly to marketing for them to update the corporate website
