Title: Vice President, Finance & Business Operations
Description:
CONTEXT
  
At Make-A-Wish® Canada, we’re redefining how the world perceives wishes through our transformative new brand platform: Wishes Are Medicine. Grounded in research, this platform recognizes what we’ve long known to be true — that wishes have measurable healing power. When prescribed alongside medical treatment, wishes reduce stress, elevate endorphins, limit emergency room visits, and deliver lasting health benefits.
  
With more than 3,500 children still waiting and a new child diagnosed with a critical illness in Canada every two hours, our mission has never been more urgent — and there are many more prescriptions to fill.
  
To meet this challenge, we’ve launched our new three-year strategic plan — Wishes Are Medicine: One Team, One Mission — focused intentionally on financial sustainability, mission impact, and operational excellence. When a child is facing a critical illness, a wish isn’t just a moment of joy — it’s a medically supported turning point. Studies show that children who receive a wish are 2.5 times less likely to have unplanned hospital visits and 1.9 times less likely to need the ER, with 100% of physicians agreeing that a wish can be a pivotal moment in treatment.
  
At Make-A-Wish Canada, you can play a lead role in bringing these powerful prescriptions to life. Where Wishes Are Medicine, transformation becomes a pathway to healing at scale — and this role is your opportunity to architect that future.
  
Our ambition to reach more children and families requires a strong financial and operational foundation. As Vice President, Finance & Business Operations, you will help shape that foundation, bringing strategic leadership to financial planning, investments, risk, governance and the services that enable our organization to thrive. You will turn insight into action, strengthen how resources are invested and managed, and help build a more resilient, disciplined and mission-driven organization.
  
At Make-A-Wish Canada, you’ll join a team united by a shared mission and an unwavering sense of possibility. Every role — whether advancing fundraising, brand, operations, or technology — helps fuel the same trajectory: transforming how hope and healing come to life for children and families nationwide. If you’re ready to help build a future where every eligible child receives the wish that helps them heal, we invite you to read on.
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We’re seeking a Vice President, Finance & Business Operations, a strategic and forward-thinking leader who will help shape the next chapter of Make-A-Wish Canada. This is more than a finance role; it’s an opportunity to strengthen the financial and operational foundation that will enable our mission to grow sustainably.
  
As a key member of our Senior Leadership Team, and reporting to the Senior Vice President, Transformation & Operations, you will bring together financial strategy, business operations, analytics, risk and governance to strengthen how we plan, invest and make decisions. You’ll provide the insight and discipline to steward our resources responsibly, improve organizational performance, and build the capabilities needed to support sustainable growth and greater mission impact.
  
If you bring financial acumen, business curiosity and enterprise thinking, and believe the strongest organizations pair ambition with discipline, this is your opportunity to help build the foundation from which our mission can grow and bring the power of Wishes Are Medicine to more children and families across Canada.
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
**Shape Financial Strategy:** Lead budgeting, forecasting, multi-year financial planning, and financial modelling. Translate insights into scenarios and recommendations that guide sustainable, mission-aligned decisions over a three-to-five-year time horizon.
  
**Steward Assets and Investments:** Oversee financial assets, treasury, and investment portfolio performance in accordance with policy, ensuring disciplined stewardship and informed decision-making.
  
**Strengthen Governance and Reporting:** Provide clear financial reporting to the Board of Directors and Senior Leadership Team, support the Finance & Audit Committee, and ensure sound governance, audit readiness, and compliance with CRA and other regulatory obligations.
  
**Advance Enterprise Risk Management:** Maintain the enterprise risk register, strengthen internal controls, and lead business continuity and disaster recovery planning to protect the organization’s assets, reputation, and long-term sustainability.
  
**Modernize Financial Capability:** Build stronger modelling, analytics, systems, and processes that improve forecasting, performance visibility, operational efficiency, and organizational decision-making.
  
**Lead Business Services:** Oversee property management, leases, contracts, insurance, and related business services. Balance operational efficiency and financial sustainability with investments in organizational capability and a safe, supportive workplace.
  
**Oversee Gift and Donation Administration:** Ensure sound systems and processes for restricted giving, endowments, estates, and other complex giving structures, coordinating closely with development teams to support stewardship and compliance.
  
**Advise and Partner:** Serve as a trusted advisor to the Senior Vice President, Transformation & Operations, the CEO, and leadership colleagues on finance, risk, and business operations. Bring an enterprise lens to strategic planning and execution.
  
**Guide and Develop Talent:** Build, coach, and lead a high-performing Finance and Business Operations team, creating clarity, accountability, collaboration, and opportunities for growth.
  
**Champion One Team Leadership:** Model One Mission, One Team leadership by working across functions and geographies, breaking down silos, celebrating collective wins, and leading with empathy, inclusion, accountability, and purpose.
  
**Represent the Mission:** Act as a visible and trusted ambassador with auditors, advisors, donors, partners, community leaders, and other stakeholders, supporting the Foundation’s presence and mission across Canada.
  
  
WHAT YOU BRING
  
You’re a strategic finance leader who pairs sound technical judgment with business curiosity and a hands-on approach. You move with ease between long-term vision and operational detail, helping leaders see the story behind the numbers and make bold, disciplined choices that bring the power of wishes to more children.
  
**Proven Financial Leadership:** 10+ years of progressive leadership in nonprofit financial management, with a track record of stewarding complex budgets, investments, assets, and financial operations in service of a bigger mission.
  
**Strategic Insight:** Demonstrated strength in financial planning, forecasting, scenario analysis, and investment and treasury management, building the modelling capability that connects strategy, data, and execution.
  
**Strong Credentials:** A CPA designation, supported by a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field, equipping you to lead with rigour and credibility.
  
**Governance and Compliance Expertise:** Advanced knowledge of nonprofit financial management, CRA requirements, GAAP, audits, internal controls, insurance, and board and committee governance — the discipline that protects trust in our mission.
  
**Enterprise Risk and Business Operations Excellence:** Experience in enterprise risk management, business continuity, procurement, contracts, property, insurance, and service delivery across a national or multi-site organization, building a resilient foundation for growth.
  
**Gift Administration Knowledge:** Experience overseeing restricted giving, endowments, estates, and other complex donation structures, with a deep understanding of donor stewardship and the financial processing that honours every gift.
  
**Collaborative People Leadership:** A track record of recruiting, coaching, and developing multidisciplinary teams, building trust across functions and rallying people around shared goals.
  
**Clear and Credible Communication:** The ability to turn complex financial and risk information into practical insight for executives, board members, auditors, volunteers, donors, and cross-functional partners.
  
**Inspiring, Values-Driven Leadership:** Deep alignment with our mission and a commitment to responsible stewardship, inclusion, and collaboration — a spirit that motivates teams, breaks down silos, and creates life-changing experiences for children and families facing critical illnesses.
  
HOW TO APPLY
  
If everything you’ve read so far sounds like you, we encourage you to apply. Please visit the Make-A-Wish Canada candidate portal for current posting details and the application deadline.
  
Make-A-Wish Canada provides equal opportunity in employment and encourages applications from all qualified candidates. Reasonable accommodations due to disability are available on request at any stage of the hiring process.
  
OUR COMMITMENT TO IDEA
  
Make-A-Wish Canada is committed to Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Access (IDEA). We believe it is essential to our mission that we build a diverse, balanced, and vibrant workforce that reflects the communities we serve and seek to serve. Research has shown that candidates from underrepresented groups often apply only when they feel 100% qualified. Even if you do not see yourself fully reflected in every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
  
RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  
Once applications are reviewed, shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Our typical process includes a phone screen, two interview rounds, reference checking, an offer, and a criminal background check for the successful candidate. We thank all applicants for their interest in working with us.

Title: Senior Techno-Functional Lead – Trade Finance Systems (Eximbills)
Description:
**Job title:**
Senior Techno-Functional Lead – Trade Finance Systems (Eximbills)

**Client**
: One of the Banks in KSA

**Location:**
Saudi Arabia

**Experience:**
10–15+ years in banking IT, of which 7+ years hands-on with Eximbills

**Employment type:**
Full-time, on-site

Must-have qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or Finance.
* 7+ years hands-on with
  **Eximbills Enterprise (EE) and Customer Enterprise (CE)**
  : configuration, customization and support, from either the vendor/implementation side or a bank’s IT team.
* At least one full Eximbills implementation, migration or major upgrade delivered to go-live.
* Deep knowledge of trade finance products and ICC rules (UCP 600, ISBP, URDG 758, URC 522).
* Strong SWIFT trade messaging knowledge (MT7xx, MT4xx, MT798).
* Integration experience: MQ, ESB, web services/APIs, file interfaces with core banking.
* Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
* Working knowledge of Java/J2EE and application servers (WebSphere/WebLogic) used by Eximbills.
* Full SDLC ownership: BRD, FSD, SIT, UAT, go-live and post-production support.
* GCC banking experience.

**Functional and business partnering**

1. Act as the trade finance subject-matter expert for Transaction Banking, Trade Operations, Compliance and Credit.
2. Run requirement workshops and write BRDs, FSDs, user stories and process flows for import/export LCs, standby LCs, guarantees (LGs), documentary collections, bills discounting, trade loans and shipping guarantees.
3. Design and support Shariah-compliant trade products (e.g., Murabaha-based import financing) with the Shariah and product teams.
4. Translate ICC rules (UCP 600, ISBP 821, eUCP, URDG 758, URC 522, URR 725, ISP98) and SAMA requirements into system rules, checks and workflows.

**Technical and platform ownership**

1. Own Eximbills EE/CE configuration and customization: products, workflows, fee and charge setup, limits, accounting entries, advices and reports.
2. Design and govern integrations between Eximbills and core banking, limits/credit, GL, customer and corporate channels, SWIFT, sanctions screening and AML, and document/workflow systems, using MQ, ESB (e.g., IBM IIB/ACE), REST/SOAP APIs and batch file interfaces.
3. Own SWIFT trade messaging: MT7xx (LC/guarantee), MT4xx (collections), MT798 corporate-to-bank, and related MT/MX payment messages, including annual SWIFT Standards Release impact and ISO 20022 readiness.
4. Write and review Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for data fixes, reconciliations, MIS and regulatory reporting; tune performance.
5. Lead version upgrades, patches and environment builds (DEV, SIT, UAT, pre-prod, prod, DR) with infrastructure and the vendor.
6. Evaluate and help deliver roadmap items: Eximbills Microservices/cloud, digital trade, supply chain finance platform integration, trade-based money laundering (TBML) controls, vessel and shipment checks.

Title: Customer Success Manager - Finance/Accounting
Description:
**Join Teleperformance – Where Excellence Meets Opportunity!**

Teleperformance is a leading provider of customer experience management, offering premier omnichannel support to top global companies. Our diverse service locations, including on-site and work-at-home programs, ensure flexibility and broad reach.

Join Teleperformance, where our world-class workforce and innovative solutions drive success. Experience a workplace that values your development, supports your goals, and celebrates your accomplishments.

**Job Description**

**About Us**

TP is a worldwide leader in client experience management, digital business services, and strategic contact center outsourcing. With more than 500,000 employees globally, TP combines high-performing on-site infrastructure with cutting-edge remote delivery models, providing support across 300 languages and dialects. Consistently recognized in Fortune Magazine's Top 25 World's Best Workplaces in partnership with Great Place to Work®, TP empowers enterprise technology partners to scale strategic go-to-market and partner success operations seamlessly across premier global markets.

**Our Work Culture**

At TP, we remain true to our core values of integrity, respect, professionalism, innovation, and commitment:

* **Autonomous:** We encourage and trust your independent judgment to prioritize high-leverage interventions across your portfolio.
* **Progressive Work Environment:** Clear vertical and horizontal growth pathways backed by structured coaching and tier-readiness programs.
* **Flexible & Impact-Driven:** We emphasize tangible outcomes, commercial retention, and partner health over activity volume.
* **Innovative:** Every idea matters—we empower operators to build new 0-to-1 playbooks and optimize operational workflows.
* **Inclusive:** A collaborative global culture where diverse perspectives are celebrated and everyone wins together.

**About the job**

As a Partner Customer Success Manager (PCSM), you are the dedicated post-sales commercial owner and strategic platform advisor for a high-value portfolio of 150–250 accounting firms, bookkeepers, and fractional CFOs. Within our partner GTM model, this segment represents highly defensible recurring revenue and the foundation of end-client subscription adoption. In this role, you protect the partner book against competitor migration, accelerate multi-product adoption (including Core Accounting, Payroll, Payments, Expense Management, Time, and Accountant Suites), and empower advisory firms to scale their practices efficiently.  
  
You operate through a proven Scaled Success motion—pairing an annual scheduled value cadence with real-time, signal-triggered 1:1 interventions and digital 1:many leverage. This is a high-impact role combining consultative account stewardship, data-driven prioritization, and authentic domain credibility.

*Competitive annual base salary, 60,000 Annual CAD, commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive performance-based incentive programs tied to portfolio retention, expansion ARR, and partner health metrics with an annual OTE of up to 10%.*

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

The Partner Customer Success Manager executes across four strategic pillars to drive partner health, revenue retention, and ecosystem expansion:

* **Scaled Portfolio Management & Cadence:** Own and manage a designated portfolio of 150–250 accounting, bookkeeping, and advisory firms as their primary post-sales point of contact; execute structured annual value reviews supported by automated mid-year health check-ins.
* **Signal-Triggered Rapid Intervention:** Monitor CRM health metrics, engagement indicators, and platform telemetry in real time; proactively intervene 1:1 whenever risk triggers fire (e.g., stalled client onboarding, platform usage drops, or competitor migration signals).
* **Revenue Defense & Churn Prevention:** Protect whole-book partner relationships to prevent silent attrition of entire underlying client subscriptions, developing proactive recovery playbooks for accounts showing disengagement or decline.
* **Client Book Migration & Multi-Product Attach:** Partner with firm principals to migrate additional client books onto the cloud platform; drive organic expansion and cross-sell across ecosystem solutions including Payroll, Payments, Corporate Cards/Expense Management, Bill Pay, and Accountant Suites.
* **Practice Onboarding & Tier Progression:** Lead structured onboarding from initial introduction to accelerate time-to-first-value; coach accounting professionals through certification programs (e.g., ProAdvisor) and tier progression milestones.
* **Campaign Targeting & Digital Leverage:** Deploy pre-built expansion toolkits, educational webinars, and digital 1:many campaigns targeted at qualifying client segments across the portfolio to drive self-serve adoption.
* **Dedicated Partner Escalation Route:** Serve as the trusted, authoritative single point of contact for complex partner operational inquiries; coordinate with Technical Support, Approvals/KYB, and Risk teams to deliver industry-leading response resolution.
* **Voice of the Partner Channel:** Act as internal partner champion by surfacing recurring workflow bottlenecks, data-mapping gaps, and product enhancements directly to Product, Engineering, and RevOps leadership.

**Job Requirements (Minimum skills and technical requirements)**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree, College diploma, or equivalent professional experience.
* **Experience:** 1+ years in Customer Success, Partner Success, Account Management, or B2B Client Engagement within B2B SaaS, FinTech, or Cloud software (candidates with 1+ years in a high-volume, scaled CS motion demonstrating exceptional commercial results are strongly considered).
* **Domain Knowledge:** Demonstrated working understanding of accounting and bookkeeping fundamentals, compliance workflows, and practice management operations.
* **Portfolio Management at Scale:** Proven track record managing a large book of business (150+ accounts) using smart prioritization, automated triggers, and digital leverage rather than unsustainable blanket high-touch.
* **Commercial Track Record:** Demonstrated success in driving product adoption, expanding recurring revenue (ARR/NRR), and safeguarding retention within a matrixed enterprise organization.
* **Tooling & Data Literacy:** Proficiency with enterprise CRM and CS tooling (Salesforce, ChurnZero, Gainsight) and analytics platforms; adept at interpreting health scores, telemetry data, and task queues to guide daily outreach.
* **Bilingual Communication preferred (Canada Hires):** Exceptional professional verbal and written communication skills in both English and French (minimum CEFR C1 proficiency required).

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Balances consultative advocacy with strong commercial instincts to identify cross-sell opportunities, run business reviews, and articulate ROI to firm owners.
* **Data-Driven Prioritization:** Ability to filter signal from noise across large datasets to invest high-touch effort where it drives maximum retention and growth impact.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Skilled at motivating external partner principals to adopt new workflows while coordinating internal cross-functional partners (Sales, Product, Support, Approvals) to resolve blockers.
* **Accountability & Resilience:** Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ownership over commercial outcomes; maintains composure, focus, and empathy under high-volume demands.
* **Adaptive & Solution-Oriented Communication:** Smoothly transitions between strategic advisory conversations with firm leaders and practical, technical workflow troubleshooting with operational staff.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Accounting Certifications:** Foundational qualification in accounting or bookkeeping (e.g., CPA, CA, CFA, ACCA, ICB, CIPP) or official ProAdvisor certification.
* **Platform Experience:** Hands-on experience with QuickBooks, Float, Xero, or comparable financial management, spend management, and ERP software ecosystems.
* **Scaled CS Methodology:** Direct experience in pooled, digital-first, or automated customer success delivery models within global BPO or high-growth tech environments.

**Benefits & Perks**

  

* Structured career advancement pathways supported by self-assessments, virtual training, and guided leadership curriculum.
* Comprehensive paid 4-week product and onboarding training, plus generous paid annual leave.
* Continuous professional learning through progressive, tenure-specific certification and enablement programs.
* Competitive base salary complemented by performance-based incentive and quarterly reward structures.
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, plus Employee and Family Assistance Programs (EFAP).
* Vibrant, collaborative workplace with dedicated Rewards & Recognition celebrations.

**Schedule**

Fixed schedule: Monday to Friday, 9-hour shift (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM local time). No weekend or overnight rotations required.

**Location**

Toronto Office (75 Eglinton Ave East, Toronto) – Onsite

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

TP is home to a global family with diverse backgrounds, cultures, and lived experiences. We embrace diversity and never discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other protected grounds.  
  
Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: We may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI) tools, to assist with candidate sourcing, resume evaluation, and interview scheduling. These tools augment our recruitment team and do not replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made thoughtfully by our recruitment and leadership teams in full alignment with human rights and privacy legislation.  
  
Accessibility & Accommodations: Teleperformance welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all stages of the assessment and interview process.

**Be One of Our People:**  
It is our mission to always provide an environment where our employees feel valued, inspired, and supported, so that they can bring their best selves to work every day. We believe that when employees are happy and healthy, they are more productive, creative, and engaged. We are committed to providing a workplace that is conducive to happiness and a healthy work-life balance. We also believe that to be our best selves, we need to be surrounded by people who are positive, supportive, and challenging. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion and diversity, where everyone feels welcome and valued. Teleperformance is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Director of Food and Beverage
Description:
**Lead the Hospitality Experience at the Golf Club at Rio Vista!**

Monarch Grill, located at the Golf Club at Rio Vista, is seeking an experienced, energetic, and hospitality-driven Food & Beverage Director to lead our food and beverage operations and elevate the overall club experience.

The Golf Club at Rio Vista is more than a place to play golf. It's a gathering place for golfers, members, families, local residents, and visitors. From everyday dining and casual gatherings to weddings, tournaments, and special events, we strive to create memorable experiences and build lasting community connections.

We are looking for a leader who understands that great hospitality goes beyond the plate. It's about building relationships, developing people, creating exceptional experiences, and contributing to the success of the entire club.

If you are passionate about hospitality, inspired by the golf industry, and ready to make a difference, we invite you to join our team.

**THE ROLE**

The Food & Beverage Director will oversee the Monarch Grill and the club's food and beverage experience, creating an inviting environment for golfers, guests, and the Rio Vista community.

We are looking for a hands-on leader who understands that successful club hospitality is about more than serving great food. It's about building relationships, developing a great team, supporting golf operations, and creating an atmosphere that brings people back.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Foster Teamwork, Cohesiveness & Positive Image**

* Conduct departmental and attend management meetings as needed.
* Promote teamwork, employee development, and a positive work environment.
* Encourage cross-promotion of food, beverage, and golf services.
* Motivate, coach, and support employees in delivering excellent service.

**Promote Financial Stability**

* Oversee all food and beverage operations, including restaurants, bars, snack bars, beverage carts, catering, and events, ensuring quality service and standards.
* Recruit, hire, train, schedule, supervise, and evaluate staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws.
* Collaborate with the Chef on menu development, pricing, and dining experiences.
* Manage budgets, purchasing, inventory, labor costs, payroll, and financial reporting to maximize profitability.
* Coordinate banquets, special events, and room rentals.
* Drive revenue through marketing, promotions, special events, and sales opportunities.
* Maintain member and guest satisfaction by addressing concerns, gathering feedback, and improving service.
* Lead membership activities and maintain open communication with members.

Title: Marketing Operations Manager
Description:
Deep Knowledge Group · MarTech Department · Reports to the Head of MarTech

**The role**
------------

Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech websites and platforms. Today the website tracking, the application analytics, the CRM and the campaign reports each work on their own. You will connect them: set up tracking, run the analytics and CRM systems, and make sure enquiries and reports reach the people who act on them.

**What you will own**
---------------------

### **Tracking and measurement**

* Create and run the company’s Google tag / GA4 account, install tags across Wix, custom-HTML and application sites, and remove the legacy tags that would double-fire.
* Verify sites in Search Console, submit sitemaps and keep reporting access working.
* Implement advertising pixels and conversion events with consent handling.
* Test that events actually arrive, with source, consent and duplicate checks, and keep a coverage record per site.

### **Analytics platform (PostHog)**

* Define a small shared event set, source and campaign fields, and how an anonymous visitor becomes a known contact.
* Run PostHog: projects, access, cost, identity handoff between domains, and event-based dashboards that update without manual spreadsheets.

### **CRM and automation (HubSpot)**

* Map form submissions, sources and outcomes into CRM contacts, with duplicate handling.
* Repair and maintain inbound email classification and routing, so every actionable enquiry reaches a named owner.
* Build audience segments with clear entry, exit and suppression rules, and run one follow-up workflow with the BisDev team.

### **Reporting and process**

* Keep dashboards labelled with data freshness and alert on collection failures.
* Document the setup so another person can run it: procedures, event definitions and a record of every automation and its owner.

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* Weeks 1–4: take over the new Google tag account, verify the priority sites in Search Console, and record a baseline of what tracks and what doesn’t.
* Weeks 5–8: agree the event and identity rules, and install tracking on the pilot sites in a way that survives page changes.
* Weeks 9–13: connect forms to the CRM, fix enquiry routing, and publish the first automatically updated dashboard.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, marketing analytics or a similar hands-on role.
* Hands-on with Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Search Console, including consent and debugging.
* Experience with a CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot (we also have Zoho in use), including forms, workflows and routing.
* Experience with an event analytics tool such as PostHog, Mixpanel or Amplitude, including user identity.
* Comfortable reading page source and network requests to confirm that tracking works.
* You write clearly and document what you build.

### **Helpful**

* Experience with Wix and custom or application sites, and Cloudflare.
* Server-side tracking or conversion APIs.
* Basic SQL or scripting.
* Experience with GDPR or similar consent rules.
* Fluent Russian.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Web development: page templates, the scheduled checking worker and site fixes belong to a web engineer.
* Content and SEO writing, which belongs to the editor.
* Commercial follow-up, which BisDev owns. You build the routing and fields; they run the conversations.

**How you will work**
---------------------

You will work with the Head of MarTech, the web operations specialist (forms, publishing and web edits), the BisDev team, Front-end and Product. Tools include Google Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console, PostHog, HubSpot, Slack and Google Workspace. Working hours are flexible, with overlap with UK time (our team works roughly 8:00–18:00 UK).

Description:
**Procurement Manager**

**About SIS Pitches**

SIS Pitches is a leading international provider of sports surfaces, delivering world-class football, rugby, hockey, cricket, and multi-sport facilities across global markets. Our expertise spans the complete project lifecycle, including design, manufacturing, construction, surfacing, installation, and long-term maintenance of natural, hybrid, and synthetic turf systems.

As we continue to expand internationally, we are seeking a highly experienced Procurement Manager to lead our global sourcing and procurement activities, ensuring the highest quality materials and services are secured at the most competitive commercial terms.

**Position Summary**

The Procurement Manager is a senior leadership position responsible for developing and executing procurement strategies that support SIS Pitches' global operations. The role requires exceptional negotiation skills, commercial acumen, supplier management expertise, and a strong focus on cost optimization without compromising quality, performance, safety, or project timelines.

The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing and securing the best-value products, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and services from international markets while building strategic supplier relationships that contribute to the company's long-term success.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Procurement & Sourcing**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Source high-quality materials, products, equipment, and services for sports pitch construction and maintenance projects in Saudi Arabia.
* Identify and evaluate new suppliers, manufacturers, and strategic partners globally.
* Continuously assess market conditions, industry developments, and pricing trends to maximize procurement efficiencies.
* Establish and maintain approved supplier frameworks and preferred vendor agreements.

**Supplier Management**

* Build and manage strong relationships with key suppliers and manufacturers.
* Conduct supplier performance evaluations covering quality, pricing, delivery performance, sustainability, and reliability.
* Negotiate long-term supply agreements that secure favourable commercial terms and mitigate supply chain risks.
* Lead supplier audits and due diligence processes where required.

**Contract Negotiation**

* Lead high-value procurement negotiations for materials, equipment, logistics, and subcontracted services.
* Secure the best combination of cost, quality, warranty, service support, and delivery schedules.
* Review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts and commercial agreements.
* Ensure all contracts comply with company policies and legal requirements.

**Cost Management & Value Engineering**

* Deliver measurable cost savings across all procurement categories.
* Drive value engineering initiatives to improve product performance while reducing overall project costs.
* Analyse total cost of ownership rather than simply focusing on purchase price.
* Prepare procurement budgets and cost forecasts for major projects.

**Supply Chain Management**

* Manage procurement schedules in line with project delivery requirements.
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks and disruptions.

* Experience supporting, heavy industrial or multidisciplinary scopes; power generation, energy, mining or infrastructure experience preferred.
* Diploma or degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Construction Management, Engineering or a related discipline is an asset.
* **CRSP, NCSO or equivalent professional safety designation** considered an asset.
* Strong leadership, communication and coaching skills with the ability to influence employees, field leadership, subcontractors and clients.
* Ability to work on project sites and travel within Ontario is required. #LI-IS1

* Regular, reliable attendance
* Work productively and meet deadlines timely
* Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment
* Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies.
* Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required.

Title: Director - Health, Safety and Worker Welfare Operations (RD 4)
Description:
Lead the development and implementation of health, safety, environmental and worker welfare governance across City Operations, translating enterprise requirements into operational standards, contractual requirements and assurance activities for City Operations-managed assets and services. Oversee compliance, audits, incident learning and corrective action, support the City Command Unit during incidents, and ensure operational readiness and safe transition of assets into live operations.

**Health, Safety and Worker Welfare Governance**

* Lead the development and implementation of City Operations health, safety and worker welfare governance, translating Strategic Delivery Unit (SDU) policies, standards and guidelines and applicable legal requirements into operational procedures.
* Establish City Operations minimum requirements and contractual schedules for health, safety and worker welfare, ensuring service providers and contractors understand the standards against which their performance will be assured.
* Maintain and improve the health, safety and worker welfare framework as the city asset base, services and workforce expand.
* Define induction, training and competency requirements for City Operations employees and relevant service providers.

**Operational Compliance and Assurance**

* Direct the risk-based assurance programme across City Operations-managed assets, public realm and operational services, covering compliance reviews, inspections, audits and follow-up activities.
* Monitor contractor, operator and service-provider compliance, directing corrective action through the relevant contract and service owners.
* Track performance through incident data, risk registers, permit-to-work compliance, regulatory reporting, leading indicators and corrective-action status.
* Report material risks, non-conformances, trends and overdue actions to leadership, escalating issues affecting people, public safety, compliance or Qiddiya’s reputation.
* Stop unsafe work within the City Operations remit where required and coordinate formal corrective action through the accountable contract holder.

**Worker Welfare Operations**

* Lead oversight of worker welfare conditions for employees and contracted workforces within the City Operations remit, recognising the public-facing nature of operational workers.
* Establish and monitor welfare requirements covering working conditions, welfare facilities, access to support and applicable Saudi labour and welfare requirements.
* Coordinate with workplace, accommodation, contractor and service-provider teams to address welfare risks and escalate unresolved issues.
* Build internal worker welfare capability through recruitment, development and knowledge transfer.

**Environmental Compliance**

* Oversee environmental compliance across City Operations-managed assets, public spaces and service arrangements, focusing on prevention of harm and compliance with approved environmental management plans.
* Establish requirements for pollution prevention and control, including oil and chemical storage, waste handling, noise and nuisance.
* Monitor contractors and service providers against environmental requirements, ensuring incidents, non-conformances and corrective actions are tracked to closure.
* Coordinate environmental reporting and relevant Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) inputs while maintaining the distinction between environmental compliance and broader

sustainability ownership.

**Incident Management and Operational Resilience**

* Provide health, safety, environmental and worker welfare subject-matter expertise to the City Command Unit during incidents, crises and emergency exercises.
* Support the Gold, Silver and Bronze response structure by advising on technical risks, immediate controls, regulatory requirements and recovery actions.
* Develop, maintain and test relevant crisis playbooks in alignment with City Command Unit and Operational Resilience requirements.
* Lead or oversee post-incident and near-miss investigations within the remit, ensuring root causes, lessons learned and preventive actions are embedded.

**Asset Readiness and Handover**

* Define health, safety, environmental and worker welfare requirements for new assets and services entering City Operations, engaging with delivery teams from design through handover.
* Lead readiness reviews from the agreed pre-handover period, validating operational requirements, documentation, controls and service arrangements before go-live.
* Provide functional sign-off and readiness input for handover and takeover processes, escalating unresolved risks through stage-gate and governance forums.
* Work with City Assets Management and delivery teams to transfer defects, risks, warranties, procedures and assurance findings into live operations.

**Stakeholder and Regulatory Coordination**

* Act as the City Operations focal point for health, safety, environmental and worker welfare matters with SDU, City Assets Management, delivery teams, operational functions and central QIC stakeholders.
* Coordinate with contract holders and service providers to embed requirements into scopes of work, mobilization plans, procedures and performance reviews.
* Support engagement with relevant regulators, authorities and emergency-response stakeholders, ensuring submissions, observations and actions are coordinated and closed out.
* Maintain constructive relationships while preserving the professional judgement required to challenge unsafe or non-compliant practices.

**Capability, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead development of the Health, Safety and Worker Welfare team in line with the phased asset handover plan.
* Establish dashboards and management information combining lagging and leading indicators to identify emerging risks and guide improvement.
* Review assurance findings, incident trends and operational feedback to improve standards, contracts, procedures and service-provider performance.
* Promote a proactive culture while ensuring accountability remains with the teams and providers delivering the work.

 **Requirements**

**Required:** Bachelor’s degree in Health and Safety, Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Health, Environmental Management, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred:** Master’s degree in Health and Safety, Environmental Management, Engineering, Public Health, Business Administration, or a related field.

Professional certifications or memberships with recognized health and safety, environmental, worker welfare, emergency management or related professional institutes are preferred; Chartered or equivalent professional standing is preferred.

A minimum of 10-12 years of experience in health and safety, occupational health and safety, environmental compliance, worker welfare, operational assurance or related fields is required, including relevant experience in a leadership role.

Demonstrated experience leading health, safety and worker welfare governance and assurance across complex operational, infrastructure, development or asset environments, including establishing standards and contractual requirements; overseeing contractor compliance; leading audits, inspections, investigations and corrective actions; supporting asset readiness and handover; advising on incident and crisis response; and coordinating with delivery teams, asset owners, regulators and public authorities. Experience across the asset lifecycle and in the Middle East is preferred.

Title: Regional Sales Manager - Cross Border Trading & Imported Building Material

You can read more about BRKZ's latest news on Forbes, TechCrunch & Wamda.

  

**Job Summary:**
----------------

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven **Regional Sales Manager – Cross-Border (X-Border)** to lead and scale our international sales operations for imported building materials with extended lead times. The ideal candidate will combine deep regional market expertise with strong commercial leadership, excelling at navigating cross-border trade dynamics, managing client expectations around shipping durations, and structuring advance payment terms. This role requires a proactive leader who can build high-performing regional channels, align closely with Procurement and Logistics teams, and drive revenue growth across key international markets.

**What You will do (Responsibilities) :**
-----------------------------------------

* **Regional Expansion:** Identify, develop, and execute go-to-market strategies to capture new business opportunities across target cross-border territories in the construction and building materials sector.
* **Channel & Key Account Leadership:** Establish, manage, and scale strategic partnerships with major regional retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and contractors.
* **Cross-Border Advisory:** Educate regional partners on the value proposition of imported materials, international lead times, Incoterms, and cross-border logistical considerations.
* **End-to-End Supply Chain Alignment:** Collaborate closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, and Customs/Logistics teams to ensure smooth cross-border transit, accurate shipment tracking, and on-time project delivery.
* **Commercial Proposals & Tenders:** Oversee the preparation and presentation of commercial quotations, regional proposals, product specifications, and samples to high-value accounts.
* **High-Stakes Negotiation:** Negotiate multi-tier pricing, volume commitments, and advance payment terms (including LCs/TT) to maximize regional profitability and market competitiveness.
* **Regional Demand Forecasting:** Partner with Procurement to analyze regional demand signals, optimize inventory allocation, and manage stock levels across markets.
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor regional economic shifts, regulatory/tariff changes, competitor activities, and global pricing fluctuations to adjust commercial strategy proactively.
* **Escalation Management:** Act as the senior point of escalation to resolve complex cross-border customer inquiries, customs delays, or order-related issues efficiently.
* **Executive Reporting:** Track regional sales pipelines, prepare comprehensive market feedback reports, and present actionable territory insights and growth forecasts to senior leadership.

  

**Who You are (Qualifications & Experience) :**
-----------------------------------------------

  

* **Experience:** Minimum 5–8+ years of B2B sales and regional management experience in building materials, construction supplies, or international trade.
* **Cross-Border Expertise:** Strong working knowledge of international trade regulations, Incoterms, import/export logistics, customs clearance, and cross-border supply chain management.
* **Lead-Time Mastery:** Proven track record of managing extended shipping lead times and aligning client expectations on large-scale or complex orders.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Demonstrated success in high-value B2B negotiations, structuring advance payment terms, and managing multi-country distributor networks.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Arabic.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) or Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides), alongside CRM and pipeline reporting tools.
* **Leadership & Autonomy:** Entrepreneurial, target-driven, and capable of operating independently to build out new territories from the ground up.
* **Mobility:** Willingness and ability to travel frequently across the region for key client meetings, trade shows, and site visits.

Title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
Canonical is hiring exceptional Sales Operations leaders and experienced analysts to grow and manage our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. Our Sales Operations teams analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.
  
  
You will partner with Canonical’s executive team across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal and provide a focal point to drive improvements. This position requires leadership, initiative and an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to drive continuous improvements in processes, systems, governance and data quality. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and the opportunity to design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
  
  
**Location:**
*These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA, Americas regions.*
The role entails
  
  

* Delivering precise, scalable revenue operations for business through direct, indirect or online channels
* Leading and developing a team of revenue operations analysts in developing policies, driving processes and providing daily operational support and enablement to sales teams and partners
* Driving Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement/Data Enrichment, Customer Relationship Management, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
* Instrumenting, measuring and improving policies and processes across teams covering the entire revenue operations spectrum
* Delivering metrics and reporting to monitor and improve revenue operations effectiveness, including new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals.
* Using data to drive insight, manage territories and channels, improve productivity, and agree and implement actionable change with executive management through regular sales and business reviews.
* Overseeing our sales technology and processes, driving automation and process improvements and partnering with our commercial systems engineering team to continuously improve business systems and integration
* Leading the introduction of new products, pricing, packaging and bundling through systems that are easy for sales and partners to navigate and quote
* Driving data quality, through order processing, new hire training, process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
* Leading and enhancing our commercial review process for evaluating and steering sales and alliance opportunities
* Owning the commission plan and leading the process for setting goals, evaluating and paying against that plan

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* Experience operating in a leadership Revenue Operations role, driving effectiveness of direct, channel and alliance partnerships
* Data-driven and analytical approach with a high attention to detail
* Track record of providing insight through robust CRM and other Revenue Operations technology platforms, data, analytics, compensation systems and processes to deliver excellent revenue operations
* An energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, a problem solver with skill in measuring, identifying and delivering systems and processes that ensure repeatable, scalable outcomes
* Comfort with commercial pressure, and the ability to put revenue teams under appropriate performance pressure
* Organisational skills and the ability to interact and work with stakeholders within all levels of the organisation
* Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
* Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills
* Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
* Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills
  
  

* Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
* Deep understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including driving a team based remotely in multiple time zones
* Experience in mentoring and coaching team members on technical and soft skills, directly contributing to their professional development and performance improvement.

What Canonical offers
  
  
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
*We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.*

Title: Store Manager - Qatar

GMG is a global well-being company retailing, distributing and manufacturing a portfolio of leading international and home-grown brands across sport, everyday goods, health and beauty, properties and logistics sectors. Under the ownership and management of the Baker family for over 45 years, GMG is a valued partner of choice for the world's most successful and respected brands in the well-being sector. **Core Responsibilities:**

* Communicate store targets to the team and drive sales to achieve financial objectives
* Maintain loss prevention standards and ensure compliance with cash handling, fraud and theft controls
* Oversee all point-of-sale activity: transactions, customer orders and payments, returns and refunds, inventory updates and customer feedback

* Analyze sales reports to maximize stock potential and report on new and core collection performance
* Maintain window and in-store displays to a high standard in line with merchandising guidelines
* Oversee inventory management: stock availability, ordering, back-store management, stock movement, stock ageing, stock loss and space management
* Coordinate with the facilities team on repairs and replacements and support maintenance standards to extend asset life
* Plan staffing levels, schedules and shift coverage, factoring in seasonal peaks and promotional events
* Train the team in inventory techniques, including receiving, stocking, restocking, transfers and resolving discrepancies

* Set clear objectives and performance targets with team members, aligned to organizational goals
* Mentor, guide and coach the team to build skills, operational efficiency and continuous improvement
* Apply structured performance management to monitor progress, troubleshoot issues and deliver periodic KPIs
* Give regular feedback and build a results-oriented environment that supports individual and team growth
* Develop leadership pipelines and succession plans within the team
* Take ownership and accountability for personal and team outcomes, making timely, sound decisions
* Lead the team through change with agility, resilience and a problem-solving mindset
* Collaborate with the Area Manager, Brand/Category Management, Warehousing and Logistics, Visual Merchandising and Marketing teams

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline
* 5-7 years of relevant experience, with at least 3 years in a similar supervisory role in retail operations
* Fluent English, written and spoken; Russian and/or Arabic is an added advantage
* Industry expertise and product/category knowledge
* Strong customer orientation
* Proficiency in MS Office and tools
* Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to influence and align teams to business goals

Title: Manager, Supply Chain EP
Description:
**What we do-**

Aspen is a technology leader in sustainability and electrification solutions. The Company's aerogel technology enables its customers and partners to achieve their own objectives around the global megatrends of resource efficiency, e-mobility, and clean energy. Aspen's PyroThin® products enable solutions to thermal runaway challenges within the electric vehicle ("EV") market. The Company's Cryogel® and Pyrogel® products are valued by the world's largest energy infrastructure companies. Aspen's strategy is to partner with world-class industry leaders to leverage its Aerogel Technology Platform® into additional high-value markets. Aspen is headquartered in Northborough, Mass.

**What we value-**

At Aspen, our values reflect who we are and how we work both with each other and our customers, suppliers, and communities. They shape our interactions, guide our decisions, and inspire us to bring our best. Whether collaborating internally or externally, our values drive us to make a meaningful impact within Aspen and in all our relationships.

**Aspen’s CORE Values**

We Do the Right Thing

We are Problem Solvers

We are Allies

We Drive Forward

**What you will do-**

The Supply Chain Manager owns the EP site supply chain from the approved demand plan through material procurement, production scheduling, inventory control, warehousing and delivery. The role serves external customers and internal Aspen receiving plants, including Monterrey where applicable, with reliable supply, accurate inventory and competitive total cost. Scope includes raw materials, chemicals, packaging, work in process, finished goods, trial materials and assigned maintenance supplies.

The manager converts demand into executable plans, prevents material shortages, controls working capital and leads disciplined ERP transactions. Success requires visible floor leadership, clear accountability and verified improvement in Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost. Corporate Supply Chain retains enterprise sourcing governance; Operations executes production; Quality controls product disposition and release.

  

**How will you do it-**

Safety and operational discipline

* Lead safe receiving, storage, material handling and shipping. Conduct routine floor reviews, verify training and corrective actions, and stop unsafe activity. Apply approved chemical storage, segregation and handling controls with EHS.

Integrated planning and production scheduling

* Own the EP supply plan within sales, inventory and operations planning (SIOP). Reconcile customer orders, interplant demand, forecasts and inventory with approved capacity, staffing, maintenance downtime, yield and Quality release lead times.
* Maintain a rolling 13-week constrained production and material plan aligned with the longer-range SIOP outlook. Agree frozen and flexible scheduling horizons with Operations; control changes and communicate their service, cost and inventory effects.
* Translate the plan into daily production schedules and material requirements. Review shortages and schedule adherence daily; escalate gaps with recovery dates, alternatives, named owners and customer impact.

Materials and inventory ownership

* Set item-level planning policies, safety stocks, reorder points, order quantities and lead times using demand variability, replenishment risk, shelf life and criticality. Cover both MRP and non-MRP materials, consumables and critical spares with Maintenance.
* Own inventory accuracy by item, lot, location, quantity, unit of measure and status. Maintain risk-based cycle counts, controlled physical inventories and timely root-cause correction. Reconcile inventory discrepancies with Finance without masking errors through unsupported adjustments.
* Control receiving, put-away, line replenishment, returns, work-in-process transfers, finished goods and trial inventory. Enforce FIFO or FEFO as appropriate; protect product, lot traceability and segregation of held, rejected, expired or obsolete stock.
* Run monthly inventory reviews with Finance, Quality and Operations. Reduce excess, slow-moving and obsolete stock through approved consumption, return or disposition plans. Protect service and continuity when reducing working capital.

ERP transactions and master data

* Act as the site supply chain process owner for the ERP currently deployed at EP. Establish standard work, role-based training, auditable transactions and exception dashboards; coordinate system changes and access controls with IT.
* Post receipts, issues, transfers, returns and completed production promptly. Reconcile material consumption, output, scrap and variances with Production and Finance. Drive accurate work-order closure, including a daily aging review and month-end reconciliation.
* Govern purchasing and planning parameters, location data, units of measure and inventory status. Validate BOM, routing and yield data with Engineering and Operations, who retain technical approval. Use approved changes and testing before changing system logic.

Supplier execution and continuity

* Own site purchasing execution within delegated authority, including requisition conversion, purchase-order accuracy, confirmations, expediting and invoice discrepancy resolution. Work with Corporate Supply Chain on supplier selection, commercial agreements and total landed cost.
* Maintain supplier delivery and capacity scorecards. Escalate recurring misses with corrective actions and verified recovery. Coordinate supplier quality problems with Quality and commercial escalation with Corporate Supply Chain.
* Maintain a critical-material risk register covering single sources, supplier capacity, lead times, transportation and shelf life. Develop tested contingencies and qualified alternate sources with Corporate Supply Chain, Engineering and Quality; define readiness milestones and accountable owners.

Warehousing logistics and customer fulfillment

* Lead receiving, warehouse and shipping operations across site shifts and assigned storage locations. Plan labor, layout, storage capacity, equipment, housekeeping and material flow to minimize handling, damage and delays.
* Own shipment readiness and execution for released product. Verify quantities, lot identity, packaging, labeling, customer instructions and documentation; measure movement from production to the designated warehouse against an agreed service time.
* Coordinate domestic, international and interplant freight with approved providers and trade-compliance specialists. Confirm responsibilities for customs documentation, shipping terms, transit protection and proof of delivery before dispatch.
* Manage freight service and total landed cost within corporate agreements. Control premium freight approvals and reason codes; recover eligible claims and prevent recurring expedite costs. Maintain shipment visibility and notify Customer Service promptly of delivery risks.
* Coordinate returns with Customer Service and Quality, ensuring authorization, traceability, segregation and approved disposition. Reconcile customer and interplant discrepancies through documented corrective actions.

Financial performance and continuous improvement

* Prepare and control the supply chain operating budget, covering labor, freight, warehousing and assigned services. Review actuals and forecast monthly; explain variances and deliver corrective actions.
* Deliver measurable improvements in inventory, transaction accuracy, lead time, freight and labor productivity. Use Lean and structured root-cause methods. Obtain Finance validation of realized savings and distinguish recurring savings from working capital release.
* Lead daily execution reviews, weekly supply-risk and service reviews, and monthly SIOP, inventory and budget reviews. Every missed target requires a cause, action owner, due date and verification of effectiveness.

Decision authority and functional boundaries

* Approve schedules, replenishment settings, staffing deployment, orders and logistics decisions within the approved plan, budget and authority matrix. Escalate decisions outside those limits before committing funds or changing delivery commitments.
* Block movement or dispatch when safety, inventory identity, required documentation or product status is uncertain. Quality authorizes product acceptance, release and disposition; EHS and designated technical owners retain process-safety responsibilities.
* Request inventory adjustments with documented evidence and independent approval. Maintain separation between purchasing, receiving, adjustment approval and payment; Finance owns accounting policy and reserve decisions.
* Perform other related duties assigned by management that are consistent with the role and approved functional responsibilities.

Performance measures

The following are proposed starting targets, not established EP results or certified industry benchmarks. Confirm baselines and definitions within 30 days and agree phased targets with the Site Leader and Finance. Apply the same service rules to external and interplant customers; show results separately.

KPI Definition’s and Proposed Target:

* Customer OTIF - Orders delivered on time and in full ÷ orders due, using the original agreed date and quantity. Target 100% monthly; record approved changes separately.
* Material availability - Production hours lost to unavailable required materials. Target zero preventable hours; log every event, cause and recovery.
* Schedule adherence - Work orders completed within the agreed window and quantity ÷ work orders due under the frozen schedule. Shared with Operations; target 95% weekly. Report changes separately.
* Inventory accuracy - Exact-match item/lot/location/quantity/status records ÷ records counted. Target 99.5% monthly and 100% for designated critical stock; also report gross absolute value variance.
* Inventory investment - Days of inventory = average inventory at cost ÷ trailing 90-day daily cost of goods sold. Proposed 12-month goal: reduce 10% from approved baseline without service loss; track aged stock separately.
* Supplier delivery - Purchase-order lines received by the agreed required date and in full ÷ lines due. Target 98% monthly; no retrospective date changes to improve results.
* Transaction timeliness - Receipts and transfers posted within 24 hours; completed work orders accurately closed within 24 hours of final required sign-off. Target 95% for each; 100% by Finance close cutoff.
* Supply chain cost - Controllable spend within approved volume-adjusted budget. Proposed six-month goal: reduce avoidable premium freight 50% from the first 90-day baseline; Finance validates realized savings.

Monitor safety observations and action closure, training completion, traceability exceptions, forecast error and bias, warehouse transfer time, shipping errors and improvement-action closure as supporting measures. Never trade safety or product conformity for a cost or delivery target.

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

Direct Reports Include-

Planning, Materials, Warehouse, and Logistics leads; site buyer(s) where assigned.

Lead the assigned planning, purchasing execution, materials, warehouse and logistics team in accordance with company policies. Responsibilities include selection, onboarding, training, staffing by shift, work assignment, coaching, performance evaluation and succession planning. Define responsibilities, maintain a skills matrix and provide cross-training for critical tasks. Address performance gaps promptly and verify that standard work is followed on the floor.

  

**Why you are right for the job-**

Education and experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and demonstrated experience.
* At least 8 years of manufacturing supply chain experience, including 3 years leading teams, with responsibility for planning, materials, inventory, warehousing and logistics.
* Demonstrated delivery, inventory, working capital and cost improvements, including transaction discipline and supply recovery during disruption.
* Experience supporting multiple shifts, internal and external customers, and international flows. Chemical, advanced materials or automotive manufacturing experience preferred.

Technical skills

* Strong capability in SIOP, production scheduling, MRP, capacity planning and inventory policy. Understand how variability, yield, scrap, downtime and shelf life affect supply plans.
* Hands-on proficiency with a manufacturing ERP, including inventory transactions, work orders, planning parameters and exception reporting. Oracle Cloud or Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience preferred; proficiency with the system deployed at EP is required after onboarding.
* Advanced Excel, operational dashboard and analytical skills. Ability to reconcile records with Finance and diagnose master-data and transaction failures.
* Working knowledge of purchasing, supplier recovery, freight, landed cost, warehouse controls, traceability and shipping documentation; experience with trade-compliance specialists.
* Knowledge of applicable quality, environmental and customer requirements. Automotive and IATF knowledge preferred where relevant; confirm applicability for EP.

Title: Senior Manager Supply Chain, MENA
Description:
**For A Better You**  
  
At iHerb, we believe that living a healthy and balanced life should be easy and accessible to everyone. As a team member, we’ll empower you to live this promise each day as you make a truly global impact in your career.

In an industry that is constantly evolving, we are on a mission to make an impact on the global market, and the individual and collaborative efforts of our people are paramount to helping us succeed.  
  
Whether you work in one of our logistics centers, technology hubs, corporate offices or even from home, your role at iHerb will take you beyond what’s expected, turning challenge into change. If you're ready for it, we want you to join our team. Get started now.

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager, MENA Supply Chain is the single-threaded owner of end-to-end logistics performance and build-out across the Middle East and North Africa region, with initial focus on the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). This role designs, launches, and scales the regional logistics network, ensuring best-in-class cost, service, and delivery speed.

Operating as a core member of the regional leadership team, this role is the primary partner to the COO in-region. It translates global logistics strategy into scalable, high-performing operations and shapes key decisions based on regional realities, including cross-border customs flows, Arabic labeling, cash on delivery, and seasonal demand peaks such as Ramadan, Eid, and White Friday.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, and team building during a critical scale-up phase.

**Job Expectations:**

### **Build and Own the MENA Supply Chain Setup**

  

* Lead the end-to-end setup of the MENA logistics network, including selection of the regional hub (for example a free zone warehouse in Dubai) and the set-up of an Arabic and bilingual labeling solution in the MENA warehouse.
* Define the flow model for the region: import and consolidation at the hub, in-country distribution, and cross-border linehaul to the other GCC markets and, over time, the wider MENA region.
* Ensure the initial setup is scalable, cost-efficient, and operationally robust.
* Ensure logistics is a proactive enabler of growth, not a constraint.

### **End-to-End Performance Ownership**

  

* Own regional logistics KPIs across (i) cost (transport, warehousing, handling, customs duties and fees), (ii) service levels (OTIF, delivery promise accuracy, first-attempt delivery, cash on delivery remittance accuracy), and (iii) speed (lead times, delivery SLAs by country and city tier).
* Drive trade-off decisions across transportation, warehousing, and inventory, including air versus sea inbound and hub versus in-country stock placement.
* Plan capacity and inventory for regional demand peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) and for summer heat constraints on temperature-sensitive products.
* Establish full visibility and control over performance drivers.

### **Strategic Partner to COO (Regional Translation and Feedback Loop)**

  

* Act as the go-to logistics counterpart to the COO in MENA.
* Translate global strategy into executable regional plans.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on (i) market constraints, (ii) performance gaps, and (iii) optimization opportunities.
* Proactively challenge and refine global assumptions based on MENA realities, such as address quality, last-mile variability, and payment preferences.

### **Customs, Compliance and Regulatory Coordination**

  

* Drive cross-functional coordination to ensure MENA regulatory requirements are met across logistics operations, including product registration and import approvals with the relevant authorities in each market (for example SFDA in Saudi Arabia and the competent health and standards authorities in the UAE), GCC and country-level customs procedures, and halal and conformity requirements where applicable.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Marketing, customs brokers, and external partners on Arabic labeling, documentation (certificates of origin, attestations, import permits), and market-specific requirements.
* Translate compliance needs into operational execution across warehouses, 3PLs, customs brokers, and distribution flows, including free zone and mainland transfers and the GCC customs transit process.
* Identify risks and dependencies, such as shipment holds, registration delays, and duty classification disputes, and drive resolution across stakeholders.

### **Team Build and Leadership**

  

* Act as logistics representative within the regional leadership team.
* Lead a lean, high-performing regional logistics team, including a 3PL /Warehouse Manager, a Transportation and Customs Manager, and an Inventory Planner, with the ability to build a multi-cultural team across the region.
* Coach the team on carrier, 3PL, and customs broker strategy and execution, and collaborate with global to ensure global strategy and guardrails are followed.

### **Continuous Optimization and Scale**

  

* Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements early.
* Optimize network design (warehouse footprint, in-country versus hub stock, routing, inventory placement), including the timing of a second node, for example in Saudi Arabia, as volumes grow.
* Optimize last-mile and cash on delivery operations, including carrier mix, delivery success rates, and returns handling.
* Lead regional logistics projects (process improvements, system enhancements).

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Required:

* Proven experience building or scaling logistics operations (warehouse, transport, and inventory) in the region.
* Strong hands-on experience with 3PLs, carrier networks, customs brokers, and multi-country GCC distribution, including cross-border trucking and free zone operations.
* Working knowledge of GCC customs procedures and import requirements for regulated consumer products (health, food, personal care).
* Experience with e-commerce last-mile, including cash on delivery and returns, is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and deeply operational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management across global and regional teams, and the cultural fluency to work with partners across different MENA markets.
* Data-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable making trade-offs.
* Fluent English is required. Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Equipment Knowledge:**

  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

**Experience Requirements:**

Generally requires a minimum 10 years in logistics / supply chain, with strong MENA or GCC exposure.

**Travel Requirements:**

The role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with frequent travel to the hub warehouse and port areas (for example Jebel Ali) and regular travel to other markets in the region, in particular Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam).

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related discipline or equivalent additional experience required

**The Position:**  
Reporting to the VP, Finance and Manager, Finance, the Accounting Coordinator will provide day-to-day administrative support to the Operations of the Finance department.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  
Daily Operations
  

* You will process invoices and accounts payable by coding, inputting, and processing investment income tax credits, and uploading transactions to Oracle NetSuite ERP, the accounting software system.
