Title: FPGA Designer
Description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

**Position Overview/Mandate:**

The FPGA Designer plays a key role in designing and delivering complex FPGA-based systems for Fidus clients. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus teams to define architectures, implement RTL, integrate IP, run simulations, close timing, and support lab bring-up and debug.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with new FPGA families and tools, is comfortable moving between different application domains (video, communications, storage, signal processing), and takes pride in producing high-quality, well-documented designs.

**Make an Impact with US:**

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Work with our clients and other Fidus Employees to develop complex FPGA and/or CPLD based systems, including architecture, custom development, integrated IP, simulations, and timing analysis and closure.
* Design FPGA based systems using Xilinx and Intel based devices and tools
* Participate in design reviews (hardware-software interface, input-outputs etc.) to ensure Fidus quality standards and customer requirements are being adhered to
* Perform lab testing, debug of prototypes and supporting hardware/software engineer, as needed
* Perform customer prototype demonstrations and author test plans, design description and user documentation
* Provide technical insight to customers during the pre-sales and implementation phase of projects
* Provide technical support to the Business Manager and Sales team by providing detailed estimates on project scope, schedule, and deliverables and to present the technical aspects of Fidus proposals to the client

**Who You are:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience designing using RTL/Verilog/VHDL on FPGAs.
* Experience with video systems and specification standards, video algorithms, and high-speed memory and bus interfaces, communications protocols, and DSP or processor instantiations.
* Created designs using Xilinx or Altera FPGA families and have a solid understanding of tool flow
* Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus, and/or ModelSim
* RTL design and verification including test benches, functional simulations, and timing closure
* Exhibit strong communication skills, are fluent in English, have great customer interaction presence, and quickly learn new technologies and processes
* Proven techniques and habits that lead to high quality design
* Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit
* Degree as a B.A.Sc., B.Eng. or equivalent
* As AMD Embedded Premier Partner, you will be certified to highest level of FPGA qualification – this will be your first “to-do” item upon joining us.

**Location and travel:** Position is based in Canada. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.

This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates will be required to complete background checks and security screening under Canada's Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and may also be required to obtain a security clearance under the Contract Security Program (CSP) administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC, formerly PWGSC).

This role is an evergreen position.

Annual base salary ranges from $125,000 to $160,000. The final offer within this range takes into account the variations in knowledge, skills, experience, and market conditions, and with consideration to internal equity.

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching GRSP contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

**About Fidus & Why Work Here**

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

Title: Sous Chef
Description:
Position: Sous Chef  
Department: Food Production  
Reports To: Executive Chef / Head Chef  
Location: Plaza Inn Hotel Doha, Qatar  
Hotel Category: 4-Star Hotel

1. Job Purpose

The Sous Chef is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the overall kitchen operations, ensuring high standards of food quality, presentation, hygiene, consistency, and service delivery. The role involves supervising kitchen staff, coordinating daily food production, monitoring food costs, maintaining food safety standards, and ensuring smooth kitchen operations across all hotel outlets and banquet functions.

The Sous Chef must lead by example, maintain discipline within the kitchen team, and ensure that all food is prepared according to the hotel's standards and guest expectations.

2. Key Responsibilities and Duties

A. Kitchen Operations & Food Production

* Assist the Executive Chef in managing and supervising daily kitchen operations.
* Ensure the timely preparation and delivery of food for all hotel outlets, room service, buffet operations, and banquet functions.
* Monitor food preparation, cooking methods, portion sizes, taste, texture, and presentation.
* Ensure all dishes are prepared according to approved recipes and hotel standards.
* Maintain consistency in food quality and presentation across all shifts.
* Coordinate with the Executive Chef regarding daily menus, special promotions, buffet arrangements, and special events.
* Ensure proper mise en place is completed before every meal period and service.
* Monitor food preparation timelines to avoid delays during peak service hours.
* Ensure proper utilization of kitchen equipment, utensils, and ingredients.
* Participate in menu development, recipe standardization, and new dish trials.

B. Staff Supervision & Team Management

* Supervise and coordinate the activities of Chef de Partie, Demi Chef de Partie, Commis Chefs, and kitchen helpers.
* Assign daily duties and responsibilities according to operational requirements.
* Prepare and coordinate kitchen duty schedules in consultation with the Executive Chef.
* Ensure adequate manpower is available during breakfast, lunch, dinner, and banquet operations.
* Conduct daily kitchen briefings and communicate operational instructions to the team.
* Monitor staff punctuality, attendance, grooming, personal hygiene, and discipline.
* Train and develop junior kitchen staff through on-the-job coaching.
* Identify training requirements and recommend suitable development programs.
* Maintain effective communication and teamwork within the kitchen department.
* Report staff performance issues, misconduct, and operational concerns to the Executive Chef.

C. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

* Ensure strict compliance with Qatar food safety regulations and hotel hygiene standards.
* Monitor personal hygiene and grooming standards of all kitchen employees.
* Ensure proper food storage, labeling, dating, and stock rotation using FIFO principles.
* Monitor refrigerator, freezer, and food storage temperatures and maintain temperature records.
* Ensure proper separation of raw and cooked food to prevent cross-contamination.
* Monitor food handling, thawing, cooling, reheating, and holding procedures.
* Ensure all kitchen areas, workstations, equipment, and utensils are cleaned and sanitized regularly.
* Conduct regular hygiene inspections and take corrective action whenever required.
* Ensure expired, spoiled, or contaminated food items are immediately removed and reported.
* Cooperate with the Quality Assurance, Food Safety, and Engineering teams during inspections and maintenance activities.

D. Cost Control & Inventory Management

* Monitor food costs and ensure effective utilization of ingredients.
* Minimize food wastage through proper planning, portion control, and production monitoring.
* Monitor daily kitchen consumption and ensure ingredients are used efficiently.
* Coordinate with the Storekeeper and Purchasing Department regarding stock requirements.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure sufficient ingredients are available for daily operations.
* Ensure proper storage and handling of food items to prevent spoilage and unnecessary losses.
* Monitor portion sizes and ensure compliance with approved standard recipes.
* Assist in conducting monthly kitchen inventory and stock verification.
* Report unusual consumption, wastage, and stock discrepancies to the Executive Chef.
* Ensure that all food requisitions are properly recorded and approved.

E. Menu Planning & Banquet Operations

* Assist the Executive Chef in preparing daily, weekly, and seasonal menus.
* Coordinate food production requirements for conferences, meetings, weddings, and other banquet events.
* Review banquet event orders (BEOs) and ensure all food requirements are communicated to the kitchen team.
* Ensure adequate preparation and manpower arrangements for special events.
* Coordinate with the Banquet and Service teams to ensure smooth food service.
* Assist in preparing special menus for VIP guests, groups, and special dietary requirements.
* Ensure buffet displays are properly arranged, replenished, and maintained throughout service.
* Monitor guest feedback and take corrective action to improve food quality and presentation.

F. Equipment & Maintenance

* Ensure all kitchen equipment and machinery are properly operated and maintained.
* Conduct regular checks of cooking equipment, refrigerators, freezers, and other kitchen facilities.
* Report equipment breakdowns and maintenance requirements to the Engineering Department.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of kitchen tools and utensils.
* Monitor energy and water consumption and avoid unnecessary wastage.
* Ensure all kitchen equipment is switched off safely when not in use, where applicable.

G. Coordination & Communication

* Maintain effective coordination with the Executive Chef, Food & Beverage Manager, Restaurant, Banquet, Stewarding, Purchasing, and Store departments.
* Communicate daily operational requirements and challenges to the Executive Chef.
* Attend departmental meetings and provide updates on kitchen operations.
* Ensure proper handover between kitchen shifts.
* Maintain accurate records of food production, wastage, temperature checks, and other kitchen-related activities.
* Handle guest complaints concerning food quality professionally and report them to the Executive Chef.
* Support other kitchen sections whenever operational requirements demand.

H. Health, Safety & Security

* Ensure compliance with hotel health and safety policies.
* Ensure safe handling and operation of kitchen machinery and equipment.
* Maintain clear and unobstructed kitchen passageways and emergency exits.
* Ensure proper use of personal protective equipment where required.
* Immediately report workplace accidents, injuries, fire hazards, and unsafe working conditions.
* Ensure chemicals and cleaning materials are stored separately from food items.
* Follow emergency procedures and cooperate with the hotel's Health & Safety team.

3. Qualifications & Experience

* Diploma or professional certification in Culinary Arts, Food Production, or a related field.
* Minimum 4–5 years of experience in a professional hotel kitchen.
* At least 1–2 years of experience in a supervisory or senior kitchen position.
* Previous experience in a 4-star or 5-star hotel is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of international cuisine, buffet operations, à la carte service, and banquet production.
* Good understanding of food safety, HACCP principles, and kitchen hygiene standards.
* Knowledge of food costing, inventory management, and portion control.
* Ability to manage kitchen teams and work under pressure.

Title: Systems Engineer-GCGCON

Title: Electrical Engineer
Description:
HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer with demonstrable infrastructure experience to join its client-side Program Management and Construction Management (PMCM) team on a major government land development and infrastructure program in Riyadh. The position is assigned to one development package and provides electrical engineering coverage throughout design review, construction supervision, testing, commissioning and handover.

The Lead Developer and its designers and contractors remain responsible for design, construction and contractual delivery. The PMCM Electrical Engineer reviews and monitors their work, coordinates technical interfaces, records compliance and provides recommendations to the Package Project Manager and Construction Manager, with technical support from the Core Team Senior Electrical Engineer and Senior Telecom Engineer.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Review electrical design submissions at applicable master-planning, concept, detailed-design and issued-for-construction stages, including design criteria, load assessments, calculations, drawings, specifications, equipment schedules and interface documents.
* Review electrical infrastructure including medium- and low-voltage distribution, substations and transformers where within package scope, feeder and cable networks, duct banks, chambers, earthing and bonding, protection, metering, distribution boards, street and public-realm lighting, and associated control systems.
* Review telecommunications infrastructure including duct and conduit routes, manholes and handholes, fibre-optic and other communications cabling, access networks, equipment interfaces, testing requirements and provision for service-provider connections, as applicable to the approved scope.
* Assess design coordination between electrical and telecom systems and roads, drainage, water, irrigation, landscaping, civil structures, existing utilities and public-realm works; identify clashes, constructability constraints and missing interfaces.
* Review Lead Developer technical submittals, shop drawings, material and equipment submissions, method statements, inspection and test plans, RFIs, technical queries and proposed deviations; issue documented technical comments and recommendations through approved workflows.
* Monitor installation and construction of electrical and telecom infrastructure; verify conformity with approved drawings, specifications, quality plans, applicable codes and authority requirements through site inspections and supervision of designated inspectors.
* Coordinate the Electrical Inspector(s) assigned to the package and work with the Construction Manager and other inspectors to prioritize inspections, track deficiencies, verify corrective actions and maintain effective coverage of both disciplines.
* Review and follow up work and material inspection requests, nonconformance reports, punch lists and inspection records, ensuring that unresolved issues are escalated through PMCM quality procedures.
* Coordinate interfaces and required submissions, permits, no-objection certificates, connections, diversions and witnessing with relevant authorities and service providers, including SEC and telecommunications operators, through the Package Interface Specialist.
* Review and witness, as applicable, electrical testing and commissioning (including insulation resistance, continuity, earthing, functional and protection testing) and telecom testing (including duct proving and fibre-optic testing), in accordance with approved procedures and authority requirements.
* Monitor design and construction progress against approved schedules and look-ahead plans; identify critical long-lead equipment, utility connections, technical risks and constraints; contribute to mitigation and recovery recommendations.
* Review as-built records, test results, authority clearances, operation and maintenance documentation, warranties, spare parts, training records and other close-out deliverables; recommend readiness for handover within the PMCM approval process.
* Coordinate routinely with the Core Team Senior Electrical Engineer and Senior Telecom Engineer on complex technical issues, standards, design assurance, cross-package interfaces and matters requiring escalation; prepare technical inputs to package progress reports and meetings.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.
* More than 12 years of relevant professional experience is required for recruitment screening.
* Proven experience in electrical power infrastructure design review AND construction supervision on major infrastructure or land development projects.
* Demonstrated knowledge of electrical distribution networks, substations and transformers where applicable, underground cables, street lighting, earthing, protection, testing and commissioning.
* Demonstrated knowledge of telecom ducts, chambers, fibre-optic networks, network interfaces, service-provider coordination and telecom installation/testing practices.
* Experience in a PMC/PMCM, owner’s engineer or engineering supervision consultant role, including design submittal review, site inspections and multidisciplinary coordination.
* Working knowledge of relevant Saudi regulations and utility/service-provider requirements, applicable IEC and other project-adopted standards, and construction quality and HSE procedures.
* Ability to review engineering calculations, CAD drawings, technical specifications, inspection/test plans and handover documentation; familiarity with Aconex or similar document-control systems.
* Registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE), as required for the appointment.
* Strong written and spoken English, technical reporting, stakeholder coordination and issue-resolution skills; Arabic is an advantage.

Title: Process Coordinator
Description:
Role summary

The Process Coordinator leads AI-led process redesign. The role takes each business process cuts it down to the steps and fields that matter, gets the rules built into Zoho CRM, and replaces manual reports with live, AI-generated dashboards for each department and role.

The goal is simple: people put the right data in the right place at the right time, and AI turns it into decisions. Managers and coordinators should stop building reports and chasing updates by hand.

This is a process and data role, not a training role. The right person reads workflows and Zoho logic, thinks in fields and data, and is comfortable shortening a process and challenging a manager when a step adds no value.

Key responsibilities1. Process redesign

* Map each current process end to end from the CRM field list, the current SOP and how the team actually works.

* Cut steps and fields that do not feed a decision or a report.

* Set one owner and one time limit for every stage.

* Define the blocking rules the CRM must enforce (for example, no case closes without evidence; no paid job closes without an invoice number), each with a logged override.

* Link modules so data flows without re-entry (for example, case to invoice; confirmed deal to PRQ, PO and delivery).

* Write the one-page SOP for each process: stage, owner, time limit, what must exist before moving on, and what is automatic.

* Assign department-specific and role-specific dashboards: what a sales coordinator, a manager, a division manager and a department head each need to see every day.

* Use the dashboards in real-time reviews and daily huddles so discussions run on live data, not on spreadsheets prepared the night before.

* Set up daily exception lists and weekly reports pulled automatically from the CRM and from source documents (SOPs, POs, invoices, PRQs), so nobody types the same data twice.

* Check data quality before trusting a dashboard: blocking rules come before dashboards, because AI on bad data gives confident wrong answers.

* Work with IT to clean up automatic tasks that a CRM rule can replace, and raise on-time completion of tasks.

* Track and report manual reporting hours removed.

* Run the 8-step redesign cycle for each process: AI baseline audit, design, build, pilot, measure, fix, roll out, retire the old way.

* Write clear build requirements for IT (fields, module links, Blueprint rules, automations) and test them before go-live.

* Support DMs and department heads, who own adoption in their teams.

* Prepare and present at the fortnightly Signal review with senior leadership and IT: designs for approval, blockers and numbers against baseline.

Title: Field CISO
Description:
**Onwards Together!**
---------------------

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

**Our Team's Vision:**
----------------------

Illumio is the breach containment company. Built on Zero Trust principles, the Illumio platform combines real-time visibility with segmentation and AI-powered detection and response, helping organizations stop the spread of breaches and ransomware across hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments before they become disasters. Illumio Segmentation contains attackers by stopping lateral movement across the enterprise, and Illumio Insights delivers AI-driven visibility and detection across hybrid cloud environments.

Illumio was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Microsegmentation Solutions, Q3 2026, earning the highest scores in current offering and strategy of any vendor evaluated, and is recognized as a Customers’ Choice in Gartner Peer Insights for Network Security – Microsegmentation. Global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, energy and utilities, government, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications trust Illumio to reduce cyber risk and build resilience.

**Our Values**
==============

Our values reflect how we work together in practice — not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you’ll likely feel at home here.

* **Bring Your Best:** We hold ourselves to a standard of excellence for our customers and each other, regardless of circumstance.
* **Build Trust:** We act with integrity, transparency, and follow-through, earning trust in every interaction.
* **Seek Truth:** We pursue facts over assumptions, stay curious, and remain open to being wrong.
* **Onwards Together:** We move forward as one team, supporting each other through challenges and wins alike.
* **Leverage Differences:** We treat diverse perspectives and backgrounds as a source of strength and better decisions.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Field CISO, Zero Trust Segmentation is a newly created, specialized role within the Global Solutions Engineering team, chartered to deepen Illumio’s credibility and category leadership within the CISO community. This role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community: we are looking for a security executive — a current or former CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security leader — who brings a proven balance of business acumen, technical depth, and operational experience running a security program, rather than a traditional pre-sales background. This is a hybrid role by design: half executive advisor and evangelist, half hands-on architect.

As Field CISO, this person is Illumio’s most credible external voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment — engaging CISOs and CTOs at strategic accounts as a peer, shaping the category narrative with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms), and representing the company at industry events. This person also personally owns the technical backbone of pre-sales for the category: the Use Case Map, demo environments, POC/POV frameworks, and reference architectures that the rest of the global SE team (AMS, EMEA, APAC) builds on.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategic Field Leadership & Evangelism**

* Serve as Illumio’s foremost executive voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment, in the field and in public — conferences, webinars, analyst briefings, and published content.
* Build and maintain analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms) to shape how the category is defined and evaluated in the market.
* Engage CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders directly on the most strategic opportunities, drawing on firsthand operating experience to act as a peer and trusted advisor alongside regional SE leads and AEs.
* Partner with Sales and GTM leadership to shape go-to-market and revenue acceleration strategy.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Product Management to shape positioning, messaging, and roadmap priorities, informed directly by field and firsthand operator signal.

**Technical Architecture & Enablement Ownership**

* Own and continuously evolve the Use Case Map, Demo Runbook, and reference architectures used across the global SE organization.
* Personally design and build flagship demo environments and POC/POV frameworks, including integration patterns and success-criteria templates.
* Partner directly with product engineering to translate roadmap into sellable, demoable capability, and drive pre-sales enablement to sell-ready status and beyond.
* Maintain deep, current hands-on fluency with the Illumio platform — including segmentation, hybrid cloud detection and response, and broader Zero Trust architecture concepts.

**Enterprise Pre-Sales & POC Execution**

* Lead or co-lead the most strategic and complex opportunities globally, engaging directly alongside AMS, EMEA, and APAC SE teams.
* Architect and execute high-stakes POCs/POVs, including technical prerequisites, integration scoping, success-criteria definition, and executive readout.
* Act as the final technical and executive escalation point for deals across regions, ensuring a consistent, credible narrative in front of customers.

**Team Enablement & Capability Building**

* Design and deliver training curriculum and certification paths for the global SE team.
* Build battlecards, FAQs, and RFP response libraries, keeping the team current against an evolving competitive landscape.
* Mentor SE Leads and SEs on segmentation and breach containment concepts, positioning, and objection handling — bringing an operator’s perspective on how real security teams evaluate and adopt these solutions.

**Product & Market Feedback Loop**

* Serve as a structured, credible voice of the field back to Product Management on roadmap priorities, feature gaps, and competitive intelligence.
* Track and analyze the competitive landscape across microsegmentation, Zero Trust, and cloud detection and response, including new entrants and adjacent incumbents extending into the space.

**Required Qualifications**

* Prior experience as a CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security executive (VP/Director of Information Security) is required — this role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community to bring firsthand business, technical, and operational credibility to the field.
* 10+ years of experience leading enterprise security programs, with direct, hands-on exposure to network segmentation, Zero Trust architecture, incident response and breach containment, or cloud security.
* Demonstrated ability to speak credibly to both engineering and executive/board audiences translating technical risk into business terms and back again.
* Demonstrated track record as an external-facing voice: conference speaking, analyst engagement, published thought leadership, or peer-community leadership (e.g., CISO forums, ISACs).
* Proven hands-on architecture and build capability — this is not a strategy-only role; the person must be able to personally build and demo complex technical environments.
* Demonstrated experience engaging CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders, ideally as a former peer, on strategic, multi-stakeholder decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to move fluidly between deep technical detail and executive narrative.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.
* Willingness and ability to travel 30–50% for customer, analyst, and industry engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior title of CISO, Deputy CISO, Field CISO, or VP/Director of Information Security at an enterprise or mid-market organization.
* Direct operational experience running a segmentation, Zero Trust, or breach containment program.
* Experience with microsegmentation, CNAPP, cloud security posture management, or hybrid cloud detection and response tooling.
* Existing relationships with analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, and others) covering network security, Zero Trust, or security operations.
* Experience integrating or building go-to-market plans around a new or acquired product line.
* Published thought leadership — blogs, whitepapers, podcasts, or conference talks — on breach containment, Zero Trust, or cyber resilience.
* Familiarity with the broader Illumio platform: Illumio Segmentation, Illumio Insights, container/Kubernetes segmentation, OT/ICS environments, and hybrid cloud architectures.

**Our Commitment**

Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.*

You will ensure all technical submissions, correspondence, records, reports, and project documentation are properly received, tracked, distributed, archived, and retrieved in accordance with the project's procedures, the Service Order requirements, and best industry practices (including EDMS/Aconex). Your role is essential for maintaining project compliance, supporting timely technical reviews, and facilitating successful project handover.

Responsibilities:

Our newest opportunity is for a talented Document Controller to join our team, based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

We envisage success in this role to include;

* Establishing and maintaining a comprehensive Document Control System for the duration of the project, including the construction phase and 12-month Defects Liability Period.
* Implementing and managing the use of the approved Electronic Document Management System (EDMS – e.g., Aconex or equivalent) for all project documentation.

* Preparing and issuing formal transmittals and maintaining accurate records of all communications.
* Supporting the team in the preparation and compilation of Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Reports.

* Preparing document control metrics and reports as required by the Senior Project Manager/Project Director.
* Archiving all project records in a structured, secure, and indexed manner at project close-out.
* Providing training and guidance to the supervision team on document control procedures and EDMS usage.
* Coordinating with discipline leads (Construction Managers, Inspectors, HSE, etc.) to ensure timely review and response to submissions.

Qualifications:

To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 5 years work experience partnered with a Diploma or Bachelor degree in Business Administration.

**This position is for KSA Nationals only.**

* **Experience:** Minimum **5 years** of relevant Document Control experience on major construction projects (as per Service Order requirements),
* Proven experience with EDMS platforms (Aconex, SharePoint, or equivalent).
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC contracts and construction project documentation workflows.

**Key Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (Arabic is an advantage).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and EDMS software.
* Ability to work independently and manage high volumes of documentation under pressure.

KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.

Title: Business Information Security Officer, Audit & Assurance
Description:
Overview:

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

KPMG Canada is seeking an experienced professional to fulfill the role of Business Information Security Officer (BISO), Audit & Assurance. This role reports to the Firm’s Chief Information Security Officer and operates within the Audit Business Unit, serving as the primary liaison between the central security function and the business.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine client-facing security advisory experience with technology risk and controls expertise, supporting Audit delivery and transformation, including the secure adoption of AI-enabled solutions. KPMG Canada’s Digital Security Group is responsible for governing and overseeing the Firm’s data and information security program.

The BISO will collaborate with Audit, ITS, Risk, Privacy, and Technology teams to assess cybersecurity risks, respond to client security requirements, and apply practical security controls The individual will provide security recommendations that reflect business needs, compliance and regulatory requirements, document and track identified risks, and obtain necessary risk and security approvals.

The ideal candidate brings experience in a large, complex, multi-jurisdictional organization and can explain technology, data flows, and security controls clearly to internal teams and clients. Strong knowledge of application lifecycle practices, security architecture, cloud platforms, Generative AI, API security, and application security standards such as OWASP, along with familiarity with frameworks such as ISO 42001, will support success in this role.

What you will do:

* Serve as the primary information security liaison between Audit and the Digital Security Group, being the first point of contact for client security questions
* Develop a thorough understanding of Audit applications and their security controls, data processing, and data locations, and explain these clearly to internal teams and clients
* Support reviews of security-related client contract conditions in collaboration with the appropriate Risk, Privacy, Legal, and Technology stakeholders

* Translate Firm security policies, procedures, and standards into practical, risk-based controls for the Business Unit technology ecosystem
* Proactively unblock and manage security, risk, and compliance issues by bringing together Audit, ITS, Risk, Security stakeholders, driving decisions, tracking actions, and ensuring issues are worked through to a clear and timely end state
* Monitor compliance with KPMG security policies, standards, and control requirements; identify non-compliance, initiate remediation actions, and track exceptions through formal risk acceptance processes with appropriate compensating controls
* Act as the BU key point of contact to understand security risks related to evolving business requirements for technology and solutions, and apply security-by-design principles to provide proactive, business-focused, guidance aligned with Firm’s security policies and standards
* In coordination with Platform Security team, assess and review business-requested software, tools, and AI capabilities (including SaaS and Generative AI solutions) for security, privacy, and compliance risks; lead intake, risk evaluation, and provide delegated approval or whitelisting where necessary
* Collaborate with Project, Technology, Business, and Risk teams to gather requirements and support the Security Assessment Review (SAR) process, led by Platform Security

* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure security requirements are documented and tracked throughout the project lifecycle

Governance

* Maintain a strong understanding of KPMG security policies (e.g., GISP, AUP, ATO), requirements, and guidance from the CISO, Risk Management Partner, and Office of the General Counsel
* Maintain and validate a comprehensive inventory of business applications, tools, and technology assets (on-premises and cloud), ensuring alignment with Firm security standards
* Coordinate implementation and onboarding of new security programs and capabilities as directed by the CISO
* Contribute to annual business planning processes and recommend initiatives to enhance security posture and operational efficiency
* Represent the business unit and provide key metrics in monthly security governance forums

Vulnerability Management and Incident Response

* Own BU–level vulnerability management, including identification, prioritization, and remediation tracking across applications, endpoints, and cloud environments (including CSPM)
* Partner with Technology teams to drive timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities
* Manage responses to security incidents following KPMG’s incident management processes
* Represent the business unit in SEV1 incident response bridges

Monitoring

* Monitor adherence to KPMG security policies and standards
* Review compliance reports generated by security tools and address identified issues
* Perform regular reviews of installed applications to identify prohibited software and initiate remediation actions
* Maintain an accurate and up-to-date inventory of business applications (on-premises and cloud environments including Azure, AWS, and GCP)
* Monitor control effectiveness across all technology assets within the business unit

What you bring to this role:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security or a related field, or equivalent experience·
* 10+ years of experience in application, technology, or solution design, architecture, development, and implementation
* 5+ years of experience in secure design/architecture and project risk assessments across modern cloud and on-premises environments, including SaaS solutions
* 5+ years of experience as a security practitioner in a leadership role
* Experience in large, complex, multi-jurisdictional organizations, including technology environments with data and systems distributed across locations and jurisdictions
* Deep understanding of modern application development ecosystems, open systems, Generative AI, and emerging technologies
* Strong knowledge of information security standards and frameworks (e.g., CSA CCM, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53) and data protection principles
* Experience evaluating modern AI tools and capabilities and applying practical security guardrails to emerging technology and transformation initiatives

Title: Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)
Description:

**Platform & Reliability Engineering**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building one of the region's most ambitious e-commerce platforms: high-traffic, multi-region, and engineered for scale. Our platform — around fifteen backend services, a web storefront and native mobile apps — handles thousands of orders every day, and every one of them depends on infrastructure that is fast, observable, and always on.

*This is a founding role for our DevOps & SRE function. You will move our platform off a managed commerce PaaS onto infrastructure we own, set the reliability bar for every engineering squad, and build the team that keeps it there.*

**ABOUT THE FUNCTION**

DevOps & SRE sits at the centre of Lulu's e-commerce engineering. We own the platform every squad ships on: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data stores, networking, security and observability. We run on-call and incident response, define SLOs with product squads, and make sure peak sales events are boring. Over the next 12–18 months our biggest goal is migrating our workloads from a vendor-managed platform onto our own cloud footprint. We are deliberately keeping the team lean and AI-first: we expect AI agents and assistants to take on a large share of the toil — writing infrastructure-as-code and pipelines, triaging alerts, drafting runbooks and postmortems — so a small team can run a large platform.

**Core ownership:**
Cloud infrastructure & Kubernetes, CI/CD & release engineering, observability stack, data-store operations, on-call & incident management, platform migration

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

* Lead the migration of our e-commerce platform from a vendor-managed PaaS onto our own cloud infrastructure: discovery, target architecture, migration waves, cutover and decommissioning
* Design and run production Kubernetes for ~15 Python/Django services (DRF, Celery workers and beat), a Next.js storefront and supporting APIs, with Helm and GitOps-based delivery
* Operate and scale the stateful core of the platform: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — HA, backups, point-in-time recovery, upgrades and capacity planning
* Build an open-source observability stack across metrics, logs, traces and profiles (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) that every squad uses day to day
* Define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product squads for checkout, order management, delivery promise and storefront APIs, and alert on what customers actually feel
* Modernise CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines: build and release standards, progressive delivery (canary, blue-green), automated rollbacks and idempotent release scripts
* Codify everything as infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including networking, IAM, secrets management and environment provisioning
* Prepare the platform for peak events — load testing, autoscaling, capacity reviews and game days — so sale days run without incident
* Run incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive the reliability fixes that come out of them
* Own cloud cost visibility and optimisation (FinOps), making sure we spend where it buys reliability or speed

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Scope & Impact**

* Own multi-quarter, multi-team infrastructure and reliability goals, with the migration programme as the headline deliverable
* Make independent technical decisions on open-ended problems — build vs buy, managed vs self-hosted, which tool and when — grounded in business context and cost
* Drive cross-team initiatives across backend, frontend, mobile and data squads, optimising for the platform as a whole rather than any one team

**Technical Craft**

* Design infrastructure that meets its reliability, security and cost objectives and stays simple enough for a small team to run
* Debug non-deterministic production issues across the stack — kernel, network, container runtime, database, application — that escape less experienced engineers
* Automate toil relentlessly; treat runbooks, dashboards and alerts as code that is reviewed, versioned and tested
* Identify and retire technical risk early: single points of failure, untested backups, unpatched dependencies, end-of-life runtimes
* Champion an AI-first engineering culture — use AI tools and assistants to speed up infrastructure work, incident analysis and documentation

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Build the DevOps & SRE function: define its charter, roadmap and operating model, and how it works with product squads (platform-as-a-product, paved roads, self-service)
* Hire, coach and grow DevOps and SRE engineers; set the hiring bar and run interview loops for the function
* Keep the team lean by design — build automation and AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate the whole platform, and measure the efficiency gains they deliver
* Design a sustainable on-call rotation with clear escalation paths, severity levels, incident command roles and stakeholder communication
* Establish reliability practices across engineering: SLO reviews, production-readiness reviews, postmortem culture, change management and DR drills
* Measure and report engineering health with DORA metrics, SLO attainment and cost dashboards; present them to engineering and business leadership
* Manage vendor relationships and infrastructure budget, and make the case for investment with data
* Act as a Culture Leader — partner with engineering leadership to set the tone, foster psychological safety and champion inclusive practices

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These are non-negotiable. We need engineers who can hit the ground running with our stack and ways of working.

* 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading or acting as technical lead for an infrastructure or reliability team
* Expert-level Kubernetes in production — cluster design, networking, ingress, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler), upgrades and troubleshooting
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable): VPC design, IAM, load balancing, managed databases and cost optimisation
* Strong infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux)
* Set up end-to-end observability and monitoring from scratch using open-source tools — metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), logs (Loki or ELK/OpenSearch), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with Tempo or Jaeger) and error tracking (self-hosted Sentry) — covering infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, queues and application code, with dashboards, alert routing and on-call integration that teams rely on
* Practical SRE experience: defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, symptom-based alerting, incident command and blameless postmortems
* CI/CD expertise (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) with deployment strategies such as canary and blue-green
* Strong Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, CDN, load balancers) and scripting skills in Python, Go or Bash — able to read and debug Python/Django application code
* Experience running Python web services and async workers (Celery or similar) in production, ideally in e-commerce, retail or other high-traffic consumer platforms

**NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These will set you apart and accelerate your impact, but aren't required on day one.

* Hands-on leadership of at least one production migration between cloud providers (e.g. AWS to GCP, Azure to AWS) or from a managed PaaS to self-managed infrastructure — planning, data migration, cutover and rollback
* Proven experience migrating stateful systems with minimal downtime: PostgreSQL (logical replication, CDC), Kafka (MirrorMaker 2), Elasticsearch (snapshot/restore, reindexing) and Redis
* Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi), PostgreSQL operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, Patroni) and the Elastic operator (ECK)
* Long-term metrics storage and scale-out observability: Thanos, Mimir or VictoriaMetrics; continuous profiling with Pyroscope; self-hosted Sentry
* Platform security and supply chain: HashiCorp Vault or External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper, Falco, image signing and SBOMs
* Chaos engineering and load testing with LitmusChaos or Chaos Mesh, and k6 or Locust
* Cost tooling and FinOps practice: OpenCost or Kubecost, rightsizing, committed-use and spot strategies
* Building an internal developer platform or portal (e.g. Backstage) for service templates and self-service environments
* Familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Pub/Sub) and supporting data-platform workloads
* Certifications such as CKA/CKS, Google Professional Cloud Architect or DevOps Engineer, or AWS DevOps Professional
* Public contributions: conference talks, technical blog posts or open-source maintainership

**TECH STACK**

Python 3.9–3.12 (Django, DRF), Celery, Next.js / React, React Native

This role offers the opportunity to:  
Build reliable, production-ready systems and services that turn ideas into scalable solutions  
Ship engineering work that directly influences business strategy and customer outcomes  
Collaborate with leading global organizations across industries  
Apply the latest advancements in AI and software engineering to solve problems at scale

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

Understand User Requirements

Partners with appropriate stakeholders (e.g., project manager, technical lead) to determine user requirements for a set of scenarios. Leverages a variety of feedback channels to incorporate insights into future designs or solution fixes. Leads incorporation of appropriate continuous feedback loops measuring customer value, usage patterns, and other actionable metrics of value. Begins to determine additional critical metrics.

Design

Leads efforts and discussions for the architecture of aspects of products/solutions (e.g., design, cost). Creates proposals for architecture and design documents and leads testing of hypotheses and proposed solutions. Shares and acts on findings from investigations, owns design decisions, and oversees the other team members. Leads the development of design documents for designs or User Stories and determines the technology that will be leveraged and how they will interact. Leads design discussions with the team and shares findings/learnings from investigations, holding ownership for design decisions. Leads efforts to assure system architecture meets security and compliance requirements and expectations.

Independently creates and mentors' others for a clear and articulated plan for testing and assuring the quality of solutions, and defines success for outcomes of tests (e.g., unit tests). Identifies needs for a broad versus selected approach in testing mechanisms and makes informed decisions to implement the most effective tests. Leads efforts to add new tests, remove antiquated tests, and aggregate tests to improve the overall test suite. Improves recommendations to the team and augments test cases to ensure that solutions have good test coverage. Leads efforts to continually integrate automation features when planning for testing.

Leads identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service or platform. Leads identification of other teams and technologies that will be leveraged, how they will interact, and when one's own system may provide support to others. Leads efforts to determine back-end dependencies associated with product, application, service, or platform functionality for the solution/product. Demonstrates deep understanding of up and downstream effects of solutions and work provided to ensure appropriate security and performance, driving reliability in the solutions, and optimize dependency chains and retrieves across teams. Identifies areas of dependency and overlap with other teams or team members and drives coordination. Enables cross team communications and resolves conflicts between teams.

Coding

Leads by example and mentors' others to produce extensible and maintainable code used across products. Leads efforts to optimize, debug, refactor, and reuse code to improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI). Identifies best practices and coding patterns and provides deep expertise in the coding and validation strategy. Creates and applies metrics to drive the quality and stability of code, as well as appropriate coding patterns and best practices.

Leads efforts to apply knowledge of debugging tools, logs, telemetry, and other methods, and leads verification of assumptions through writing and developing code proactively before issues occur and reactively as issues occur across products. Leverages minimal telemetry data, triangulates issues, and resolves with minimal iterations. Leads retrospective debugging of solutions to identify root causes of problems.

Reviews the code of a product to assure it meets the team's and Microsoft’s quality standards, is reliable and accurate, and is appropriate for the scale of the product/solution area. Applies feedback to current and future iterations. Participates in code reviews to ensure coding standards are followed. Considers diagnosability, reliability, and maintainability when reviewing code, and understands when code is ready to be shared or delivered. Applies and screens for coding patterns and best practices in reviews and provides feedback on code to drive adherence to best practices.

Title: Facility Coordinator
Description:
**Who we are**

At Namaa, we build and operate tech-enabled urban infrastructure that gives consumers fast, reliable access to meals, groceries, and everyday essentials.

Traditional retail models, built around brick-and-mortar locations, often struggle to compete in today's digital-first landscape. Challenges such as cost efficiency per square foot, logistics-optimized locations, and seamless technology integration have made it clear that a new approach is needed.

We believe the future of foodservice and commerce lies in purpose-built infrastructure designed for speed, accuracy, and scalability. That's why Namaa was established—to power the next generation of digital food and quick commerce ecosystems across the Middle East.

Our ecosystem is driven by a portfolio of specialized business units, including **KitchenPark**, **CloudRetail**, and **Profood Properties**, each playing a key role in enabling brands to grow and thrive in an increasingly on-demand world.

  

**About the role**

We are seeking an organized and hands-on Facility Coordinator to support the Facility Manager in running the day-to-day maintenance of our Riyadh facilities. The role receives and prioritizes work orders, schedules technicians and vendors, tracks preventive maintenance, keeps compliance records up to date, and reports on performance. It is the first point of contact for site teams and restaurant partners on anything maintenance-related.

  

**What you'll do**

* Receive, log, prioritize, and dispatch work orders from site operations teams and restaurant brands through the CMMS / ticketing system.
* Schedule and coordinate the daily work of facility technicians and external vendors across Riyadh sites.
* Track the preventive maintenance calendar (HVAC, kitchen exhaust, gas, firefighting, fire alarm, electrical, plumbing) and flag overdue items to the Facility Manager.
* Coordinate vendor visits: raise purchase requests, confirm scope and quotes, supervise access and completion, and verify invoices against work done.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, permits, Civil Defense certificates, warranties, service logs, and equipment manuals.
* Manage the spare parts inventory and consumables: stock levels, reorders, and tracking of usage by site.
* Conduct site walk-throughs and basic inspections, and report hazards or defects.
* Follow up on open work orders until closure and keep requesters informed on status.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on work orders, PM completion, response times, vendor performance, and costs.
* Support the Facility Manager with budget tracking, incident documentation, and audit preparation.
* Support new-site openings and handovers (snag lists, asset tagging, documentation).

  

**What we're looking for**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or a related engineering / facilities field.
* 1-3 years of experience in facilities coordination, maintenance planning, or a building-services role.
* Working knowledge of building systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety, gas).
* Experience using a CMMS / CAFM or ticketing system and strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage many open items and follow through to closure.
* Strong communication skills; fluency in Arabic and English.
* Valid Saudi driving license and willingness to move between Riyadh sites daily

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in food service, cloud kitchens, hospitality, or retail facilities.
* Basic health and safety certification (e.g., OSHA, NEBOSH IGC, or IOSH).
* Vendor coordination and purchase-request experience.
* Using the AI tools in the work

  

**Why join us**

* Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
* Changing the restaurant industry: You'll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
* Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you'll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer's success.

  

**What else you need to know**

This role is based in our Riyadh office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We're constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

Title: Cyber Defense Analyst (Tier 1) - Afternoon
Description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.

**Location: Remote**

**1.0 Role Description**
========================

***The Cyber Defense Analyst is responsible for monitoring, triaging, and providing first response to security alerts across VSOC customer environments, using various security tools to distinguish meaningful threats from background noise while carefully documenting investigations and analyzing events for signs of true positive threats. They work closely with fellow analysts, sharing findings and leveraging senior colleagues’ expertise to deepen their analysis, determine the appropriate severity of each situation, and promptly escalate issues to the right stakeholders. At the end of each shift, they clearly communicate outstanding items and tasks to the incoming team to ensure continuity of operations and effective SOC performance.***
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**1.1 Primary Responsibilities**
--------------------------------

**Protect and Defend:**

* **Monitor Customer Environments** - Leverage the customer's security technologies to triage security alerts and identify potential threats.
* **Escalate confirmed or suspected Threats** - Compile an actionable report that describes a threat to the customer environment and escalate through the appropriate channels.
* **Document Investigations** - Record security investigation efforts in a thorough manner that allows for easy peer review and collaboration through the appropriate case management tool.

**Incident Response:**

* Execute standard operating procedures (SOPs) for common alert types
* Perform basic artifact analysis (IP addresses, domains, file hashes)
* Conduct initial containment actions (isolating hosts, blocking IPs) per runbooks
* Document all actions taken with timestamps and evidence preservation

**Communicate and Collaborate:**

* **Acknowledge and handle Customer Requests** - Process communications from assigned customers and fulfill (or forward) the tasks as appropriate.
* **Support your Shift** - Be available to your teammates while on shift and ready to assist them at all times.
* **Improve SOC Situational Awareness** - Use the Shift Turnover Report to note outstanding work items, tasks and situations that the following shifts should be aware of.

**1.2 Secondary Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

**Maintain SOC Readiness:**

* **Verify and Improve Customer Access** - Take responsibility of your overall access situation and work with the Program Managers to achieve 100% access across all customers.
* **Identify and Fill knowledge gaps** - Convert localized tribal knowledge into global shared knowledge through SharePoint articles and documents for the entire SOC to benefit from.
* **Update outdated documentation** - Take stock of currently existing documentation and change the information as necessary to keep the knowledge base current.

**Continuous Development:**

* **Keep up-to-date on Threat Landscape** - Review Threat Intelligence's weekly Cyber Threat Reports and crawl the open web to learn about contemporary threats to our environments.
* **Hone Blue Team skills** - Seek out challenges and trainings to improve your Analysis skillset.
* **Get Creative** - Take a proactive approach to problems encountered in your career and consider possible solutions you or the team can implement to overcome them.

**2.0 Role Integrations**
=========================

**2.1 Collaboration with the Intelligence Team**
------------------------------------------------

**Purpose**

The Intelligence team provides the Tier 1 Cyber Security Analyst situational updates on the ever-changing Cyber Threat Landscape regularly. T1 Analyst should seek to leverage the knowledge provided to improve their contextual awareness for threats in their daily monitoring duties.

**Requirements**

* **Stay Appraised:** Attend weekly Threat Intelligence briefings (or download the recording/slides of the briefings) regularly to stay up-to-date on the latest changes to the Cyber Threat Landscape.
* **Feedback Loop:** Provide feedback to the intelligence team on the effectiveness and accuracy of the threat intelligence reports received. Share insights and observations from working with the threat hunting content and highlight any areas where additional or more specific information would be beneficial for improving the content's accuracy and relevance.

**2.2 Collaboration with the Program Management Team**
------------------------------------------------------

**Purpose**

The Program Management team handles the majority of the VSOC’s administrative duties for our customer environments. Tier 1 Cyber Security Analysts should leverage the PM team to gain further insight into what their customer environments need from them as well for handling clerical tasks (such as requesting access for customer tools)

**Requirements**

* **Regular Communication:** Request for the Program Management team must be documented in our case management system and frequently followed-up on in order to maintain momentum and prevent important tasks from falling off the PM’s radar.
* **Self-Accountability (Access :** Customer access is a core requirement of the T1 Analysts role in the VSOC and often takes time to restore once lost. VSOC Analysts must regularly verify and maintain their access to prevent long periods of downtime as the result of access loss.

**2.3 Collaboration with the Customer Tech Leads**
--------------------------------------------------

**Purpose**

Customer Technology Leads (formerly known as Client Leads) serve as the operational SME of a customer environment. Cyber Defense Analysts will interface with these leads in order to address environmental concerns (such alert tuning or customer requests).

**Requirements**

* **Regular Communication:** T1 Analysts who are assigned to customer environments should be aware of who the relevant Customer Tech Leads are and be ready to open lines of communication with them to raise concerns or ask questions to help them on their Threat Monitoring duties.
* **Identify Tuning Opportunities:** Many alerts worked by T1 Analysts often result in false positive/benign results that generate unnecessary noise in a customer environment. T1 Analysts should help mitigate the noise by identifying these noisy alerts and informing the Customer Tech Lead of tuning opportunities through **Tuning Requests**.

**2.4 Collaboration with the Engineering Team**
-----------------------------------------------

**Purpose**

The Engineering team maintains the availability of the majority of the VSOC’s customer environments. Cyber Defense Analysts interface with technologies that Engineering teams maintain and relay any issues in availability and performance so that Engineering can resolve them in a timely manner.

**Requirements**

* **Regular Communication:** T1 Analysts who are assigned to customer environments should be aware of who the relevant Engineers are and be ready to open lines of communication with them to raise issues that impact system availability or performance.

**Identify Tuning Opportunities:** Many alerts worked by T1 Analysts often result in false positive/benign results that generate unnecessary noise in a customer environment.

**3.0 Qualifications**
======================

**3.1 Mandatory Requirements**
------------------------------

### **3.1.1 Experience**

* 1–2+ years of experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, or security monitoring in a SOC/NOC or similar environment.
* Hands-on experience with at least one SIEM/XDR platform (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent) for alert monitoring and triage.
* Experience using endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools for basic investigation and containment.
* Practical experience triaging alerts, performing basic artifact analysis, and escalating incidents.
* Exposure to incident response activities (initial containment, documentation, coordination with senior analysts).
* Experience working in a 24x7 or shift-based operational environment.
* Experience documenting investigations and maintaining accurate tickets/case records.

### **3.1.2 Technical Skills**

* Solid understanding of network protocols and architecture (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, VPNs, common ports/services).
* Proficiency in basic log analysis and event correlation across multiple data sources (endpoint, network, identity, cloud).
* Familiarity with major threat frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain) and their practical application.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems from a security and operations perspective.
* Familiarity with at least one major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and its core security concepts.
* Ability to execute SOPs and runbooks for common alert types and initial containment (host isolation, blocking IPs/domains).
* Ability to perform basic artifact analysis (IP addresses, domains, URLs, file hashes, simple email header review).
* Comfortable using case management and collaboration tools to track and share investigation details.

### **3.1.3 Key Competencies**

* Proactive and self-motivated approach to monitoring, investigation, and continuous improvement.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills applied to alert triage and incident assessment.
* High attention to detail and accuracy in documentation, evidence handling, and severity assessment.
* Excellent written communication skills for clear, concise tickets, incident notes, and handover reports.
* Effective verbal communication skills for collaboration with teammates and cross-functional partners.
* Ability to work under pressure during active security incidents while maintaining composure and quality.
* Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing habits.
* Continuous learning attitude, staying current with evolving threats, tools, and best practices.
* At least one entry-level cybersecurity certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC, or equivalent).

**3.2 Preferred Qualifications**
--------------------------------

* 2–4+ years of direct SOC, incident response, or security monitoring experience.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Sentinel and/or Microsoft security stack (Defender, M365, Entra ID).
* Hands-on experience supporting or leading incident response for medium to high-severity events.
* Exposure to cloud security monitoring and hardening (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Experience tuning SIEM/EDR alerts and creating or refining detection use cases.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, KQL, Bash) to support investigations.
* Experience working in client-facing or consulting environments.
* Prior involvement in SOC process improvements, documentation, or automation initiatives.
* One or more intermediate certifications (e.g., CySA+, GSEC, GCIH, CISSP Associate, or equivalent).

**Salary & Benefits**

  
The salary associated with this position ($64,000-$128,000) is commensurate with the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, and demonstrated level of expertise. Compensation will be determined based on these factors to ensure alignment with skills, responsibilities, and market standards.
