Title: Oshawa Power Control Room Operator
Description:
**CONTROL ROOM OPERATOR**
-------------------------

Oshawa Power Group of Companies is a parent company of fiber optic, district energy and renewable generation businesses, and the local electricity distribution company that supplies electricity to more than 63,000 customers in the city of Oshawa. Located just 45 minutes east of Toronto off the shores of Lake Ontario, Oshawa serves as the economic engine for the Durham Region. Oshawa Power maintains 1000 km of overhead and underground distribution lines within a 150 km2 service territory, operated at 44 and 13.8 kV, supplied by 9 distribution and 3 transmission substations. The organization is committed to the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of electricity through responsible financial management, strategic reinvestment and continuous innovation.

**ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY**

Reporting to the Manager, Distribution Construction, the Control Room Operator is responsible for the safe, reliable and efficient real-time operation and control of the company's electrical distribution and sub-transmission systems during normal, planned, abnormal and emergency conditions.

As a designated Controlling Authority, the position monitors system conditions, authorizes and directs switching, administers work protection, coordinates field response and manages power restoration while protecting employees, contractors, the public and electrical equipment.

**Hourly Rate:** $44.99- $59.23 per our Collective Agreement with **IBEW 636**

**Vacancy Type:** Replacement

**AS THE SUCCESSFUL APPLICANT, YOU HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO BE INVOLVED WITH:**

**System Operations & Monitoring**

* Exercise real-time operational control of the company's distribution, sub-transmission and station systems during normal, planned, abnormal and emergency conditions.
* Monitor SCADA, ADMS, GIS, alarms, voltage, loading, equipment status and other operating information; identify abnormal conditions and take or direct timely corrective action to maintain safe and reliable system operation.
* Authorize and direct the safe operation of switches, breakers, reclosers, intelligent field devices, station equipment and other electrical apparatus.
* Monitor feeder, station, transformer and equipment loading; respect established ratings and operating limits and initiate or recommend corrective action.
* Use automated and self-healing distribution devices to support sectionalizing, fault isolation, load transfer and service restoration.

**Switching & Work Protection**

* Prepare, check, issue and administer switching orders, Orders to Operate, Hold-Offs, work permits and other work protection documents in accordance with the Utility Work Protection Code (UWPC), Electrical Utility Safety Rules (EUSR), and company procedures.
* Control and authorize operational access to electrical plant and equipment in accordance with the UWPC, EUSR, and company procedures.
* Review planned work with field crews, supervisors, contractors and authorized parties to confirm system configuration, isolation requirements, operating sequences and appropriate work protection.
* Direct overhead, underground, station and sub-transmission switching for planned work, system reconfiguration, load transfers, equipment isolation and service restoration.

**Outage & Emergency Response**

* Coordinate planned and unplanned interruptions; dispatch and direct field personnel to investigate trouble, isolate hazards, complete emergency repairs and safely restore service.
* Assess disturbances and establish restoration priorities that protect public and employee safety, safeguard equipment, maintain system integrity and minimize customer impact.
* Respond to emergencies involving downed conductors, damaged equipment, fires, motor-vehicle incidents, public hazards and possible life-safety concerns.

**Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate planned and emergency switching, supply interruptions, load transfers and station operations with Hydro One's control centre.
* Communicate with the IESO, Electrical Safety Authority, emergency services, neighbouring LDCs, contractors, major customers and other authorities as required.
* Provide clear operational direction to field personnel and accurate, timely outage and system information to internal and external stakeholders.
* Respond professionally to customer inquiries involving outages, partial power, voltage concerns and other distribution-system conditions, and arrange investigation as required.

**Operating Records, Systems & Improvement**

* Maintain accurate operating diagrams, maps, open-point records, equipment status information, switching records, outage records, operating logs and required reports.
* Support investigations of system events, equipment operations, interruptions, power-quality concerns and feeder performance, and assist with corrective actions.
* Assist with the development and continuous improvement of operating procedures, emergency and restoration plans, switching practices and System Control Center processes.

**Training, Safety & Other Requirements**

* Provide instruction and operational support to Apprentice or backup operators and maintain required technical, safety, emergency-response and cybersecurity training.
* Comply with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, applicable regulations, UWPC, EUSR, company policies and safe work practices.
* Available for emergency response, overtime and call-ins on an as-needed basis in accordance with established schedules and the collective agreement. Rotational shifts may be introduced in the future and would be included in the collective agreement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**WHAT YOU HAVE TO OFFER**

**Education:**

* Three-year college diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Engineering Technology or a related electrical discipline; an equivalent combination of relevant utility experience, education and technical training may be considered.
* Successful completion of the MEARIE Operator-in-Training Program and certification as an EDA Journeyperson Electrical Operator is required.
* OACETT certification, or eligibility for certification, as a C.E.T. or C.Tech. is considered an asset.
* Current UWPC certification is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum four years of progressively responsible experience in electrical distribution-system operations, System Control Center operations, utility field operations, protection and control, stations or a directly related electrical utility function.
* Demonstrated experience with SCADA, ADMS, GIS, switching orders, work protection, system isolations, load transfers and service restoration.
* Experience coordinating field crews and external authorities during planned work, outages and emergencies.
* Experience operating 13.8 kV distribution and 44 kV sub-transmission systems, including associated stations and protection schemes, is preferred.

**Required Competencies**

* Advanced knowledge of overhead and underground distribution, sub-transmission, transformer stations, protection schemes and associated equipment.
* Advanced knowledge and practical application of the UWPC, electrical isolation, switching and work-protection principles.
* Strong understanding of electrical fundamentals, loading, voltage, equipment ratings, fault response, system restoration and operating contingencies.
* Ability to interpret and maintain single-line diagrams, operating maps, schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings and switching documents.
* Ability to assess complex, changing conditions and make timely, accurate and defensible operating decisions with minimal supervision.
* Advanced problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to remain calm and decisive during outages and emergencies.
* High accuracy and attention to detail when preparing and administering operating and work-protection documents.
* Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to coordinate simultaneous switching, outage, dispatch and communication activities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including clear and unambiguous direction by radio, telephone and electronic systems.
* Ability to direct field activities and establish operational priorities without direct supervisory authority.
* Professional interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with employees, contractors, customers, emergency services, regulators and other utilities.
* Proficiency with SCADA, ADMS, GIS, Microsoft Office and other operational technology systems.
* Strong commitment to safety, system reliability, customer service, teamwork, respect and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work established schedules and maintain the concentration required to safely manage multiple concurrent activities, including rotational shifts if introduced in the future.
* Valid Ontario Class G driver's licence with a driving record satisfactory to the company.

Title: Patient Transporter

Description:

**Position Summary:**The Patient Transporter acts as a representative/transporter/courier of the health program, for eligible patients in accordance with the current transportation policies. Patient Transporter is responsible at all times for the patient’s health and welfare while they are transporting and until they deliver the patient to the health center, a recognized medical provider, or their home. In addition, the Patient Transporter must be able to communicate well and be able to establish rapport with patients and their families. He/she must be sensitive to the needs of the Indian community; its cultures, traditions, and values, as well as be familiar with the goals and objectives of the Tule River Indian Health Center, Inc. and express a genuine enthusiasm for its success.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

1.Must be able to abide by and effectively communicate the transportation policy of the TRIHCI to others and to screen for eligibility for transportation.

2.Provides limited courier services for medication delivery (Reservation only), clinic message delivery, and limited transportation of clients to needed medical appointments as assigned by the Outreach Supervisor.

3.Answer telephone, take messages, and schedule transportation for eligible patients according to the current transportation policy of the Tule River Indian Health Center, Inc.

4.Provide urgent transportation services as needed. Urgent means an acute or serious illness/injury that is not life threatening.

5.In conjunction with the Outreach Supervisor, the Patient Transporter may call for appropriate level of care and if determined to be an emergent need, 911 shall be called to assist with transport by EMT service.

6.Cooperate with other professional and ancillary health program staff and assist as needed/assigned in other departments to facilitate a team approach to health care delivery.

7.Provide First Aid/CPR (BLS level) to patients/clients as may be needed and necessary.

8.Records all scheduled transports in the transportation appointment book/log and maintains the book/log to reflect up-to-date activity and resolve any conflicts in scheduling.

9.Must be willing and able to work flexible hours as may be necessitated by schedule medical/dental appointments and distant transports, and community awareness events.

10.Must be willing to drive long distances and be confident/competent in driving to and around large metropolitan areas (e.g. San Francisco, Los Angeles, Fresno, etc.)

11.Opens necessary gates and removes other barriers in order to access an elder, ill and/or handicapped person’s residence so that person may be picked up. If a situation that requires barrier removal is determined to be unsafe, the Patient Transporter shall not be required to do barrier removal.

Title: Associate Administrative Officer (OPAS)
Description:
The Organizational Setting

Under the direction of the Director, Capacity Development and Implementation Bureau/ICAO (D/CDI), the Field Operations Section (FOS) is responsible for the strategic planning, development, execution, and evaluation of programmes in the Capacity Development and Implementation (CDI) Bureau. FOS assists with the identification of priority development requirements across civil aviation and with technical cooperation to recipient States. It carries out resource mobilization with multilateral and bilateral development partners and industry. FOS develops regional and country-specific technical cooperation programmes and projects and executes these programmes and projects in accordance with the policies and contractual modalities of CDI.

The Associate Administrative Officer is a combined finance and administration function that oversees the project office’s administrative and accounting tasks under the CDI Project: FSA2201. The incumbent reports to and works under the supervision of the CDI Programme Manager overseeing the project, in accordance with the terms of reference set out in this job description. The position is located in the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) of Saudi Arabia, in Riyadh, and works in close coordination with the CDI Field Operations Officer, ICAO Headquarters, GACA, and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to ensure the efficient, compliant and timely delivery of all financial and administrative services required for the successful implementation of the project. The incumbent exercises professional judgement in planning and delivering assigned work, analysing issues and identifying appropriate action within established policies, procedures and responsibilities. Complex or exceptional matters are referred to the supervisor for guidance.

Major duties and Responsibilities

Function 1 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides accounting and financial support for the effective administration of the project office by reviewing transactions, monitoring resource use and applying established financial procedure, achieving results such as:**

* Collaborate with relevant authorities to prepare the annual manning requirement list and coordinate with ICAO-HQ for budget preparation and submission of the budget report to the GACA Finance Department on a yearly basis.
* Liaise with GACA to ensure proper budget administration, authorization, and project funding, and bring discrepancies or delays to the attention of the supervisor.
* Manage petty cash, process payments towards project office expenses, reconcile monthly expenses, and prepare and submit Electronic Journal Cash Transactions (EJCT) cash book reports to ICAO Finance in Montreal.
* Analyse and monitor petty cash balances against the established threshold stipulated under ICAO financial rules and regulations, identify and address variances, coordinate the timely deposit of excess funds to UNDP, and prepare monthly replenishment requests to ensure the project’s petty cash balance remains consistent.
* Monitor local payments and payment authorizations for ICAO OPAS Experts, vendors, and other project-related expenses through UNDP, ensuring proper fund transfers and timely follow-up.
* Review vendor statements and invoices for completeness and submit them for approval and/or facilitate payment processing and manage the financial aspects of the ICAO experts and support staff members under the project.
* Manage travel claim records of ICAO OPAS Experts, ensuring compliance with ICAO and ICSC standards, monitor unsettled claims, and follow up on payments.

Function 2 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides administrative support to the project office, achieving results such as:**

* Coordinate day-to-day administrative activities, draft and review routine correspondence and letters, coordinate and monitor official email correspondence, and monitor follow-up actions to support timely field-project implementation.
* Organize project documentation, and coordinate the review, finalization and signature of the Management Service Agreement (MSA), the ProDoc, and related records.
* Coordinate the procurement of office supplies, and official operational requirements from local markets, and facilitate the procurement of digital publications for GACA and ICAO OPAS Experts.
* Contribute to the review of project reports, presentations, and financial analysis for the CDI Programme Manager.
* Organize and maintain an orderly e-filing system and documentation of all assigned tasks, correspondence and reports, applying applicable records-management standards; ensuring confidentiality and compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations; such documents to be shared only with the consent of the CDI Programme Manager.

Function 3 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides personnel and contract administration support, achieving results such as:**

* Compile, Analyse and submit key reports such as the Monthly Strength Return, Quarterly Reports, and Annual Reports.
* Coordinate with GACA authorities/Department Heads and ICAO-HQ on critical administrative matters, including contract extensions, staff performance reports, probationary reports, new expert arrivals, and repatriation of OPAS Experts.
* Review, reconcile and submit travel expense claim reports and educational grant claim reports for ICAO experts, and review, verify and submit leave requests (Annual, Sick, Home Leave, Family Visit, Lump Sum, and Mission Requests) to ICAOHQ in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate with the travel agency to arrange flight itineraries and issue domestic airline tickets for approved official travel and missions.
* Maintain updated and accurate administrative records, including contract renewal documentation, annual staff performance reports? (SPRs), driving authorization letters, and vehicle insurance records.
* Liaise with UNDP and GACA to facilitate the issuance and renewal of UN/GACA identification cards (IDs), and manage government-related requests such as Visas, IQAMA, Multiple Re-entry Visas, Final Exit Visas, and Driving Licenses through coordination with UNDP, UNRC and GACA.
* Coordinate training requirements for ICAO experts, including liaison with ICAO Global Aviation Training (GAT) Section, and prepare employment-related letters (bank letters, visa request letters, staff arrival letters, etc.).

Function 4 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides coordination, meetings and stakeholder support, achieving results such as:**

* Organize annual, quarterly and urgent meetings for the project office, and prepare draft agendas and minutes of the meetings (MOM) for project records.
* Liaise with GACA, ICAO, UNDP, UNDSS, UNRC and other relevant offices for project coordination, recruitment, and administrative support, and assist in meetings with these stakeholders to address project requirements.
* Facilitate recruitment processes, including coordination with GACA and ICAO for candidate approvals and onboarding, and assist with contract extensions, SPR, and repatriation processes for project staff.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination across all stakeholders, inside and outside the project office, for the effective implementation of the project.
* Maintain the confidentiality of all project-related data and ensure compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations.

Function 5 (incl. Expected results)

**Performs any other duties as required for the successful and timely implementation of the programme.**

Impact of The Outcome of the Position

The Associate Administrative Officer ensures effective project administration by managing communications, documentation, and stakeholder coordination. This role directly supports project efficiency, compliance, and the seamless operation of administrative tasks within the ICAO-CDI Project. The position plays a key role in maintaining efficient administrative operations, ensuring compliance with policies, and supporting project coordination, which directly impacts smooth project execution and stakeholder collaboration.

Work Relations and Contacts

The Associate Administrative Officer reports to the GACA Authorities in close coordination with the CDI Programme Manager. The incumbent also coordinates with ICAO experts on administrative matters, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.

COMPETENCIES

**Professionalism** : Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work.

**Deployment and progress**

**Help keep our community fed!**

The Bemidji Community Food Shelf is seeking an organized, dependable, and hands-on Food Operations Coordinator to oversee the day-to-day coordination of our warehouse and store operations. This position plays an important role in ensuring that food and other resources are received, stored, managed, and distributed efficiently and safely to meet the needs of our community.

The Food Operations Coordinator oversees the flow of food from donation or purchase through warehouse storage and distribution to customers. Working closely with the Executive Director, Volunteer Coordinator, Farm Coordinator, and volunteers, this person helps ensure that our food resources are used effectively and that our warehouse and store operate smoothly.

* **Hours:** 32 hours per week
* **Schedule:** Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, 7:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m., with a 30-minute unpaid meal break. An additional 8 hours will be scheduled on Tuesday and/or Thursday in coordination with the Executive Director.

* **Benefits:** Paid time off (PTO) and matching 401(k) retirement plan

**Key Responsibilities**

**Warehouse & Store Operations**

* Coordinate daily warehouse and store operations, ensuring food is properly received, sorted, stored, rotated, and stocked.
* Provide direction and support to warehouse and store volunteers.
* Maintain an organized, clean, safe, and well-stocked warehouse, store, coolers, and freezers.
* Coordinate food movement from receiving and storage through distribution.

**Inventory & Purchasing**

* Develop and maintain an effective inventory tracking system.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify purchasing needs.
* Prepare and place routine food orders within approved budgets.
* Monitor food availability and customer demand to ensure adequate supplies of high-demand foods.

**Food Safety & Quality**

* Monitor food quality, rotation, expiration dates, and storage conditions.
* Monitor and document refrigerator and freezer temperatures.
* Track food recalls and ensure affected products are removed from distribution.
* Identify opportunities to reduce food waste and spoilage.

**Food Distribution & Farm Coordination**

* Ensure food is appropriately allocated and available to customers.
* Coordinate food distribution for the store and other BCFS programs.
* Work with the Farm Coordinator to coordinate the storage and distribution of harvested produce.

**Operations & Volunteer Coordination**

* Maintain and improve procedures for efficient warehouse and store operations.
* Identify operational needs and opportunities for improvement.
* Train and provide day-to-day direction to warehouse and store volunteers.
* Work with the Volunteer Coordinator to identify volunteer needs and assignments.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Experience in warehouse, retail, food service, distribution, nonprofit, or a related environment; supervisory experience preferred.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
* Basic computer skills and willingness to learn inventory and purchasing software.
* Ability to safely lift and move items weighing up to 50 pounds and perform physical warehouse and stocking duties.
* Ability to learn to safely operate pallet jack and forklift following required training.
* Ability to work effectively with employees, volunteers, and customers from diverse backgrounds.
* Commitment to the mission of the Bemidji Community Food Shelf.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with inventory management or purchasing.
* Experience with food safety or food distribution.
* Experience working in a food shelf, food bank, grocery store, or warehouse.
* Experience directing or coordinating employees and/or volunteers.

The Bemidji Community Food Shelf is committed to serving our community with dignity and respect. We welcome applicants who share that commitment.

Title: Sous Chef – Organic Meal Delivery
Description:
**Lead the prep, the batch cook, and the delivery run.**

Down to Earth Cuisine is an organic meal delivery service, and we’re hiring an experienced Sous Chef to work alongside our Head Chef. You’ll help prep, cook, package, and deliver high-volume meals while keeping taste, presentation, and food safety standards consistently high. If you’re strong at batch cooking and like running an efficient kitchen, this role is built for you.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* 4+ years of experience in a high-volume kitchen, with a focus on batch cooking and meal prep
* A current Washington food worker card
* Excellent knife skills and proficiency in a range of cooking techniques
* Knowledge of special dietary needs, such as gluten-free, vegan, and low-sodium
* The ability to prepare high-quality dishes at scale while staying consistent
* Strong organization and multitasking in a fast-paced environment
* Clear verbal and written communication with staff, suppliers, and management
* Quick thinking, adaptability, and a positive attitude toward new responsibilities
* Meticulous attention to presentation, portion control, and quality standards

  

**Your week:**  
Friday, Saturday, and Sunday are required. Additional hours earlier in the week are also part of the role, supporting administrative tasks and customer service, and the specific days can vary with business needs. You’ll help prep, cook, portion, and package meals, then handle labeling, packaging, and deliveries to keep fulfillment running smoothly. Mileage is reimbursed on deliveries.

**What you’ll be responsible for:**

* Prepping, cooking, portioning, and packaging meals for delivery, with accuracy and freshness
* Working with the Head Chef on weekly menu planning and new recipe development
* Checking taste, texture, and appearance regularly to meet company standards
* Helping with ingredient ordering, stock monitoring, and waste reduction
* Following food safety regulations, including temperature checks, sanitation, and proper storage
* Helping answer customer questions about menu offerings, online ordering, and delivery
* Supporting the training and recruiting of new prep cooks
* Managing your time to meet prep, cooking, and delivery deadlines
* Other duties as assigned

  

**Tools you’ll use:**  
Commercial ovens, grills, fryers, and mixers; knives and culinary tools; inventory management software; and computer skills for menu planning, costing, and communication, ideally Shopify.

**Pay, hours, and benefits:**

* $30–$31 per hour, depending on experience
* 25–35 hours per week to start, with room for adjustment based on business needs and performance
* Hourly, non-exempt
* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance and Paid Time Off for eligible employees
* Mileage reimbursement on deliveries

  

Down to Earth Cuisine is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Title: MS Back Office Cloud Infra Engineer
Project Coordinator
Description:
**Who are we?**  
Global Maritime is a leading marine, offshore, and engineering consultancy that offers intellectually stimulating work within a deeply collaborative culture and with uniquely supportive leadership. This environment creates a culture where talented professionals truly thrive. At the heart of what we do are extraordinary challenges. We directly contribute to unique, often world-first projects on the global stage. We are driven by a vibrant culture of innovation, including dedicated R&D, advanced in-house software, and the freedom to develop your own ideas. This rapid exposure across the entire spectrum of marine, offshore, and engineering consultancy accelerates your expertise like nowhere else.
  
  
**Welcoming you to our team:**  
Based in Global Maritime’s Qatar office, the Project Coordinator will report directly to the Country Manager and play a critical role within the Marine Services Department. This team supports marine operations and offshore projects by ensuring the effective engagement, coordination, and deployment of subcontractors to meet project requirements safely, efficiently, and compliantly. Working closely with clients, vendors, agents, finance teams, and operational personnel, you will be at the heart of maintaining seamless project execution through effective administration, logistics coordination, documentation management, and stakeholder engagement. This role is ideal for an organized and proactive professional who enjoys working in a dynamic marine and offshore environment and thrives on ensuring operational excellence behind the scenes.
  
  
**What does success look like in this position?**  
Success in this role means keeping subcontractor and personnel records accurate, up to date, and readily available to support uninterrupted project operations. You will confidently manage qualifications, medical certificates, visas, training records, and travel arrangements, ensuring that subcontractors are always prepared for mobilization and demobilization activities. You will proactively identify upcoming document expirations and coordinate renewals well in advance, reducing operational delays and ensuring business continuity.
  
You will build strong working relationships with clients, vendors, agents, and internal stakeholders, creating clear communication channels that enable projects to progress smoothly. Success also means efficiently coordinating visas, port passes, travel, accommodation, and logistical arrangements while maintaining cost-effective solutions that support operational objectives.
  
In this position, you will accurately process timesheets, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor documentation through NetSuite, ensuring compliance with company procedures and client requirements. You will maintain reliable filing systems, provide management with real-time workforce availability and compliance data, contribute to monthly ESG reporting requirements, and support HSEQ initiatives through equipment calibration coordination, first aid kit maintenance, and reporting activities. Your attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to operational excellence will directly contribute to the successful delivery of marine services projects.
  
  
**How you make an impact:**  
As our Project Coordinator, you will make a significant impact by ensuring that all subcontractor deployment activities are managed efficiently, compliantly, and without disruption to project delivery. You will serve as a central point of coordination for operational documentation, mobilization logistics, compliance records, and stakeholder communications, helping the Marine Services Department deliver services effectively and maintain high standards of professionalism.
  
Your contribution will strengthen the organization's ability to mobilize qualified personnel quickly and efficiently while reducing operational risks associated with documentation, travel, compliance, and contractor management. By maintaining accurate records, supporting invoice and timesheet processing, generating purchase orders, and coordinating with the finance department, you will help ensure operational transparency and financial efficiency.
  
You will also play an important role in supporting the company's HSEQ and ESG objectives through reporting activities, equipment calibration management, customer feedback tracking, and health and safety administration. Through your proactive approach, attention to detail, and strong stakeholder management skills, you will help drive operational continuity, regulatory compliance, and exceptional service delivery for clients across Qatar and the wider region.
  
  
**Your starting point when you join:**

* Bachelor’s degree and/or relevant experience within marine, offshore, crewing, logistics, project support, or subcontractor coordination environments.
* Experience working with document management systems and maintaining compliance-related personnel records.
* Strong understanding of mobilization and demobilization processes, including visas, travel arrangements, port passes, and international travel coordination.
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills with the ability to maintain databases, trackers, reports, and operational records accurately.
* Experience processing timesheets, invoices, purchase orders, and supporting finance-related administration within a structured business environment.
* Fluent written and spoken English, with Arabic language skills considered advantageous.
* Knowledge of Middle Eastern business practices and culture, preferably within Qatar or the wider Gulf region.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to liaise professionally with clients, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy.
* A confident self-starter who can work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* To act within the powers of their role, leading by example and following GM compliance, ethics and company values.

  
**Working with us**  
Global Maritime stands out as the premier destination for any maritime professional due to our unique blend of technical opportunities – the chance to shape the industry's future on globally significant, cutting-edge projects – within a genuinely supportive and collaborative international community. This is all combined and led with leadership that actively mentors your growth within an empowering non-political environment.
  
At Global Maritime, you'll find an exceptionally supportive and collaborative environment. We cultivate close-knit global teams built on transformative relationships, not transactional ones. Expect transparent, two-way communication and a genuine sense of community, fostered through shared celebrations, activities, and a commitment to social responsibility. This ensures you feel connected, valued, and part of a cohesive international network focused on making a positive real-world impact.
  
Your journey will be guided by leaders defined by integrity, accessibility, and honest investment in your growth. You can expect clear strategic direction, open communication channels right up to the CEO, and a transparent Career Framework. You'll be mentored and developed by recognized industry thought leaders within an informal, flat structure where data drives decisions. This ensures you're empowered, supported, and valued as an individual, never just a cog in the machine.

Title: Network Engineer-GCGCON
Description:
**Position Summary:**

Under the general direction of Sr Manager, Network Services & Delivery, the Network Engineer is a senior level hands on technical leader responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, and ongoing operation of the organization’s enterprise network and network security infrastructure. This role supports a multi-site, 24x7 operational environment, requiring a strong focus on availability, resiliency, performance, and security by design.
  
The Network Engineer works in close partnership with IT Security to ensure network designs align with enterprise security architecture, risk management practices, and regulatory requirements.
  
The Network Engineer acts as the primary network architect for assigned domains, translating business, operational, and security requirements into scalable, resilient, and supportable network solutions. In addition to advanced operational responsibilities, the role provides technical leadership, mentors other network staff, serves as subject matter expert for initiatives, and collaborates with management, IT peers, vendors, and security stakeholders to deliver reliable and secure network services.

**Key Accountabilities:**

Operational Support & Service Reliability

* Assume technical authority and lifecycle accountability for the performance, capacity, and availability of assigned network systems.
* Provide senior-level operational support, including 2nd and 3rd level escalation, and lead resolution of complex network and security-related issues.
* Participate in after-hours on-call rotation, with accountability for ensuring networks are architected to be stable, secure, and recoverable.

Network Architecture & Infrastructure Design :

* Own the network and network-security architecture for assigned domains, including LAN, WAN, WLAN, Internet connectivity, and secure access platforms.
* Design and maintain network solutions supporting a multi-site, 24x7 environment, with emphasis on availability, resiliency, segmentation, and security-by-design.
* Lead requirements gathering, architecture, and technical design for network and security initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and security architecture.
* Act as technical lead and network architect for projects and major changes, providing design authority and implementation guidance.
* serve as the primary technical authority for secure connectivity, network segmentation, perimeter defense, and traffic control platforms.

Security & Risk Management

* Partner closely with the Cybersecurity team to ensure network designs support enterprise security controls, risk management practices, and regulatory requirements.
* Assume technical authority and lifecycle accountability for the security posture of assigned network systems.
* Identify and drive architectural and operational improvements that reduce incidents, improve security, and enhance overall service reliability.

Project Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Lead network and security initiatives from requirements gathering through implementation and operational transition.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance for projects, major changes, and infrastructure enhancements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, scalability, operational efficiency, and service quality.

Standards & Governance:

* Develop and maintain clear network and security architecture documentation, standards, and diagrams.
* Ensure network solutions adhere to enterprise architecture standards, operational best practices, and governance requirements.

**Educational and Functional Requirements:**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in network administration within a large-scale enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience in network and security architecture, technical design, and enterprise scale implementations within 24x7 operations.
* Post secondary education in Information Technology or equivalent experience.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in:

o Enterprise LAN, WAN, and WLAN architectures
  
o Network security technologies (firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS, segmentation, secure access)
  
o Multi-site routing and switching
  
o Internet connectivity and service provider integrations
  

* Proven ability to troubleshoot across network, operating system, and application layers.
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA )required, or equivalent experience;
* Cisco Certified Network Professional; Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert;Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer( CCNP, CCIE, PCNSE), or equivalent security focused certifications are considered strong assets.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business and security requirements into secure, scalable network architectures.
* Excellent communication skills with a service-oriented mindset.
* Valid Class 5 Driver’s License.

The role helps ensure the right teams are connected, actions and timelines are tracked, documentation remains current and stakeholders receive timely updates.

* Availability to participate in rotational 24/7 on-call support, including evenings, overnight periods, weekends and holidays during critical incidents; extended hours may also be required for major outages or other business-critical events

Title: Network Operation Center Supervisor I
Description:
**Job Title:** Network Operations Center Supervisor I

**Department:** Network Operation Center

**Reports to:** Network Operations Center Manager

**Location:** On-site located in Spokane Valley, WA

**About NoaNet**

NoaNet is a non-profit mutual corporation providing telecom solutions and services and is headquartered in Spokane Valley, Washington. For over 20 years, NoaNet has operated a reliable public open-access broadband network that today totals over 3,800 fiber miles and touches every county in Washington State. Our organization provides rural areas access to broadband services, supporting more than 100 last-mile providers that serve more than 260,000 customers. NoaNet’s owner/members are nine public utility districts and a joint operating agency. Learn more about NoaNet at https://noanet.net.

**Career Overview**

Support network operations center analysts in a leadership role by leading, training, and coaching a team of network analysts to provide superior customer support relating to monitoring, troubleshooting and repairing NoaNet’s and our NCS members networks consisting of multiple systems including PON, carrier Ethernet, and MPLS. Provide technical support to clients via telephone, remote access, and on-site service; provide circuit design support by interfacing with engineering, provisioning, and customers; provide technical expertise and training to network operations analyst for troubleshooting and maintenance of the network and associated equipment, interface with installers to test and turn up new circuit orders; and other duties as assigned. Provide field support to install, maintain and troubleshoot circuits and systems and, work closely with NoaNet’s engineering and sales teams, and provide guidance and support to contract installers.

**Responsibilities**

* Supervise a team of network analyst to provide superior customer service through effective leadership, documentation, training, and coaching techniques.

* Install and configure network equipment for service order implementation and train network operations analysts to do the same.

Title: Principal Network Developer
Description:
As a Principal Network Development Engineer within NAT, you will serve as a senior technical leader for network acquisition, connectivity delivery, and activation across OCI’s global infrastructure. You will guide the engineering execution of connectivity supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, backbone growth, and strategic network deployments.

You will operate at the intersection of network architecture, telecommunications, optical infrastructure, service providers, data center engineering, deployment, and operations. Your scope will span carrier circuits, dark and lit fiber, DWDM and wavelength services, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects. You will translate complex network designs and business requirements into clear technical specifications, implementation approaches, and acceptance criteria for internal teams and infrastructure partners.

At the Principal level, you will lead engineering decisions across programs and deployments, resolve ambiguous technical requirements, and evaluate tradeoffs involving capacity, performance, resiliency, physical route diversity, operational supportability, and delivery constraints. You will partner with architecture and engineering teams to identify implementation gaps early and use delivery and operational experience to influence future designs, technical standards, and supplier requirements.

You will establish the technical requirements for circuit acceptance, fiber and optical validation, turn-up, activation, and production readiness. You will guide teams in evaluating test evidence, resolving deficiencies, and documenting readiness decisions, exceptions, and remediation requirements before operational handoff. As a senior technical escalation point, you will lead the resolution of complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 issues across OCI teams and external providers, drive root cause analysis, and ensure recurring failures result in corrective actions and engineering improvements.

You will work closely with Program Managers to assess technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and recovery options across the delivery portfolio. You will strengthen NAT’s engineering practices through reusable standards, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, acceptance frameworks, accurate infrastructure records, and clear operational handoffs. You will also guide the use of automation, scripting, telemetry, database management tools, and AI-assisted engineering to improve validation, troubleshooting, data quality, and delivery efficiency while maintaining engineering rigor and validating outputs.

This role requires deep network engineering expertise, sound technical judgment, and the ability to drive complex outcomes across organizations and external suppliers. You will influence technical direction, mentor engineers, and raise engineering standards across NAT, with an emphasis on repeatable practices that improve connectivity quality, reliability, and readiness at global scale.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Provide senior technical leadership for complex global connectivity programs supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, and strategic network deployments.
* Own technical outcomes across the lifecycle of carrier circuits, dark fiber, lit fiber, wavelengths, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects.
* Translate high-level network architecture and business requirements into detailed technical delivery requirements and implementation strategies.
* Lead technical design reviews covering topology, physical paths, diversity, demarcation, transport, interfaces, optics, capacity, routing, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Identify design and delivery risks early and drive engineering decisions that prevent downstream deployment and operational issues.
* Define technical acceptance standards and validation requirements for network infrastructure delivered by external providers.
* Lead complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting across fiber, optical transport, Ethernet, routing, and provider networks.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for systemic or high-impact connectivity issues.
* Lead deep-dive root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions across Oracle and supplier engineering organizations.
* Act as a technical authority in supplier engagements, challenging proposed solutions and ensuring services meet OCI engineering, reliability, scalability, and operational requirements.
* Partner with Program Managers to assess technical risk, establish delivery strategy, make tradeoffs, and develop recovery plans for critical infrastructure.
* Lead cross-functional engineering efforts involving network architecture, backbone, Internet, optical, capacity, deployment, operations, data center teams, and suppliers.
* Develop technical standards, design patterns, acceptance criteria, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, and engineering best practices that can be applied globally.
* Identify systemic gaps in network acquisition and delivery and lead technical improvements that increase quality, predictability, and operational readiness.
* Influence supplier capabilities, technical roadmaps, testing methodologies, and service offerings based on OCI requirements.
* Lead or contribute to technical evaluation of new carriers, services, hardware, optical technologies, and connectivity solutions.
* Define requirements for automation and tooling that improve network delivery, validation, monitoring, inventory accuracy, and troubleshooting.
* Partner with software and automation teams to ensure engineering requirements are translated into scalable tools and workflows.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate technical analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution development while maintaining engineering rigor.
* Provide technical coaching and mentorship to NDEs, Program Managers, and partner teams.
* Raise the technical bar for NAT and serve as a trusted technical advisor across the organization.

**Critical Focus Areas**
========================

* Global carrier and service provider networking
* Optical transport, DWDM, dark fiber, lit fiber, and wavelengths
* Internet transit, peering, and inter-domain networking
* Backbone and metro connectivity
* Network architecture and resiliency
* Circuit and fiber acceptance
* Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting
* Supplier technical leadership
* Network readiness and production acceptance
* Root cause analysis and systemic remediation
* Technical standards and engineering governance
* Automation requirements and AI-assisted engineering

**Qualifications**
==================

* Extensive experience designing, building, operating, or delivering large-scale networks within hyperscale cloud, Tier 1 ISP, telecommunications, service provider, or comparable environments.
* Expert-level knowledge in at least one networking domain such as routing, optical transport, Internet, backbone, or data center networking, with strong knowledge across multiple adjacent domains.
* Deep understanding of network architectures and network device behavior.
* Strong knowledge of routing and networking protocols including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, TCP/IP, IPv4, and IPv6.
* Deep experience troubleshooting complex network problems across physical, optical, Ethernet, transport, and routing layers.
* Strong understanding of optical networking, fiber infrastructure, structured cabling, cross-connects, transceivers, and physical network design.
* Experience with Internet peering, transit, inter-domain networking, backbone infrastructure, or large-scale service provider connectivity.
* Experience translating high-level architectures into detailed technical designs and implementation requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple engineers and cross-functional organizations.
* Experience working directly with supplier engineering teams to resolve technical issues and improve infrastructure solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as an escalation point and lead root cause analysis for complex or large-scale network events.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to evaluate tradeoffs involving architecture, resiliency, performance, cost, schedule, and operational complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical issues and recommendations to engineering and senior leadership audiences.
* Experience with scripting or programming and a strong understanding of software development and network automation concepts.
* Experience defining technical requirements for automation, tooling, monitoring, or operational systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience designing or delivering carrier connectivity at global scale.
* Deep experience with dark fiber, lit fiber, DWDM, optical transport, wavelengths, metro fiber, or long-haul networks.
* Experience with OTDR, optical power testing, fiber characterization, acceptance testing, and complex optical troubleshooting.
* Experience working directly with major telecommunications carriers, ISPs, fiber providers, optical vendors, or colocation providers.
* Experience with network diversity, route engineering, physical path analysis, and resiliency requirements.
* Experience with Internet peering, transit architecture, BGP policy, and inter-domain networking.
* Experience supporting hyperscale AI or GPU infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Broadcom and NVIDIA/Mellanox-based networking platforms.
* Familiarity with YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF, gNMI, telemetry, and model-driven networking.
* Experience influencing supplier technical roadmaps, hardware adoption, testing strategies, or service capabilities.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate troubleshooting, analysis, documentation, scripting, and engineering workflows.
* Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership across engineering organizations.

Title: Logistics Operations Officer
Description:
### KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

#### 1. Shipment & Logistics Coordination

\* Coordinate daily import and export shipments from origin to final delivery.

\* Arrange and monitor \*\*FCL, LCL, air freight, and land transportation\*\*.

\* Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, airlines, transporters, customs brokers, and clearing agents.

\* Obtain freight quotations and negotiate competitive rates and service terms.

\* Ensure timely booking of containers, vessels, flights, and trucks.

\* Monitor shipment schedules, ETD/ETA, transshipment, delays, and delivery status.

\* Maintain an updated shipment tracker for all active shipments.

#### 2. Import & Export Operations

\* Handle complete import/export logistics documentation.

\* Coordinate \*\*Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary Certificate, Health Certificate, COO and other relevant documents\*\*.

\* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure documents are received accurately and on time.

\* Liaise with customs and relevant government authorities for shipment clearance.

\* Ensure compliance with UAE import regulations and GCC requirements.

\* Coordinate inspection, approval, sampling, and release of shipments where required.

#### 3. Perishable & Food Cargo

\* Manage logistics for \*\*fresh fruits, vegetables, rice, wheat flour, sugar, edible oils and other food products\*\*.

\* Coordinate temperature-controlled transportation and reefer containers where required.

\* Monitor cold-chain requirements and ensure cargo is handled within the required temperature range.

\* Coordinate urgent action in case of cargo delays, port issues, customs holds, or quality concerns.

\* Ensure perishable shipments are prioritized for clearance and delivery.

#### 4. Port, Airport & Customs Coordination

\* Coordinate with \*\*Jebel Ali, Khorfakkan, Fujairah and UAE airports\*\* as required.

\* Follow up on container discharge, D/O, customs clearance, inspections, port releases and gate-in/gate-out activities.

\* Coordinate trucking arrangements for container pickup and delivery.

\* Resolve operational issues involving shipping lines, terminals, ports, airlines, customs, and transport companies.

\* Monitor demurrage, detention, storage, port and other logistics-related charges.

#### 5. Transportation & Delivery

\* Arrange local and GCC transportation according to shipment requirements.

\* Coordinate container trucks, refrigerated trucks and delivery vehicles.

\* Ensure timely collection from ports/airports and delivery to warehouses or customers.

\* Obtain PODs and maintain proper delivery records.

\* Monitor vehicle movement and coordinate with drivers and transport companies.

#### 6. Supplier & Freight Forwarder Management

\* Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, transporters and clearing agents.

\* Request and compare quotations before confirming logistics arrangements.

\* Evaluate service quality, transit time, pricing and reliability of logistics providers.

\* Escalate repeated operational failures and negotiate corrective actions.

\* Develop a reliable network of logistics service providers across key trade lanes.

#### 7. Cost Control

\* Review freight quotations and logistics invoices.

\* Negotiate freight, trucking, clearance, handling, storage and other operational charges.

\* Monitor and minimize \*\*demurrage, detention, storage, waiting time and unnecessary additional costs\*\*.

\* Verify logistics invoices against agreed quotations and shipment records.

\* Maintain shipment-wise logistics cost records.

#### 8. Documentation & Reporting

\* Maintain complete and organized shipment files.

\* Prepare daily/weekly shipment status reports.

\* Maintain records of:

\* Shipment status

\* ETA/ETD

\* Container numbers

\* BL/AWB details

\* Customs status

\* Clearance status

\* Delivery status

\* Logistics costs

\* Outstanding documents

\* Provide management with regular updates on delayed, urgent, or high-value shipments.

### MANAGER-LEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES

For the \*\*Logistics Operations Manager\*\* position, additional responsibilities include:

\* Lead and supervise the logistics operations team.

\* Develop logistics SOPs and operational procedures.

\* Establish and manage freight-forwarder and transporter contracts.

\* Negotiate annual/monthly freight rates and credit facilities.

\* Develop strategic relationships with shipping lines, airlines and logistics providers.

\* Monitor overall logistics performance and operational KPIs.

\* Optimize shipping routes, freight costs and delivery schedules.

\* Plan logistics capacity based on projected purchasing and sales volumes.

\* Identify operational risks and develop contingency plans.

\* Manage major shipment escalations and resolve operational disputes.

\* Train and supervise logistics staff.

\* Report logistics performance, costs and issues directly to senior management.

### KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

\* On-time shipment booking

\* On-time customs clearance

\* On-time delivery

\* Freight cost savings

\* Reduction in demurrage and detention

\* Documentation accuracy

\* Shipment visibility and tracking

\* Supplier/forwarder response time

\* Reduction in shipment delays

\* Successful handling of perishable cargo

\* Logistics cost per shipment/container

\* Customer delivery performance

### REQUIREMENTS

\*\*Education:\*\*

\* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field.

\*\*Experience:\*\*

\* Officer: \*\*2–4 years\*\* relevant logistics/import-export experience.

\* Manager: \*\*5+ years\*\* relevant logistics/supply chain experience.

\* UAE logistics experience is highly preferred.

\* Experience with \*\*foodstuff, FMCG, agricultural products, perishables, or trading companies\*\* will be an advantage.

### REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE

\* UAE import/export procedures

\* Customs clearance

\* Shipping and freight forwarding

\* FCL/LCL operations

\* Air freight operations

\* Reefer and temperature-controlled cargo

\* Port and terminal procedures

\* Transportation and trucking

\* Import/export documentation

\* Demurrage and detention

\* GCC logistics

\* Incoterms

\* Basic logistics cost analysis

### SKILLS

\* Strong negotiation and communication skills

\* Excellent coordination and follow-up abilities

\* Strong problem-solving skills

\* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

\* Good knowledge of MS Excel and Microsoft Office

\* Strong documentation and organizational skills

\* Ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously

\* Strong commercial awareness

\* Ability to communicate effectively with suppliers, forwarders, transporters and government authorities

\* Fluent English required; \*\*Hindi/Arabic\*\* would be an advantage.

### PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

\* Proactive and responsible

\* Highly organized and detail-oriented

\* Strong sense of urgency

\* Commercially minded

\* Reliable and accountable

\* Good team player

\* Capable of independently handling operational issues

\* Willing to work beyond standard hours when urgent shipments require attention

### WORKING ENVIRONMENT

The role requires frequent communication and coordination with suppliers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, customs brokers, transport companies, warehouses, customers and internal departments.

The candidate must be prepared to handle urgent shipment requirements, delays, port/airport issues and time-sensitive perishable cargo operations.

### AUTHORITY & ACCOUNTABILITY

The Logistics Operations Officer / Manager will be accountable for ensuring that shipments are:

\*\*Booked → Shipped → Cleared → Collected → Delivered\*\*

efficiently, cost-effectively, safely, and within the required timelines.

For the Manager position, the role will also be responsible for \*\*team performance, logistics cost optimization, service-provider management and overall logistics strategy\*\*.

Pay: AED2,500.00 - AED4,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Inflight Training Operations Controller
Description:
Job Summary:

Reporting to the Manager, Crew Planning, the Inflight Training Operations Controller is responsible for the coordination, execution, and oversight of all short-term inflight training activities. This role manages the day-to-day and monthly scheduling of Flight Attendant training programs, ensuring compliance with all regulatory and company training requirements.

Working collaboratively with Inflight Training, Crew Planning, and operational stakeholders, the Controller ensures training activities are effectively scheduled, monitored, and recovered in the event of operational disruptions. The role is critical to maintaining crew qualifications, operational readiness, and compliance with Transport Canada regulations and company standards.

Duties & Responsibilities:

### **Training Operations & Scheduling**

* Execute and manage all short-term (current month and day-of) inflight training schedules.
* Plan, adjust, and optimize training activities within crew management systems.
* Coordinate recovery of disrupted training events, including initial, recurrent, upgrade, and specialized training.
* Schedule and adjust instructor resources to support training delivery requirements.

### **Tracking & Compliance**

* Monitor and track completion of all inflight training to ensure regulatory and company compliance.
* Oversee inflight crew training validity and currency in accordance with Transport Canada regulations and company policies.
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate compliance risks, including expiries or missed training.

### **Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Liaise with Inflight Training, Crew Scheduling, and external vendors to support training delivery and recovery efforts.
* Partner with Inflight leadership on training priorities, constraints, and operational impacts.
* Communicate training schedules, updates, and changes clearly to inflight crew members.

### **Systems & Administration**

* Maintain accurate training records and scheduling updates within crew management systems.
* Input and validate schedule adjustments and associated pay implications.
* Review and reconcile manual adjustments related to training and crew utilization.

### **Reporting & Monitoring**

* Monitor daily training performance and identify risks to completion or operational readiness.
* Generate and maintain reports on training status, expiries, and recovery plans.
* Provide data-driven insights to support planning and decision-making.

### **Safety & Compliance**

* Actively participate in the Safety Management System (SMS), including reporting hazards and operational irregularities.
* Promote adherence to company safety policies and regulatory requirements.

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer – Team Leader to lead and supervise electrical substation condition-monitoring activities under the Kahramaa project.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing field teams, coordinating technical inspections and diagnostic testing, ensuring compliance with project specifications and Kahramaa requirements, and overseeing the effective execution of condition-monitoring activities across electrical transmission and distribution substations.

The role requires strong technical expertise in electrical power systems, team leadership, project coordination, resource management, quality assurance, and HSE compliance.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

A. Technical & Operational Management:

* Lead and supervise electrical condition-monitoring activities across transmission and distribution substations.
* Oversee Partial Discharge (PD) testing, Infrared (IR) Thermography inspections, and other assigned diagnostic activities.
* Ensure all inspection and testing activities are performed in accordance with approved procedures, method statements, technical specifications, and Kahramaa requirements.
* Review technical reports, inspection findings, test results, and equipment condition assessments.
* Identify critical equipment abnormalities and ensure timely escalation with appropriate technical recommendations.
* Coordinate with Data Analysts and Data Operators to ensure accurate data collection, verification, and reporting.
* Monitor the quality and accuracy of all technical deliverables.

B. Team Leadership & Manpower Management:

* Lead, allocate, and supervise engineers, technicians, inspectors, and field personnel.
* Prepare daily and weekly work schedules and assign responsibilities based on project priorities.
* Monitor team performance, productivity, attendance, and work progress.
* Ensure effective manpower utilization and timely completion of assigned activities.
* Conduct regular technical and operational coordination meetings.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to team members.

C. Client & Project Coordination:

* Act as the primary technical coordination point between the project team, client representatives, and management.
* Coordinate with Kahramaa representatives for work permits, inspection schedules, access arrangements, and technical approvals.
* Monitor project progress against contractual requirements and agreed timelines.
* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
* Identify operational challenges and recommend corrective measures to avoid delays.
* Support the Project Manager in technical discussions, client meetings, and project performance reviews.

D. HSE & Quality Compliance:

* Ensure strict compliance with Kahramaa safety regulations, company HSE policies, and applicable electrical safety standards.
* Ensure proper implementation of Permit-to-Work (PTW), risk assessments, and approved method statements.
* Conduct toolbox talks and safety briefings before commencement of site activities.
* Monitor field activities to ensure safe working practices, particularly in high-voltage environments.
* Ensure compliance with quality assurance and quality control requirements.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with a Power Engineering specialization.
* Relevant professional certifications in electrical power systems, condition monitoring, or asset management will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of IEC, IEEE, and other applicable international electrical standards.
* Kahramaa project or utility-sector experience will be highly preferred.

### **Experience Requirements:**

* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in electrical power utilities, transmission and distribution networks, or substation operations and maintenance.
* Proven experience in leading and supervising electrical engineering teams.
* Strong practical knowledge of electrical substation equipment, including MV/LV switchgear, transformers, cables, and protection systems.
* Experience in condition-monitoring activities, including Partial Discharge (PD) testing and Infrared (IR) Thermography.
* Experience in technical reporting, inspection coordination, project execution, and client management.
* Previous experience in Kahramaa or similar GCC utility projects will be an added advantage.

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

Eureka Math²,
**Wit & Wisdom**
,

Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.
  
  
**Where We’re Headed**
Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.
  
  
Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Reporting to the Chief Learning and Product Officer, the Vice President, Services will serve as the general manager of Great Minds’ services product line. Great ideas only become great classrooms when the people leading them are supported well. Great Minds services, professional learning and coaching, are how that happens: long-haul partnership that helps teachers and district leaders rise to ambitious curriculum, in classrooms every week and in strategic conversations with leadership every month. The Vice President, Services will be the general manager of that work, owning the strategy, quality, and performance of our services so every district gets support that is rigorous, human, and built to last.
  
  
The Vice President, Services will lead more than 200 facilitators and coaches along with a services operations team that ensures the right resourcing to meet district and teacher needs. In addition, the Vice President, Services will work across Research, Learning, Sales and Marketing to connect services to stronger implementation and student outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the services portfolio and its market fit:

+ In partnership with the Chief Learning and Product Officer and the leadership team of the Learning and Product team, set the strategy for the services product line, including which offerings Great Minds should develop, improve, scale, or retire and how to scale across our diverse market.
+ Define the right mix of free and paid support, and of digital, virtual, and in-person services.
+ Determine which needs can be met through scalable foundational support and where customers need paid expertise, coaching, or more intensive partnership.
+ Use customer needs, implementation evidence, field feedback, and service performance to identify gaps in the portfolio and opportunities for new offerings.
+ Partner with Research & Content to develop service content that is instructionally strong, practical for educators, and suited to each offering’s purpose and format.
+ Partner with Sales & Marketing to define the value, audience, positioning, and sales guidance for each offering. Ensure customer commitments match what Great Minds can deliver well.
+ Partner with the VP of Product to build an integrated product offering that provides direct and real-time training and support aligned to our instructional vision and training approach.
+ Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations on pricing, cost to serve, revenue, and margin, making deliberate choices about where to standardize and where to provide more tailored support.

* Deliver excellent professional learning:

+ Establish clear standards for high-quality professional learning, including the knowledge and practices participants should take back to their schools and classrooms.
+ Define and monitor measures of delivery quality, participant learning and application, and contribution to implementation progress.
+ Create a model for national consistency and regional stewardship, specifying where content and delivery should be common and where adaptation to local context is valuable.
+ Use observation, participant feedback, and implementation evidence to identify variation in quality and improve offerings and delivery.

* Build and develop the delivery workforce:

+ Lead the strategy for selecting, onboarding, certifying, developing, and managing over 200 full-time and part-time facilitators and coaches.
+ Ensure the workforce has the product, instructional, facilitation, and learning expertise required by Great Minds’ evolving implementation approach.
+ Develop leaders who can observe delivery, give useful feedback, and strengthen the performance of their teams.

* Oversee operations and scale:

+ Lead the Service Operations function and hold it accountable for reliable staffing, scheduling, deployment, capacity planning, utilization, systems, and service economics.
+ Work with the Service Operations leader to match workforce capacity to demand, protect delivery quality as volume grows, and improve the efficiency and reliability of fulfillment.
+ Build service models, content, workforce practices, and operating systems that can scale without losing the elements that make services effective.

* Connect services to implementation and outcomes:

+ Partner with Success to ensure services address customer goals, context, and implementation needs.
+ Ensure evidence from facilitators and coaches informs customer support, portfolio decisions, and Great Minds’ broader understanding of implementation.
+ Partner with Research to assess whether services produce the intended changes in educator knowledge, practice, and implementation, and use those findings to improve the portfolio.

* 12+ years of professional experience with 7+ years of leadership experience in K-12 professional learning, coaching, or education services, including responsibility for the quality and performance of a delivery team
* Strong understanding of district leadership: how leaders set priorities, make purchasing decisions, manage implementation, and judge whether a service has solved a meaningful problem

Principal, Advisors & Consulting Services, Sub-Cluster Lead

Team: KSA Sub-Cluster Lead for Advisors
  
  
Location: KSA
  
  
Role –
  

* Engagement & Delivery Leadership – Lead project teams to deliver high-quality analyses, creative solutions, and actionable recommendations that generate tangible business value. Provide subject-matter or industry expertise and guide teams toward efficient, business-focused outcomes.
* Client Impact – Own mid- to senior-level client relationships, proactively shaping client agendas and managing relationship risks to ensure sustained trust and impact.
* People & Team Development – Manage and grow a diverse consulting team across KSA, mentoring junior teammates both within and beyond engagement teams. Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture and contribute to Mastercard’s knowledge management and best practices.
* Internal Collaboration – Partner with Country Managers, Global Markets, and Business Development teams to align priorities, share market intelligence, and support regional go-to-market initiatives.
* Financial & Operational Accountability – Manage engagement budgets, staffing, and risk; maintain forecast accuracy and ensure compliance with firm policies and profitability goals.
