**All About You –**
Core Competencies
  

* Passion – Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in guiding project teams toward delivering the highest-quality results and recommendations.
* Problem Solving – Leads teams to identify the most critical aspects of a problem and guides them to business-focused solutions and recommendations that drive client value; initiates course corrections where required.
* Analytic Excellence – Demonstrates strong structured-problem-solving and quantitative skills; ensures efficient use of technical capabilities regardless of context.
* Project Management – Deep interest in project delivery with business clients and strong intuition for how companies make decisions.
* Client Management – Inspires client confidence through timely, reliable execution; develops stakeholder management plans to align priorities and address support or resistance.
* Communication & Presence – Crafts clear, complete deliverables and communicates effectively—verbally and in writing—across complex scenarios up to senior management levels.
* Teamwork – Motivates medium-sized teams or key workstreams on regional engagements to produce superior deliverables while fostering open collaboration and a “will-to-win” attitude.
* Commercial Orientation – Identifies opportunities to leverage internal capabilities, including cross-sell opportunities beyond direct project work; partners with broader Services teams on contracting and solution design.
* Leadership – Instills a sense of urgency, ownership, empowerment, and thoughtful risk-taking in leaders at all levels; structures work to align with team members’ goals and motivators.
* Integrity – Models Mastercard’s values of honesty and integrity; follows through on commitments and holds others accountable to do the same.
* Diverse Perspective – Brings unique skills or approaches to every client engagement and internal activity.

**Qualifications**

* Undergraduate or master’s degree and significant post-graduate work experience in payments and consulting.
* Deep understanding of the KSA , including regulatory frameworks, competitive dynamics, and cultural nuances that influence financial services and payments adoption
* Strong knowledge of Mastercard’s products, data assets, and ecosystem partnerships, and how these capabilities create competitive advantage and drive client value in KSA
* Experience in coaching and leading teams across large, strategic consulting engagements that involve structured problem solving and stakeholder management
* Deep knowledge of business KPIs, financials, and organizational leadership
* Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills; proven ability to guide project teams to structure and resolve ambiguous client challenges.
* Demonstrated success in owning and developing relationships with mid- to executive-level client contacts, inspiring confidence in Mastercard as a trusted partner.
* Strong ability to communicate complex ideas effectively—both verbally and in writing—in English and local market language(s).
* Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, balancing thought with action while maximizing limited resources.
* Advanced proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Purchasing Manager leads the purchasing function and team in support of manufacturing operations. This leadership role sets priorities, develops buyers, and oversees purchasing activity to ensure materials, components, and services arrive on time, at the right cost, and to specification. The role also includes some hands-on purchasing, with the manager personally issuing purchase orders, handling critical buys, and stepping in to support the team as needed.

The Purchasing Manager is accountable for team performance, supplier on-time delivery, purchase price variance, accurate ERP/MRP purchasing data, and compliance with company, customer, and regulatory purchasing requirements. The ideal candidate is a proven people leader with a strong manufacturing purchasing background who builds capable teams, holds them accountable, and is willing to roll up their sleeves when needed.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the purchasing team; set priorities, assign workload, and hold team members accountable to clear performance expectations.
* Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and goal setting; identify training needs and build bench strength within the team.
* Recruit, hire, and onboard purchasing staff, and plan staffing levels to meet current and future business needs.
* Build a culture of ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement within the department.
* Represent Purchasing in production, planning, and leadership meetings, communicating material status, risks, and priorities.

**Department Management & Oversight**

* Oversee daily purchasing activity to ensure purchase orders are placed, confirmed, and expedited in time to support production schedules.
* Review open orders, past-due lines, and shortages with the team; set recovery plans and escalate issues as needed.
* Establish, document, and enforce standard purchasing procedures, approval workflows, and authority levels.
* Review and approve purchase orders, pricing, and terms within delegated authority.
* Partner with Production Planning, Engineering, Quality, and Finance to align purchasing with build schedules, engineering changes, and new product introductions.

**Hands-On Purchasing**

* Issue purchase orders, including obtaining quotes, negotiating pricing and terms, and confirming delivery dates with suppliers.
* Personally handle critical, complex, or high-value purchases and key supplier negotiations.
* Step in to support buyer workload during peak demand, absences, or urgent shortages.
* Serve as the escalation point for difficult supplier, pricing, and delivery issues.

**Supplier Management**

* Manage relationships with key suppliers, including pricing, lead times, and terms.
* Monitor supplier on-time delivery and quality performance, and work with Quality to drive corrective actions.
* Support approved supplier list maintenance and identify alternate sources when needed to resolve supply issues.

**Systems, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure the team maintains accurate ERP/MRP purchasing data, including lead times, pricing, supplier records, and open order status.
* Track and report purchasing KPIs including Supplier On-Time Delivery, Purchase Price Variance, Past-Due POs, Material Availability, and Cost Savings.
* Provide purchasing status updates and analysis to senior leadership.
* Lead improvements to purchasing processes, cycle times, and costs.

**Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure purchase orders flow down all applicable quality, customer, and contract requirements.
* Ensure compliance with ITAR, export control, government contract, and customer-specific requirements in all purchasing activities.
* Maintain purchasing documentation and records in an audit-ready condition, and support internal, customer, and third-party audits.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 5+ years of purchasing or procurement experience in a manufacturing environment, including 3+ years supervising or managing a purchasing team.
* Proven track record of hiring, coaching, and developing employees and managing team performance.
* Strong working knowledge of MRP-driven purchasing, purchase order management, and expediting, with the ability to step in and buy when needed.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to read and interpret bills of material, engineering drawings, and purchase specifications.
* Excellent communication, cross-functional collaboration, and conflict resolution skills.
* Must be a US Person in accordance with ITAR regulations.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
* Experience in a defense, electronics, or regulated manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of government contract flow-down requirements and ISO 9001 purchasing controls.
* Professional certification such as ASCM CPIM or ISM CPSM.

Duties and Responsibilities

Background: The UN Secretary General’s development system reform, launched on 1 January 2019 through General Assembly resolution 71/243 and furthered by resolution 72/279, strengthened Resident Coordinators and their Offices as the central platform for coordination and integrated policy support at country level. The UN Country Team in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, aligned with national development priorities and Vision 2030, prepares an annual UNCT Results Report that presents system wide results under the Cooperation Framework. The primary audience is the national Government, followed by partners in country. The report must use UN INFO as the backbone for both results and finance, and it must be released by 31 March each year. Maximum length is 25 pages or 10,000 words. The report links outputs to outcomes, includes a financial overview, highlights partnerships and SDG financing, and integrates cross cutting principles including Leave No One Behind, gender equality, disability inclusion, youth, human rights, and environmental sustainability. Objective of the Assignment Lead, coordinate, and deliver the UNCT Results Report for KSA, ensuring evidence based, visually strong, and timely reporting that demonstrates system wide results against the Cooperation Framework and Vision 2030 priorities. Scope of Work and Key Tasks: Under the supervision of the Head of the RC Office and the RCO Economist, and in close coordination with Results Groups, M&E focal points, finance and operations focal points, and the Communications Group, the Country Results Report Lead will: 1) Planning and governance • Produce a backward plan from the 31 March release date, covering drafting, data cut offs, internal reviews, RC foreword sign off, Government presentation and feedback, and final publication. • Define roles and responsibilities across entities for data, narrative, finance, and quality assurance. 2) Structure and storyboard • Draft an annotated outline that follows the official UNCT Results Report template structure: o Chapter 1: Key developments in the country and regional context. o Chapter 2: UN development system support to national priorities through the Cooperation Framework, organized under sections 2.1 to 2.6. o Chapter 3: UNCT key focus for next year. • Integrate cross cutting themes throughout, including LNOB, gender equality, disability inclusion, youth, human rights, climate and environmental sustainability, and resilience. 3) Data pipeline and evidence • Set and communicate a data cut off. • Coordinate UN INFO extractions for outcomes, outputs, indicators, locations, partners, and finance. • Link outputs to outcomes with quantitative baselines, annual progress, and targets. • Curate concise stories that show scale, policy effect, and systems change, supported by data. 4) Financial overview and SDG financing • Compile a financial overview that presents, for the reporting year and by outcome: total resources required, resources available, expenditures, and funding gaps. • Present funding sources and types, link resources to results, and include clear charts and infographics generated from UN INFO and agreed finance inputs. • Draft the section on partnerships and financing the 2030 Agenda that captures innovative partnerships, cooperation with international financial institutions, and examples of South South and triangular cooperation relevant to KSA. 5) Coherence, effectiveness, and efficiency • Draft the section on how reform and coordination improved coherence and delivery, including tailored UNCT configuration, joint work planning, joint programmes, integrated policy advice, use of regional and global assets, and operations efficiency gains through common services or premises. Quantify efficiency savings where feasible. 6) Design, language, and communications package • Produce a reader friendly report with strong visuals, and data snapshots, within the 25 page or 10,000 word limit.

A Masters or Higher degree in communication, marketing, social sciences, economics, public health, international relations, international development, law or related area is required. English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat. For this position, fluency in English is required. Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private, and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. **Job Summary**
As a Client Service Manager within Vialto Partners' Immigration Law practice, you will oversee day-to-day client service and operational delivery for one or more client accounts, ensuring consistent, high-quality service and an exceptional client experience. You will serve as a key point of coordination between client stakeholders, engagement leadership, and legal teams, overseeing operational workflows, monitoring service performance, resolving escalations, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires a proactive, solutions-oriented professional with strong client relationship management skills, operational expertise, and the ability to translate client needs and performance insights into practical improvements that enhance efficiency, accountability, and service delivery.
  
  
**Job Description**
A career within our Immigration Law practice will provide you with the opportunity to help our clients adopt a more strategic approach to managing their immigration needs.
  
  
As a Client Service Manager, you will play a critical role in maintaining strong client relationships and ensuring effective operational delivery across client engagements. Working closely with client stakeholders, engagement leadership, and legal teams, you will translate client requirements into practical processes, monitor service commitments, coordinate operational activities, and proactively address challenges that may impact service quality.
  
  
You will help strengthen workflows, improve operational consistency, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and the overall client experience.
  
  
**What You'll Create And Do**
Professional skills and responsibilities for this role include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders and engagement teams, understanding client priorities, managing service expectations, and translating requirements into effective operational practices.
* Service Delivery Management: Oversee day-to-day operational service delivery for assigned client accounts, ensuring service commitments are met, priorities are effectively managed, and operational challenges are addressed promptly.
* Operational Process Development: Design, document, implement, and maintain client-specific standard operating procedures (SOPs), workflows, playbooks, and escalation protocols, ensuring clear responsibilities, handoffs, and accountability.
* Case Management Oversight: Coordinate with legal and engagement teams to monitor case progression, milestones, outstanding actions, and dependencies, proactively identifying potential delays and supporting timely resolution.
* Performance Monitoring: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), service level agreements (SLAs), and operational performance metrics, identifying trends, service risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Client Reporting and Analytics: Oversee recurring and ad hoc client reporting requirements, collaborating with reporting specialists and engagement teams to ensure timely, accurate, and meaningful reporting.
* Issue Resolution and Escalation Management: Manage client service inquiries, operational challenges, and escalations, coordinating appropriate resolution plans, stakeholder communications, and follow-up actions.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify process gaps, operational inefficiencies, and opportunities for standardization or automation. Implement improvements that enhance service quality, reduce manual effort, and support scalable operations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with legal teams, engagement leadership, reporting specialists, and other stakeholders to resolve operational bottlenecks, align priorities, and ensure consistent execution of service commitments.
* Client Onboarding and Change Management: Support client onboarding, account transitions, and operational changes, coordinating the implementation of agreed processes, systems, workflows, and service expectations.
* Data Quality and Integrity: Coordinate data integrity reviews with engagement and reporting teams, identifying and resolving discrepancies that may impact reporting accuracy, client communications, or operational decision-making.
* Client Communications: Develop and maintain clear, consistent client-facing communications, including service updates, process documentation, FAQs, email templates, and operational guidance.
* Client Service Reviews: Coordinate regular client service meetings and quarterly business reviews (QBRs), presenting operational updates, service performance insights, improvement initiatives, and action plans while ensuring follow-through on agreed actions.
* Professional Standards: Uphold the firm's code of ethics, professional standards, and business conduct.

* Proven experience designing, documenting, implementing, and improving operational processes, including SOPs, workflows, escalation procedures, and service delivery controls.
* Experience monitoring case workflows, service commitments, KPIs, and SLAs, with the ability to identify risks, investigate operational issues, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Strong client relationship management skills, including experience facilitating service discussions, managing expectations, communicating with stakeholders, and handling escalations constructively.
* Ability to coordinate activities across multiple teams, manage competing priorities, resolve operational bottlenecks, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Experience working with case management systems, operational dashboards, reporting platforms, or similar tools to monitor service delivery and interpret performance trends.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to review operational data, identify discrepancies, assess service performance, and translate findings into actionable improvements.
* Experience supporting client onboarding, operational transitions, process implementation, or change management initiatives.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple client requirements, deadlines, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present operational information clearly and effectively to both internal teams and external clients.
* High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently while maintaining accountability for service commitments.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a commitment to operational excellence, continuous improvement, and exceptional client service.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing service delivery across multiple client accounts or complex, high-volume operational environments.
* Familiarity with immigration case management processes, client reporting requirements, and service performance metrics.
* Experience facilitating client service reviews or quarterly business reviews.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Alteryx, or similar reporting and analytics tools.
* Experience supporting process automation, workflow optimization, or operational transformation initiatives.

$70,000 – $105,000 annually.
